le'uganyis pa/ b.rama'i bas kyibyung ba brjod pa/ 13rajiX sulhan/ (phyi lo 123641240)de ltar elhutamisha'i sras mo rajiX de sulhan du khri la 'khod nas sulhan rajiyu zhes mtshan du gsol/ mos skyes pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes pas ma tshad bud med kyu chas dang / gdong g.yog tshang ma dor te khyo ga'i chas gos gyon nas zhi ba dang drag po'i dbu khrid cing 'dzin skyong byas/ mo khri la 'khod ma thag mulasmin dang / 'ahor gyi srid skyong gnyis kyis ngo rgol byas shing / de gnyis ni sngon ma nas mo khri la 'god rgyur ngo rgol byed mkhan yin pa red/ rajilta sulhan gyis 'phral du srid don gyi thabs tshul gyi sgo nas de gnyis dbang du bsdus/ je la brten nas 43 dang / baṅgāl gnyis kyis kyang mgo 'bul zhus/phyi lo 1239 lor rajilta yang bskyar 'ahor du zing 'jags ched bskyod dgos byung zhing / 'on kyang de ga'i srid skyong aXdza la rang 'jags srid 'dzin du bcugmo rang gi gzhung zhabs pa tuka'i mi drag tshos mo la dga' po ma byas shing /rgyu mtshan ni khong tsho'i thog bud med cig gis dbang sgyur bzhin pa de khong tsho'i 'dod blor gtan nas ma babs pa red/ der brten 1240 lor dolnga'i tuka'i mi drag tshos mo la ngo rgol byas shing / mo rang gis dga' po byed sa bran g.yog jawal usthān ākāta zhes pa de la yang sdang zug chen po byas pa red/ des ma tshad sarahinda mnga' khul gyi srid skyong ulatuniX zer ba de la raX.ā la ngo log byed du bcug pa red/ der brten rajiX de la gdong len byed par phyin yang mo rang dang mo rang gi blos khel sa yukuta gnyis ka 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / yukuta la srog thog tu btang ba red/ mo rang btson du gnas skabs su mo rang gi ming po btarām zer ba de rgyal gar bkod de sulhan du bskos/
14 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/rajiXs spyang grung byas te mgyogs por aṣānayā de rang gi phyogs su bsgyur te de dang mnyam bza' mi'i gnyen mdun byas/ khong gnyis dmag dpung stobs chen po dang disnya la bslebs kyang khong gnyis ka pham nas so so'i phyogs gtogs pa tshos khong gnyis bsad pa red/ rajiXs srid don thog nor 'khrul chen po gcig byas yod pa ni tuka'i sku drag tshos dga' po ma byas bzhin du mos rang gi bran g.yog añdzakā'i mi rigs shig la rgyab skyor phyogs 'dzin byas pa de red/ de min mi mang gis mo la rgyal sar bkod pa de brgya cha brgya tham pa 'grigs yod pa red/ mo'i dus skabs kyi byung rabs smra ba min2ja us tharaja zhes pa des mo la bstod bsngags chen po btang 'dugmo ni shes rab dang ldan la khrims drang po dang / gzhan la phan sems can zhig yin par ma zad mo ni mkhas pa rnams kyi sbyin bdag dang srung skyob byed mkhan zhig kyang yin pa red/ mo la rgyal po zhig 'os pa'i rmad byung gi yon tan thams cad tshang yod pa red/ spyir btang mkhas pa tshos bshad tshul ni gal te mo bud med cig min na mo ni rgya gar gyi dbang 'dzin pa don ldan zhig yin gyi red/ byung rabs la mkhas pa ela'idrastun (2125123605)mchog gis bshad don/ mo'i 'jon thang dang yon tan gzhan tshang mas mo rang bskyabs ma thub pa ni mo rang gi skyon gcig 5 skyes dman yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/ aḥwāka'i mi rigs nas yin pa'i mo'i bran g.yog lākāta ni mo rang rtsa med du phyin pa'i rgyu rkyen du gyur pa red/ ces bshad yod/ gang ltar gong du bshad pa ltar phyi lo 1240 lor mo bsad pa red/bantarām shāha (phyi lo 124041242)de nas btarām shāha disnya'i rgyal sar 'khod pa yin zhing / de ni elhutamisha'i sras gsum pa yin/ tuka'i sku drag tsho la chab srid 'dzin skyong thad dbang shugs
le'uganyisapa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 15chen po sprod rgyu dang / khong tsho'i phyogs 'dzin byed rgyu'i cha rkyen thog btarām shāha de rgyal por bskos pa red/ der brten tuka'i sku drag añtsa.ār usthān ayitigin zer ba zhig gis rgyal srid kyi bya bzhag la dbang cha tshod med pa bed spyod byas pa dang / khos rgyal po'i sring mo dang gnyen mdun yang byas pas kho'i gnas stangs shugs che ruphyin par ma zad rgyal po btarām shuha'i thog la yang dbang bkod byed 'go btsugs pa red/rgyal pos de la ma dga' zhing tshod med pa'i bya bzhag tu bsam nas de nyid srog thog tu btang /yang bdar uXn sunakar zer ba'i sku drag gzhan zhig gis kyang de nang bzhin byas par brten de nyid rgyal pos khrims ra nas phyir 'bud byas kyang kho slar khrims rar yong nas rgyal po'i bka' la dma' 'bebs byas pa na rgyal po khros te kho 'dzin bzung byed dgos kyi bka' gnang ba dang / mthar srog thog tu btang /de nas sku drag tshos dogs zon gyis gzab gzab byas te kha che'i chos byed bla ma tsho la yang rgyal por ngo log byed par bskul/ de tsho tshang mas byus ngan bting nas rgyal po btarām shāha 'dzin bzung gis phyi lo 1242 lor bkrongs 'dugbaharlam shāha'i rgyal srid ring phyi lo 1241 lor sog po tshos rgya gar la btsan rgol byas par munywan gyi srid skyong ṇḍabīr tshon agaja zer bas gdong len byas pas sog po tsho āttar gyi phyogs su phyin te 1241 lor 'ahor 'dzin bzung byas/rgyal po btarām shāha yis lhadzir ni:ma ul mānta zhes pa'i 'go khrid 'og dmag dpung btang yang de la grub 'bras gang yang ma byung / ༷hor gyi srid skyong de de nas bros thar tsam byung zhing / mi mang sdeb gsod 'jigs su rung ba byas rjes sog po'i dmag dpung rnams phyir log byas pa red/
16 'phags yul9 byung babarjod pa/lalā usthān masnyad shāha/ (phyi lo 1242—1246)maswād ni elhutamisha'i tsha bo dang / rukan uXn pherodza shāha yi bu yin pa dang / des baharlam gyi rjes su lo bzhi'i ring srid dbang bzung / des tuka'i sku drag tsho la dbang cha chen po sprad pas de tshos dbang cha la bed spyod byas/ sku drag tsho'i nang nas b.laban de gal che shos su gyur/phyo lo 1245 lor slar yang sog pos dpung 'jug byas/ sulhan (rgyal po )gyi spyod pa sdug tu phyin pas sku drag tshos de nyid khri las phabs te btson du bcug khra ring bar de ñtsha las 'das pa na elhutamisha'i sras gzhan pa nusar u sngon mabhamyud zer ba de khri la 'khod pa red/nusir u phrun mnyamād/ (phyi lo 124641266)nusar uXn mahalhad ni phyi lo 1246 lor sulhan gyi khri la 'khod nas lo 20 srid bskyangs/ de ni gzhan dang gros stun che ba zhig yin tshul bshad yod/ de ni kha che'i rtsa che'i gleg bam kunān gyi rjes su ji lta ba bzhin 'brangs nas shin tu stabs bde por sdod mkhan zhig yin zhing / kho mi hnā shin tu stabs bde po la gnas pa yin pas kho rang gi btsun mo la g.yog po yang ma bzhag pa red/ kho'i btsun mo ni kho rang gi blon po shugs chen po b.laban gyi sras mo yin pa red/ khos srid gzhung 'dzin skyong gi bya ba rnams b.laban gyi lag par bzhag pa red/ 'on kyang gnas stangs 'ga' zhig gis rkyen pas khong gis b.laban las don nas phyir 'bud byas te btsan byol du gtong dgos byung ba red/ b.laban btsan byol du phyin pa de ma thag tu sku drag dbang che ba tshog 'dzin skyong byed 'go tshugs/ 'on kyang ring min b.laban slar srid dbang
le'u gnyis pa/ b.rama'iskabs kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 17du log par ma zad sulhan de la btsan byol byed btsug nas de nyid so so'i a ma'i sar btang /skabs der rgyal khab la zhi bde dang srung skyob la nyen kha che shos ni sog pos dka' ngal bzos pa de yin zhing / de tshos nub byang phyogs nas dpung 'jug btsan rgol mu 'thud byed bzhin du gnas/ 'on kyang b.laban gyis sog po la kha gtad gcog pa'i gra sgrig byas yod pa red/ sog po'i dmag gis muXn dang / 'ahor la thog rgyag thengs kha shas byas te gser dngul mang po dang / dngos zog rin thang can mang po khyer bas ma tshad mi mang po yang bran g.yog tu khrid pa red/ phyi lo 1246lor sulhan rang nyid chu bo rāṇḍa brgal nas cirngab gtsang po'i 'gram du phebs pa dang /blon po b.laban la tsalam gtsang po'i phyogs su sog dmag la 'thab 'dzing byed du btang ba red/ b.laban de nyid kelam gtsang po'i 'gram du 'byor ba dang sog po'i dmag dang thug/ 'on kyang b.laban 'dzing chog yod par mthong nas sog dmag phyir log byas pa red/ 'on kyang sog po'i dka' ngal de phyo lo 1256 lo'i bar du yang mu 'thud gnas yod pa dang / mulatun gyi srid skyong sogs mang pos sog po la rogs ram byas shing mgo btags zhus/ sog dmag gis yang bskyar somanātha'i phyogs su yong ba na b.laban gyis sog dmag pham par byas te rang gi mnga' ris de sog po'i btsan rgol dpung 'jug las bskyabs par byas/ b.laban gyi bu de rgyal po'i sras mo dang banyen 'dun byas/ mahalhad yi mi che'i tha ma ga re byung yod min shes ma thub kyang / de'i rjes su b.laban kho rang gis rgyal sa bzung 'dugb.laban/ (phyi lo 126641286)b.laban gyi rtsa ba'i ming ni g.yu su:na b.laban yin pa red/ kho ni rtsa ba'i
18 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/tuka'i mi rigs shig yin pa dang / sog pos 'dzin bzung gis bran g.yog gi tshul du gzhan la btsongs pa zhig yin pa la/ phyi lo 1232 lor elhutamisha yis dirsā la khrid yong ba zhig red/ elhutamisha'i 'og kho sku drag che khag bzhi bcu'i gral du tshud pa dang / rajilta sulhan gyi skabs kho la ngon pa'i dpon po dang / baharwam shāha yis panāb tu kho la gzhis ka zhig sprad pa red/ kho sngar rgyal po sngon ma'i blon po byas skabs sku drag nang phan tshun ma dga' bas dka' ngal sna tshogs byung yang gdong len mthar phyin byas pa dang / sog po'i btsan rgol las rgyal khab bskyabs thub pa sogs sngar rtsung zad bshad zin pa ltar la/ mthar phyi lo 1266 lor dirsā'i sulhan gyi khrir 'khod/kho khri la 'khod pa'i rjes su rang yul du dka' rnyog shin tu mang po bsal rgyu bsdad yod pa dper na/ tuka'i sku drag tsho mgo mtho bas dbang 'og tu ma 'dus pa dang / rgyal po'i bang mdzod stong par gyur yod pa dang / sog po'i dpung 'jug yang yang byung ba'i yul la nyen kha rtag tu yod pa dang / gzhung la me mang gis dad grus tna bkur brlags pa dang / mi ser tsho'i sems kyi dkyil du srid gzhung gi nus shugs kyi tshor snang yal ba lta bu'i gnas tshul las rgyal khab rgyud pa'i nang du lhung nyen yod pa red/der brten sulhan b.laban gyi dmigs yul ni rgyal srid kyi che ba dang dbang shugs bskur gso dang / rgyal srid la nyen kha can 9 sku drag bzhi bcu de rtsa med du gtong ba dang / sog dmag gi btsan rgol gyi ngan dpung de med pa bzo ba bcas gsum yin pa red/b.laban gyis dpung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs bskyar du byarngashe pas ma tshad jag bcom pa rnams yang snying rje med par chad pas bcad de khrims lugs bskyar gso byas/
le'uganyis pa/ b.rama'i skabasakyi byung babarjod pa/ 19sa cha nyen kha yod sa rnams la rdzong brtsegs te de tshor srung skyob byas pa dang / nags tshal gtsang ma bzos nas 'grul lam khag bzos/sngar sku drag tsho dmag 'khrug mi 'jon par gzhis ku'i nang skyid sdod byas pa dang / de yang pha gzhig bus 'dzin ngang bsdad pa red/ b.laban gyis rang nyid kyi rgyal srid shugs ldan 'dzugs skrun bya rgyur thag bcad/ der brten khong gis sku drag tsho las sa gzhis phyir len byed pa'i bka' gnang bar ma zad sku drag bzhi bcu'i dbang shugs gcog ched 'dzin skyong gcig bsdus byas/ srid byus kyi thag gcod tshang ma so sos byas te su la'ang dbang cha ma sprad/ der ma zad khrims kyi cha nas khong mpi su la'ang phyogs ris med pa'i khrims dpon gal che ba zhig kyang red/ dper na sku drag gcig gis g.yog po la chad pa btang nas de la brten nas kho shi ba na rgyal po 'dis sku drag de la mi mang gi mdun sar rta lcag zhus pa red/ gal te dmag mi zhig gis rang gi las 'gan sgrub ma thub na de la chad pa shin tu drag po gcod par byed/sog po'i nyen kha las skyob ched b.laban gyis drag po'i dpung dmag hrag po dang rgya chen po ltar yod cing / dmag mi'i sgrig 'dzugs shin twā legs pa yod/las 'gan gal che sa tshang ma las hoḥ tshang ma phyir 'bud byas shing / byang nub cakyi sa mtshams kyi mnga' khul de kho rang gi sras kyi dbang 'og tu bzhagphyi lo 1279 tsam la sog po'i dbung dmag chu bo gtalaja yi sa khul khag tu bslebs kyang de tsho pham par byas/ phyi lo 1285 lor sog dmag gis muXn la dpung 'jug byas pa na rgyal sras mutasmadakhyan gyis gnas tshul la gdong len mthar phyin byas/ 'on kyang stabs ngan pa zhig la de skabs rgyal sras de sku che dor ba red/sku na bgres pa'i skabs su sras grongs pa des b.laban la skyon chag chen po byung / khong
20 'phagasayul 9byung ba brjod pa/gi sras gzhon pa rgyal sras bugarākhun ni 'jon thang zhan la dmigs yul med pa 'dod yon la dga' po byas nas bsdad/phyogs gcig nas baṅgāl gyi srid skyong tugarilaslen zer ba sngon b.laban gyi bran g.yog yin pa zhig yod pa des b.laban de sog dmag dang 'thab 'dzing gis brel ba chen po yod pa'i go skabs de bzung nas des oris de yang 'dzin bzung byas te 1279 lor rang dbang rang btsan du dril bsgrags byas/ der brten sulhan b.labande nyid tugaril la chad pa gcod pa dang / baṅgāl du rang gi rgyal srid bskur gso bya ched thengs gnyis phyogs phebs gnang dgos byung / b.laban gyis tugaril bsad par ma zad de la rogs ram rgyab skyor byed mkhan tsho la yang chad pa drag po bcad/ phyi lo 1282 lor khong gi sras gnyis pa bugarākhyan zhis pa de baṅgāl gyi srid skyong du bskos/khong gi sras rgan pa de phyi lo 1285 lor sog dmag skabs che srog shor ba des b.laban la rgyud pa shin tu chen po byung zhing 'u thug thabs zad kyis sras gnyis pa bugarākhyan la rang gi rjes 'dzin du bskos te sras de nyid di: la bos pa na de dirsā la bslebs kyang yab la ma zhus par baṅgāl du phyir log byas/ de la yab ma dga' bas sras rgan pa marnyasmyudakhun gyi bu nakhus/ zer ba de nyid khri 'dzin du bdams/ 'on kyang 1286 lor b.laban grongs pa na sku drag tshos rgyal sras gzhon pa'i bu na(bād zhes pa de nyid rgyal sar bkod 'dug de ltar b.laban de nyid sku che'i tha ma la khag po byung nas sdug bsngal dang bgres pa gnyis tshogs nas myur du 3 'phos/b.laban gyi rgyal po dang rgyal srid kyi skor bsam tshul dmigs bsal zhig yod pa ni sngon dus su rgyal po ni dkon mchog gi pho nya yin pa'i grub mtha' dang 'dra po yod/khong gis rgyal po la khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan yod par yid ches byed/ der
le'uganyis pa/ b.rama'i skabasakyibyung babarjod pa/ 21brten khong gis dzikhri isngo zhes pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes shing de'i don ni dkon mchog gi grib ma zhes pa red/ khong gis rgyal po la dbang tshad cha tshang ldan zhing gcig dbang gcig lcog la yid ches byed cing / be ni rgyal khab kyi srung skyob la med du mi rung ba yin pa'i yid ches byas/ khong gis tuka'i lha yi dpa' bo chen po mi yul du babs pa yin pa dang / dkon mchog gis mi nyung shas shig rgyal po'i ched du bdams yod pa'i yid ches byed/khong rgyal sar 'khod ma thag chang rag spangs te mi mang dang 'grog 'dris dor nas bag med rtse rgod sogs la nam yang mgo ma 'khor/ khong gis rgyal po la rkyang phyag 'tshal dgos pa dang / rgyal po'i zhabs la 'o byed dgos pa'i srol btsugs/ de dag ni rgyal po la grus bkur mtshon byed yin pa red/ khong mi phal pa dang bka' mol mi gnang zhing khra mang dang rgyang thag ring po byed/ khong dus rtag tu rgyal po'i chas cha tshang gyon nas bzhugs shing pho brang gi nang du'ang de ltar byed de rgyal po ni mthong tshul yag po dang gzi brjod dang ldan pa dgos pa'i yid ches byed/byung rabs mkhan tshos bshad don ltar na/ b.laban ni srid gzhung 'dzin skyong la nyams myong can dang / khrims lugs sogs la lhod yang nam yang mi gtong mkhan zhig yin/ mi drang ba'i la sa ka byed mkhan la chad pa gtan gtan gcod/byas tsang sus kyang bran g.yog dang g.yog po dang / rta g.yog sogs la sdug po gtong ma nus/ rgyal po 'di ya nga snying rje la mi lta bar drag shul che ba zhig yin bzhin du'ang kho rang gi sku sger gyi mi 3 la byams sems che zhing 'jam po zhig yin/ khong gis dbus oshilā nas yong ba'i skyabs bcol ba stong phrag mang po la sdod gnas sogs gnang nas rogs ram byas yod/ gshin chog la phebs skabs khong gi spyan la
22 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/spyan chab 'khor gyi yod par tshang mas mthong /b.laban ni shes yon la srung skyob gnang mkhan zhig yin pa dang / khong gi sku dus su parashilā'i snyan ngag mkhan chen po gasmyurakhusaru zhes pa de byon pa red/ b.laban de nyid rgyal po'i che ba dang gzi brjod che zhing / mi mang la zhi bde 'dzugs pa po dang / sog po'i dbung gi phung sbyor gtor bcom las skyob mkhan zhig yin zhes byung rabs pa tshog bzhed pa yin/naku'ad/ (phyi lo 128741290)gong du bshad pa ltar b.laban rang nyid kyis sras rgan pa'i bu skukhusarlu khri 'dzin du bdams pa cas med du bzhag nas mi drag tshos rgyal po'i sras gzhon pa'i bu kekabād zhes pa de b.laban gyi rjes 'dzin du khri la bkod/ rke)bād de snyad sulhan 'khod pa'i skabs kho lo bcu bdun yin pa red/ kho sngon ma mes po b.laban gyis sgrig khrims dam po'i nang bzhag pa yin pas rgyal por gyur rjes 'dod yon dang dga' skyid la tshod med spyad/ rgyal po la mig lta byas te rgyal po'i khrims ra'i gzhung zhabs pa tsho yang sdug tu phyin/ dbang shugs tshang ma gzhan gyis lag par shor nas sulhan rang nyid gzhan gyi lag par rtsed chag a lad pad ko nang bzhin du gyur/ rgyal po 'di ni dbang shugs shin tu zhan la mi 'jon pa zhig red/de'i skabs kyang sog po'i dpung rgol byung zhing sa mtshams sa gnas re zung la 'phrog bcom byas yod 'dug 'on kyang sngar b.laban gyis gra sgrig srung skyob byas nas bzhag yod pa des sog dmag gi gdong len byed par 'thug tshang byung bas/ sog dmag pham nyes kyis mthar sprod byas/
le'uganyisapa/ b.rama'i skabasagyi byung ba brjod pa/ 23rgyal po 'di'i yab bugarā khyan zhes pa baṅgāl gyi srid skyong yin pa de dmag dbung chen po dang bcas 'thab rgol du yong ba na/ kekabād yang pha'i gdong len byed du dpung dmag shin tu chen po dang bcas 'gro skyong byas/ tha mar pha bu gnyis bar nang 'grig byas/ pha yis gros 'debs byas pa ltar sku drag 'ga' shas gnas spo byas pa'am de tsho la chad pa btang ba sogs byas shing / nga.āl uXn pherodza khyil: zer ba de 'dzin skyong dang drag dpung gi do dam pa'am spyi khyab tu bskos/ de la tuṣka yi sku drag tsho dang / di:'i mi mang sus kyang rgyab skyor ma byas/ de 'dra'i skabs su sulhan naku'ad la grib skyon lta bu phog nas gzugs gzhi mi bde bar gyur/ dmag spyi ja'al uXn phi'oja khol: yis go skabs bzung nas rgyal gar bskyod pa dang / tuka'i sku drag tshos brel tshab kyis na(bād yi sras lo gsum lon pa zhig khri la bkod pa red/'on kyang jalhal usthān gyis de nyid khri las phabs te naku6da bgrongs nas phung po chu bo gamuna'i nang du g.yug tuka'i sku drag tshos kyang mgo btags zhus/ phyo lo 1290lor jalhal u:na phi'oja khil: de nyid disnya'i sulhan gyi khri la 'khod pa dang / bran g.yog rgyal rgyud rdzogs pa red/bran g.yog rgyal po tsho'i rgyal srid de la spyir btang dge mtshan dang skyon cha gnyis ka yod cing / rang gi mnga' ris su gcig gyur brtan cha yong ched sger gzhis ring lugs la shugs snon byung yod/ drag po'i dpung dmag ni gzhung gi lag cha gtso che shos yin pa dang / zhi ba'i 'dzin skyong ni gal shin tu chung / chos lugs la shin tu mgo mkhregs byas pa des mi mang gi bde don la gnod skyon byung bas ma tshad mi dmangs la dka' ngal chen po bzos/ de ltar na yang sar ḍabalayu hig (311gi 5718) mchos/ gis gsungs don bran g.yog rgyal po tsho ni rang gi hoḥ'i mi ser
24 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/tsho'i thog khrims lugs drang la 'gro ba mi'i spyod tshul dang mthun pa yod pas sngar dbyin yul gyi rgyal po noraman las legs shing / sapen dang nidaraleṇḍa yi rgyal po phingapa gnyis pa las bzod bsran che ba yod ces gsungs yod tshod/de tsho'i nang nas rgyal po ha cang yag po gsum byung ba de tsho ni bran g.yog dngos gnas pa yin la/ tuka'i bran g.yog lam lugs des sger gyi yar rgyas la gnod skyon ma byas pa lta bu zhig red/ gang lags zer na bran g.yog tsho'i nang nas kyang shin tu gzi brjod che zhing dpa' mdzangs can gyi rgyal po de rnams byung thub pa red/khong tsho'i nang phan tshun 'gran sdur byed dgos kyi gnas stangs kyis rgyal po tsho rtag tu gzab gzab byas nas sdod/ khong tshos byas rjes che shos gnyis las dang po ni rgya ༷dzā ṭwāṃ phru/ ༷༷ ༷྅nga galhashā lcu ༷pa /pas tu thu lnga/shā dhā/sa su tsho spra ༵ /sa khang bzo'i rig khil: rgyal rgyud/ (phyi lo 129041320)sras lo gsum lon pa rgyal sar bkod pa de the bas/ bran g.yog rgyal po bcu gnyis byung ba'i rjes su di'i'i sulhan gyi khri la khril: rgyal po rnams 'khod pa yin la/khong tsho'i 'byung khungs ni 'ga' shas kyis 'di tsho aphagan gyi rigs yin tshul bshad kyang / de tsho ni tuka'i rigs nges par du yin par the tshom med/ aphaXnistun la helamanta lung pa zer ba zhig yod pa de la khol〉 zhis brjod/ lung pa de la gnas mkhan tshor khyil: pa zhes brjod pa yin/ jalal uXn gyi nang me sngon ma rnams tu'istun nas yong ste der gzhis chags pa'i tuka'i khra rigs yin/ khong tsho'i mi thog sngon ma de tsho 3 lo brgya phrag bcu gcig pa'i nang der gzhis chags pa red/ sngon
le'u gnyis pa/ b.rama'i skabs 9byung ba brjod pa/ 25baṅgāl la dbang sgyur byed mkhan gyi mutasmad khol: de yang 'di tsho'i khongs gtogs yin/ aphaXnistun la gzhis chags nas yun ring song bas khong tshos aphaspyan gyi goms gshis dang lugs srol dang du blangs/ der brten rgya gar du gnas pa'i (rka'i mi drag tsho phyi'i mthong tshul la gaphagan lta bu yod pa yin/kholagrwas dbang sgyur byas pa de la rgya gar 9 kha che tshos dga' po rang byas med tshod/ khol) tshog rgya gar la 'gyur ba gang mtshams btang ba dper na sngar bran g.yog rgyal po tshog brgya phrag gcig tsam ring thabs shes byas kyang de tsho'i mnga' ris 9 skyed byed ma thub par de tsho muhamad lhari yis blangs te gang la dbang sgyur byas pa'i rgya gar yul de gcig gyur bzo rgyu'i las don rang byas pa red/ 'on kyang khol: rgyal po tsho'i dus su rgya gar kha che'i rgyal khams rgya che ba'i mthar gtugs pa red/ kheland+ra'i rgyal po'i dmag spyi lalā.uXn khilaXs kha che'i rgyal khams rgya skyed byas pas ma tshad hend+ra'i dbang shugs kyang gtor ba red/ des ma tshad chab srid 'dzin skyong la gzhi rgya che ba'i sgyur bcos btang nas rgya gar gyi kha che tsho yang de dang mnyam sbrel byas/ rgyal po 'di tshos rgyal srid 'dzugs skrun gcig pā ma yin par rgya skyed mu mthud byas pa dang /gzhung lugs dang shes yon la las don rgya che byas yod pa red/jalhal uXn khril〉 des rang gi 'jon thang la brten nas khri la 'khod pa yin zhing / drag po'i stobs shugs kyis srid dbang bsgyur ba red/ khong ni kha che'i chos kyi 'go khrid tsho dang mi mang su las kyang rgyab skyor thob thabs byas med/ de tsho ni sku drag tsho la yang rag ma lus par ma zad 'dzam gling gi kha che'i rgyal tshab kharsāshās ngos len byas min la'ang ltos pa med/ khong tshos bsam par rgyal khab dang de'i 'dzin skyong mpi sulhan gyi dbang shugs 'ba' zhig la brten pa yin pas de ni chos phyoḍa kyi rgyab
26 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/skyor sogs su la rag lus pa min par 'dod/4āl usnrin pherodza shāha khyil:/ (phyi lo 129041296)gong du bshad pa ltar b.laban gyi tsha bo naku6da zhes pa'i bran g.yog rgyal rgyud kyi rgyal po shin tu mi 'jon pa de la grib nad phog skabs de'i sras lo gsum lon pa zhig rgyal gar bkod kyang / drag po'i spyi khyab nga.āl uXn gyis de khri las phabs te yab rgyal po bgrongs nas dmag spyi rang nyid phyi lo 1290 lor phyi rla 6 ches 13nyin dirsā'i sulhan du 'khod/ de dus nga.āl utrun de nyid dgung lo bdun rtsu yin pa red/ khong ni mi shin tu gshis ka bzang po zhig yin la lo na dang bstun pas bsam blo gtong tshul zhi 'jam can zhig yod pa red/ khong gis rang gi 'gal zla tsho la 'jam po yod par ma zad khrims 'gal nyes can tsho la yang 'jam po gnang mkhan zhig yod 'dug 'phrog bcom pa tshos rgya gar gyi byung rabs nang thog mar skabs 'dir rgyal por mgo bsgur zhus pa na de tsho la yang chad pa drag po btang med/ khong gis gzhan las rnam par rgyal ba'i srid byus rtsub po cher byas med kyang sog po'i btsan rgol ba rnams pham par byas/ sog po'i jag dmag mang pos mgo btags zhus nas kha che'i chos su zhugs/ de tsho kha che'i chos su zhugs rjes de tsho dirsā'i nye 'gram du gnas chags su bcug nas de tsho la zhi bde mthun 'brel byas/ 'on kyang de ltar byas pa de mtha' bzang po byung med de sog po de tsho la kha che gsar pa zhes pa'i ming thog cing de tshos rjes su khra ring bar rgyal khams la dka' ngal bzos/ 4āl uXn lta bu'i kha che chos byed pas so so'i rgan po'i mi 3 de zhi bde dang gzhan phan gyi ngang du skyel ba las gzhan gyi 'dod pa byas med/
le'u gnyis pa/ b.rama'i skabs gyigrang ba brjod pa/ 27rgyal po 'di'i ring la ya yud che zhing snying stobs che ba'i dpung skyod gnyis byas yod pa ni rgyal po'i tsha bo dang sras mo'i mag pa gnyis ka yin pa'i galā.uXn zhes pa de'i 'go khrid 'og byas pa zhig red/ a.ā.uXn zhes pa de skabs der i.āhāshād mnga' khul gyi srid skyong red/skabs 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni/ kha che'i lugs srol la so so'i spyan 'jag dang so so'i sring mo'i bu dang bu mo rnams phan tshun bza' mi byed chog pa yin pas pha spun dang ma spun yin pa'i bu dang bu mo phan tshun bza' mi byed srol yod/ pha ma gcig pa'i spun nye min tsam ma gtogs nye 'brel nang phan tshun gnyen byed srol 'dug pas lugs srol 'di ni ya mtshan po zhig yin/ kha che tsam ma yin par rgya gar lho phyogs kyi sa cha 'ga' shas la yang lugs srol 'di yod pa yin/ byas tsang rgyal po 'di'i sras mo'i khyo ga a.ā.usthān zhes pa de rgyal po rang gi spun nye zhig gi bu yin pas tsha bo yang yin pa red/galā.u②na gyi dbung skyod dang po ni/ sprulasā zer ba'i sa khul du drag dbung gis 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / de rjes delhagiri la yudaba'i rgyal po tsho pham par byas shing sa gnas de gnyis ka las 'phrog bcom byas pa'i dngos zog shin tu mang po thob pa red/ 〉lasā la dbung skyod byed pa'i skor rang gi rgyal po la bka' skor zhus kyang /delhagiri la ni rgyal po la ma zhus par kho rang gis thag bcad nas dbung skyod byas pa red/ der brten sa cha dang po de las 'phrog bcom byas pa'i dngos zog gi cha shas gcig rgyal po la phul yod kyang / sa cha rjes ma las 'phrog pa'i rgyu nor rnams su la'ang bgo bsha' byed 'dod ma byung ba red/ de lta na yang khos rang gi rgyal po la bris don/ bka' khrol ma zhus par delhagiri la dpung rgol byas par bzod bzhes
28 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/yod pa dang / 'phrog bcom byas pa'i dngos regs bzhes ched rgyal po rang nyid dngos su kho'i gar phebs dgos tshul 'khod yod pa red/ rgyal pos de lta bu mi rung ba'i bya spyod zhal bzhes ma gnang yang / khong i.āhāhād yi nye 'gram kunā zer sar galā.usprin dang phrad du phebs pa red/ 'on kyang rgyal po rang gi bu mo'i zla bo bslu brid mkhan des rgyal po bkrongs te/ de ga'i nyin mo rang la kho rang snyad sulhan du dril thabalnga/nga/'a5 (smathag/de nas a.ā.usthān rang nyid brtan po bzo dgos pa byung ste/ rgyal sa dosmyu de da dung yang kho'i dbang du ma 'dus/ kho'i rgyug mo ste chung ma'i a mas rang gi sras chung ba zhig khri la bkod/ a.ā.usthān gyis 'tshor snang gi sgo nas dermā'i phyogs su dpung skyod byas pa'i lam du khos sngon ma delhagiri nas phrogs pa'i rgyu nor rnams bgo 'grems byas pas kho la dmag mi mang po byung thub/ de la brten nas khos rang gi chung ma'i ming po rgyal por gyur pa de rtsa med btang thub pa byung / khos ya nga snying rje med par rgyal po gzhon nu de dang ldog phyogs pa gzhan tshang ma rtsa med du btang / mthar kho rang nyid kyis 1296 lor ṇḍasnyi dbang 'og tu bsdus pa red/galā.u:na de nyid ༷rā'i srid skyong yin pa'i skabs nas di'i'i sulhan yong ba'i rmo lam rtag par gtong gi yod pa red/ kho rgyal por 'gyur ba la rgyu nor ram dpal 'byor chen po dang / phyogs gtogs rjes 'jug pa shin tu mang po dang / stobs shugs chen po dgos pa'i bsam blo byung / bsam tshul de la brten nas khos sprulasā la dpung rgol 'phrog bcom byas shing / lho phyogs delhagiri la btsan rgol byas te dpal 'byor (spra ༵༵༵༵ rgyu~X ༵ (dpa/ dngakho /'i 'a~X gaXgod zlo ṇā skyo sprad ba snapa ndha depo sbyo (( spya shā kho rgyal sa dirsā'i phyogs su bskyod/ phyi lo 1296 lor sulhan gyi khri la 'khod/
le'u gnyisapa/ bar ma'i skabs 9byung babarjod pa/ 29a.ā.usthān khyilagrwa/ (phyi lo 129641316)a.ā.udīn ni sulhan dzalāl usthān gyi spun rshahāb usthān maswād yi bu yin zhing /sulhan gyi sras mo zhig kho dang mdun thabs su sprad/ nye 'brel gyi gnas stangs de la brten nas 4āl usthān gyis rang gi dgra rnams kyi mgo mnan nas ༷rā la sred skyong du 'khod/ khrilashrī'i sku drag tsho sulhan 4āl uXn gyi zhi bde'i srid byus la ma dga' bas galā.usthān la rgyal po'i khrir bzung datog pa'i ngan skul byas pas ma tshad a.ā.u sprin gyi nang gi mi tsho de yang dka' ngal bzod dka'i rang bzhin zhig ste/ chung ma de nga rgyal che zhing rgyug mo ste chung ma'i a ma de rgyag res tsha la skyon 'dogs 'ba' zhig byed mkhan zhig yod pa red/ der brten kho'i sger gyi mi che de skyid po ma byung ba dang /de la brten nas 'jig rten 'di'i go gnas dang dbang shugs thob ched 'bad brtson bya dgos byung / phyi lo 1292 la khog sprulasā dang / 1296 lor delhagiri dbang sgyur byas te btsan 'phrog byas pa'i dngos zog srid na rin thang bral ba chen po thob pa des dersā'i khri 'dzin par phan thogs chen po byung /dka' rnyog khag galā.udzñān rang nyid sulhan du gyur kyang kho'i gnas stangs brtan po med par nyen kha che ba zhig yod pa red/ khong rang nyid so so'i mi mang tsho'i nang du dga' mos can zhig min te/ khos rang gi a khu bkrongs pa de ni rgyal po zhi bde gu yangs la dga' ba zhig yin pas de bkrongs pa la mi mang tshos dga' po ma byung tshod/ sku drag mang po zhig blo yid ma tshoms pas de tshos kho la 'jigs snang ga dus kyang bskul srid/ māla'i dang / bukhulakhanya sogs la rlang5ta'i dbang 'dzin pa mang po zhig yod pa de tshog kho la ngo rgol byed sred/ gungarwata dang / lho phyogs kyi yul lung yongs rdzogs kha che'i dbang shugs kyis khyab med/ der ma zad a.ā.urdzun
30 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/la sog po'i drag dmag gi nyen kha la gdong len bya dgos pa byung /'olā.usthān gyis gong gsal dka' ngal rnams gdong len mthar phyin byas te/sku drag ngo rgol byed mkhan tshang ma ya nga snying rje med par rtsa med du btang ba dang /thag ring gi mnga' khul rnams so so'i 'og tu bsdus nas 'dzin skyong brtan po btsugs/yul du zhi bde dang khrims lugs bskyar gso byas par ma zad phye rgyal dpung 'jug las bskyabs te mnga' ris rgya skyed byas/ rgya gar lho phyogs yongs rdzogs la drag pos 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / de tsho rang gi mnga' khongs su bsdus pa red/ der brten khos khrilagrwa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs lag len du bstar nas srid dbang gcig spyod kyi lugs srol de mtha' rtser son pa byung /galā.usthān de mes po b.laban ltar rgyal po btsan po zhig yin la/ kho rang nyid 'dod pa che zhing snying rje med la slu brid can zhig dang / spyod lam ngan pa zhig red/ kho la re 'dod chen po yod pa des mnga' ris rgya skyed byed thub pa byung zhing /khos rgya gar phyed gling yongs rdzogs la dngos shugs gang rung gis dbang sgrur ba'i 'bad brtson byas pa red/a.ā.usnrin gyis thog mar gujarātra'i mnga' khul la dpung rgol byas shing / de skabs sa khul de kurshadewa zhes pa'i rgyal po'i 'og tu yod pa red/ phyo lo 1297lor gungashāta la dbung 'jug byas pas kurshadewa de delhagiri la bros pa na de'i rjes su ded de btsun mo kumaludenywa zer ba de 'dzin bzung gis rjes su a.ā.u:na gyi btsun mor gyur/ somanātha zhes pa'i lha khang rtsa chen de gtor bshig byas/ shin tu grags che ba'i bran g.yog 1phyur zhes pa de yang de nas nyos pa sogs byas nas dngos zog gya nom pa 'phrog bcom byas/ mnga' khul de kha che'i srid skyong gi 'og tu bzhag
le'uganyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung babarjod pa/ 31phyo lo 1301 lor ra9thalhar gyi cohān rgyal sras rāX dharmāradewa zer ba des a.ā.uXn gyi btsan rgol gyi gnas su gyur pa red/ gang lags zhe na des sog po'i ngo log pa rnams la skyabs sprad yod tshul bsnyad pa red/ gang ltar galā.uXn gyis dpung rgol byas te ragathalhar dbang du bsdus/ phyi lo 1303 lor meltar gyi rgyal sa citor gyi mtha' bskor nas de ga'i rgyal po rāX ratnasitapham par byas pa na btsun mo padma can (pasmini )sogs rā46ta'i bud med mang pos rang gi che mthong srung skyob ched mer mchongs nas ñtsha las 'dag/ rgya gar du grags pa'i gtam rgyud nang skabs 'di tshor rā46ta'i rgyal po tsho kha che'i dpung rgol gyi gdong len ched du phyin pa na bud med tshos de tsho bsgug sdod bzhin yod cing / gal te rgyal po tsho dmago sar shi ba'am pham pa'i gnas tshul thos 'phral bud med tshos dang len gyis me la sdeb mchongs byed/ rgyu mtshan ni rang gi khyo ga dgra las pham rjes rang nyid kha che kla klo'i lag par mi bslebs pa dang / rang gi che mthong srung skyob bya ched yin/myalanywa'i sa khul de di:'i rgyal pos thengs mang por 'phrog bcom byas yo da kyang sus kyang da bar sa khul de dbang (1ga tu bsdus med/ 'on kyang phyo lo 1305lor myalalnga'i sa khul de yang dosmyu'i sulhan 'og tu bcuga.ā.usthān gyis lho phyogs su dpung skyod/rgya gar lho phyogs kyi lha khang rnams ni nor dang longs spyod kyis shin tu phyug pa yin pa de thob pa'i don du a.ā.uXn gyis lho phyogs su dpung dmag btang ba dang /de yang kho'i drag po'i spyi khyab ༷phur zer ba sngar kho'i bran g.yog yin pa phyis su rgyal khams kyi dpon rigs che shos gnyis par bskos pa de'i 'go khrid 'og phyin pa red/
32 'phags yul9byungababarjodapa/de dus 'phags yul lho phyogs 'dir rgyal khams bzhi yod pa dper na ltadawa dang / kṣatrig dang / togasāl dang / pā:ya bcas red/ de tsho nang phan tshun 'thab 'dzing rgyun du byed bzhin pas byang phyogs kyi kha che'i btsan rgol ba la khe bzang chen po byung ba red/1 delhagiri la btsan rgol/ phyi lo 1304 lor delhagiri'i rgyal po rāmacadredewa ādawa dang / galā.uXn gnyis bar mos mthun byung don a.ā.usthān la lo ltar lo khral 'bul rgyu yin yang / 1305 dang 1306 lor re ltar 'bul ma thub pas lalā.uXn gyis rang gi dmag spyi kā:ra dpung dang bcas pa btang nas 1307 lor yudawa'i rgyal po rlamatsand+ra dmag sar pham/ de rjes zhi mthun gyi grogs por gyur nas 1phur lho phyogs su dpung 'jug byed par dpung rogs zhus/2 lharaṅgal la dbung rgol/ galā.uXn gyis yang bskyar phyi lo 1310 lor malika kāgur lho phyogs su btang / skabs 'dir kho lharaṅgal gyi kṣatriya'i rgyal po 53parudra la chad pa gcod du phyin/ des galā.usthān gyi mnga' khongs su khas blangs te lo rer glang chen brgya re dang / rta bdun brgya re dang / gzhan yang dngos zog gi skyes 'bul rgyur mos mthun byas/3 togasāla'i rgyal khams la dbung rgol/ ma4ka 1phur de nyid waraṅgal nas log ma thag galā.usnrin gyis kho la rgya ga'aci lho phyogs kyi mtha' rtser dpung rgol byed du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba red/ phyo lo 1311 lor paphur de drag po'i dpung dang bcas lho phyogs hoyasāla'i rgyal sa 〉ra samudra la phyin te de ga'i rgyal po spuralhalnga gsum pa pham par byas te des kyang kha che'i mnga' khongs su khas blangs nas lo 'khor khral skyes dang / glang chen dang rta sogs 'bul rgyu khas blangs pas
le'u gnyisapa/ b.rama'i skabs gyi byung ba brjodapa/ 33ma tshad da dung lho mtha'i rgyal khams pā:yan rgyal khab la dpung rgol bya ched khos kuphur la rogs ram byed rgyu yang khas blangs/4 5nyagan rgyal khams la btsan rgol/ de dus lho phyogs pāñtsayan gyi khri 'dzin ched du rgyal sras gnyis phan tshun 'dzing bzhin par kā(ra gyis de gar kha che'i srung dmag bzhag de nas lho mthar phyin te rwameshār la kha che'i mchod khang brtsigs pa sogs byas te slar log pāñtsayan dang hoyasāla'i rgyal khams gnyis nas rgyu nor tshod med khyer nas disnya la yong ba red/ de'i rjes su yang dewaṇḍari la zing snyog byung bas phyi lo 1313 lor malika kāswār lho phyogs su bskyod pa de khos lho phyogs su dpung rgol byas pa tha ma de red/de ltar a.ā.urdzun gyis lho phyogs su dpung 'jug gis g.yul rgyal gyi bya ba byas pa de ha cang cha tshang ba dang brtan po zhig ma yin par ༷phur gyis gang la dpung rgol gyis dbang du bsdus pa'i skabs de la tshul mthun gyis mgo 'bul gyi sgo nas mnga' 'og tu khas blangs pa dang lo khral skyes 'bul bya dgos pa'i tha tshog tsam 'jog gi yod pa red/ don dngos po'i thog mnga' khul de tshor 'dzin skyong tshul bzhin bya ched thabs shes gang yang byas med tshod/ a.ā.usnrin gyi mnga' ris de gungarwata nas sirnyu dang panāb bcas nub phyogs dang / shar phyogs su baṅgāl dang / lho phyogs su yang spyir btang phyed gling yongs rdzogs 'dus yod pa de'i phyir shin tu rgya che ba'i mnga' ris de la don dam 9 dbang sgyur legs po ma byung ba dang / de la brten nas galā.uXn shi ma thag mnga' rig nyams rgud du gyur pa red/sog pos dpung 'jug a.ā.usnrun la sog po'i btsan rgol la gdong len bya dgos byung zhing / sog po'i dpung rgol de ni dus rtag tu dka' ngal tshab che ba zhig
34 'phagasayul thu byung babarjod pa/yin/ rgya gar gyi nub dang byang gi sa mtshams nas sog po'i 'jigs pa rgyun du yod dang yod bzhin pa la/ 'on kyang de tsho'i dbu khrid ca346na grongs pa'i rjes su khong tsho stobs chung du phyin yod/ a.ā.usnrin gyi rgyal srid ring sog po'i btsan rgol khyon bsdomaraltathengs lnga byung ba yin la/ btsan rgol lnga pa'am tha ma de phyi lo 130741308 lor byung zhing de la yang gdong len mthar phyin byas te mthar sprod btang ba red/ de'i rjes rgyal khab kyi sa mtshams su zhi bde lteng 'jags byung zhing sa mtshams srung skyob brtan po byas yod pa red/'olā.usthān gyis nang srid 'dzin tshul/ nang gi srid don gyi cha nas kyang 'alā.uXn gyis dka' ngal sna tshogs gdong len bya dgos byung ba red/ kho yi nye skor du mi bzang ngan sna tshogs yod pa dang / kha che'i phyug po armār zer ba'i sku drag tsho dang / btsun mo'i gtso mo khag rgyal po'i ngo rgol ched lag sbrel byas pa dang / chang rag la bed spyod shin twā shugs chen po byas pa sogs ni nyen kha che ba zhig red/ der brten de dag gi ched du srid byug drag rtsub can lag len du bltar te sku drag tsho las sa gzhis gzhung bzhes byas pa dang / chang rag la dam bsgrags byas pas ma tshad rgyal po'i bka' grol med par spyi tshogs kyi las rim la yang sku drag nang phan tshun thug phrad mi chog pa bzos/ rgyal po 'dis kha che'i bla mang ma chos ston pa tsho la'ang yid ches chen po ma byas/ hi('i chos byed pa dang rgya gar gyi chos byed mkhan tsho la ni de bas kyang gdug rtsub che snye/ kha che lasanagazhan pa'i chos lugs la mi dga' zhing gzhan la dpal 'byor yod na yang mi dga' ba byas/ de rnams mdo gnon ched gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs dam po bzos shing / der brten dma' rim mi mang nang tsam du ma zad mtho rim gzhung zhabs pa tsho'i bar phan tshun gleng mol byed par 'jigs
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs 9byung ba brjodapa/ 35snang byed cing gzab gzab byed kyi yod 'dugkhral rigs/ galā.uXn gyis sa zhing thon bskyed kyi phyed ka khral bsdu gi yod pa dang / sa zhing gi tshad rnams la gzhi byas te thon skyed dang / khral rigs gtan 'bebs byed srol yod cing / kha che'i rgyal po tsho'i nang nas yar thon can gyi khral len tshul ngo sprod byed mkhan dang po de yin zhing / khos khral rigs de dngul thog nas len pa las dngos po len par gal cher bcas/ khos ba phyug gi 'o ma la yang khral brgyabs/ hoḥ'i chos byed pa tsho la khang pa'i khral yang brgyabs/ der ma zad hirā'i tshong pa tsho la tshong zog thog brgya cha bcu khral yod la/ kha che'i tshong pa tshos brgya cha lnga las sprod mi dgos/ der brten rgyal yongs khral 'bab nang cha shas mang che ba hiḥ tsho ༷dhi ༷༷ (shā da da/ mag a.ā.usthān gyi sred de ni drag po'i gzhung lta bu zhig yin pa dang mnga' ris shin hu rgya che bsag dbung dmag hāg po dang 'jon po dgos pa ni gal che'i gnas su gyur/ khos dpung dmag la legs bcos dang / dmag mi tsho la go lag yag po sprad pa dang / sbyong brdar yang yag po sprad par rma zad dmag mi gsar pa mang po gsar du btsug sbyong brdar legs po yod pa'i dmag dpon rnams spyi khyab tu bskos/ rta dmag yar rgyas gtong ched rgyal po rang nyid kyis yang yang dbu khrid gnang / rgyal po'i srid gzhung gi 'gro gron ma dkrul nas dmag mi tsho la dngul phogs sprod kyi yod pa red/sngar b.laban gyis byang nub kyi sa mtshams khag tu rdzong brtsigs pa rnams skabs 'dir nyams gso byas pas ma tshad rdzong gsar pa mang po yang bzhengs nas de tsho'i nang drag dmag gtan 'jags bzhag ste de tshor go rbha/tshor dang za chas sogs kyi
36 'phags yul9 byung ba brgyud pa/mkho sprod rgyun ma chad par byas pa red/khrom gyi sgrig khrims/ galā.usnrin la drag po'i dpung dmag shin tu chen po dgos pa dang / de yi ched du dngul yang shin tu mang po dgos pa byung bas khos drag po'i 'gro gron nyung du gtong ba'i thabs shes byas/ dmag khra re re'i phogs rshakā 234re gtan 'bebs byas/ dmag mi tsho'i phogs spar ma thub pas 'tsho ba'i gnad gong chung du gtong ched khrem gyi dngos zog rnams kyi rin gong 'phar mi thub pa'i thabs shes byas/ rgyal pos dngos zog tshang ma'i rin gong gtan 'bebs byas shing khrom gyi do dam pa shahanāyamaX zhes pa zhig kyang bskos nas des rgyal po'i bka' rnams lag len du bstar/ tshong pa tshang mas khrom gyi do dam pa'i las khungs su deb skyel byed dgos/do dam pa des khrom du nyo tshong dang gnas tshul kun la lta rtogs byed/ gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rin gong las 'das pa'i nyo tshong sus kyang byed mi chog 'gru rigs gsog 'jog byed pa de srid gzhung rkyang pa'i dbang cha yin/ tshong khang tshang mas so sor dngos zog ga re yod min dang / de tsho'i rin gong gi tho tshong khang du 'jog dgos/rgyal po'i bka' las 'da' bar byed mkhan su la'ang chad pa drag pos bcad/ gal srid tshong pa zhig gis nyo ba po la nya ga'i tshad 'jal tshul la mgo skor btang ba yin na dngos po'i ljid tshad ga tshod mang nyung btang ba de'i tshad tsam gyi sha tshong pa'i lus las gcod par byed/ de dag la brten nas 'tsho ba'i gnad gong chung du gtong thub pa dang / drag po'i dpung dmag chen po rgyun ldan du 'jog thub pa byung zhing / de'i ched du rgyal po'i bang mdzod la gnon smyud ha cang chen po 'gel dgos ma byung /a.ā.usthān gyi mi che'i tha ma/ galā.u:na gyi rgyal srid de 3 lo 1312lor mtho ba'i mtha' rtser bslebs shing / de lta na yang de rjes 'gyur ba chen po zhig
le'u gnyis pa/ bar mang skabasakyi byung ba brjod pa/ 37byung / kho'i 'dod yon ha cang che ba dang / drag po'i las don ha cang mang drag pa'i rkyen gyis 'phrod bsten sdug tu phyin par ma zad kho rang gi btsun mo dang phru swā tshos do snang ma byas/ mkhraka ༷phur gyi lag par a lad pad ko lta bu'i rtsed chas su gyur zhing / kāhār gyi g.yo rgyus rgyal po'i khrims ra dang / btsun mo'i grong gi gnas stangs sdug po dang / g.yo rgyu khram gsum gyis khengs pa lta bur gyur pa red/ phyi lo 1316 lor lalā.uXn 3 las 'das shing / spyir btang ༷phur gyis kho la dug sprad nas bkrongs pa yin pa'i dogs pa byed/mtha' bsdoms/ galā.usthān zhes pa'i rgyal po de ni kho'i dus rabs su mi mkhregs po khyad mtshar ba zhig red/ kho'i rang bzhin ni shin tu rtsub po yod pa dang /gtong phod dang / snying rje dang / bzod pa sogs dge ba'i yon tan gcig kyang med la/ grogs po dang dgra bo sogs sus kyang kho las nying rje'i re ba gtan nas byed sa med pa zhig red/ de la brten nas kho la grub 'bras lam lhong sogs ga re byung ba tshang ma kho rang la thim pa lta bur gyur pa dang / kho'i stobs shugs la yar rgyas gtong ba'i srid byus de ni khrag sbyor gyi srid byus shig yin par brten kho rang ma shi gong so so'i mig lam du rgyal srid thog ldab 'gro bzhin pa de mthong yang 'u thug thabs zad du gyur pa red/rgyal po 'di'i rgyal srid las gal che'i gnad don gnyis byung ba dang po ni/khos 'phags yul lho phyogs kyi sa khul yang kha che'i rgyal khams kyi mnga' ris khongs su btsug pa de yin zhing / gnyis pa ni khos chab srid 'dzin skyong gi thabs tshul mang po tuka'i rgyal po'i chab srid dang sbrel ba des yun ring drag po'i chab srid la phan thogs byung yod pa yin/ rgyal po 'des kha che'i chos byed pa rnams srid don las phyir
38 'phags yulagyi grang ba brjod pa/'bud byed mkhan kha che'i rgyal po dang po yin/ khos chab srid 'dzin skyong gi stobs shugs gcig sgril byas pa dang / chos lugs la gzhi byas pa'i sred byus med pa bzos te chos lugs la mi brten pa'i srol gtod pa'i kha che'i rgyal po thog ma yang yin/der brten yul du zhi bde smyung 'jigs byung ba dang / kho'i rgyal srid ring dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa yod/galā.uXn de nyid phal cher slob sbyong med pa zhig yin tshod/ de lta na yang gzhung lugs la do snang yod 'dug ste armār khusaro sogs kha che'i mkhas pa rnams la sbyin bdag zhus 'dug khos mkhar legs po mang po yang bzhengs pa dang / kha che'i mchod khang yang bzhengs 'dug pa 'ga' shas deng sang yang desnyi la yod/rshahāb usthān umar/sulhan lalā.usnrin khyilaX shi ba'i nyi ma gnyis rjes mkhraka 'phrur gyis rgyal po'i sras chung shos shiyab usthān umar zhes pa de khri la bkod/ des ma(rika hāphyur de nyid dngos don gyi dbang sgyur bar gyur par phan thogs chen po byung / 'on kyang nyi ma sum rtsu so lnga'i nang kho la mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi khrims 'gal bya spyod byas rkyen srog gi chad pa phog phyi lo 1316 phyi zla bzhi pa'i nang na tshod ma longs pa'i rgyal po gzhon nu de'i mig med par bzos/ de nas galā.uXn gyi sras gsum pa ku6bucan myabāraka shāha zer ba de khri la 'khod/kutabuXn mursāraka shāha/ (3 lo 131641320)myabāraka shāha yis kho'i pha yis bka' tsha bo de tsho phyir bsdu byas shing / srid don gyi btson pa tshang ma glod dkrol btang / chab srid 'dzin skyong thad gu yang btang
le'uganyisapa/ b.rama'i skabs kyibyung ba brjod pa/ 39ba des khrims lugs la gnod skyon du gyur/ rgyal po rang nyid 'dod yon la dga' bder spyad pa des gnas stangs da dung sdug tu phyin pas ma tshad kho rang nyid blon po khusaro zer ba'i dbang shugs 'og tu tshud/ khugaro zer ba de hoḥ'i chos lugs pa rigs ngan zhig yin pa de phyis su kha cher gyur pa zhig red/myabāraka shāha'i rgyal srid ring sog pos btsan rgol ma byung yang / delhagiri'i ngo log byas pa mgo gnon ched lho phyogs su 'gro dgos byung / rgyal po 'di lho phyogs su bskyod de delhagiri'i rgyal po 'dzin bzung gis bsad/ de nas rgyal pos khusaro de lho phyogs mdurā la btang / khusaro yis mdurā las 'phrog bcom byas pa'i dngos rigs 'bor chen bsdus pa dang / phyir log skabs lngaraṅgal nas dpal 'byor chen po bsdus/ kho rgyal sa la log pa na kho rang gi rigs gcig pa yin pa'i mtshon ldan dmag mi 'bor chen gyis bskor nas bsdad/ mi mang pos rgyal po la nyen brda btang yang khusaro'i skor gang yang ma gsan/ 3 lo 1320 lor khusaro yis rgyal po bsad nas rang nyid kyis rgyal sa bzung ste ming la nusir usthān khusaro shāha zhes grags/nusir usthān khugaro shāha/sngar bshad pa ltar nusir u:na khusaro shāha ni hiḥ rigs ngan kha cher gyur pa dang / myabāraka shuha'i blon por gyur pa zhig yin zhing des rgyal po bkrongs nas rang gis rgyal sa bzung ba zhig red/ khos rang gi rigs rgyud rnams la khe phan chen po byas pa red/ rgyal po'i khrims ra'i nang du sku 'dra la mchod pa byed mkhan la dga' po yod tshod/ ches mtho'i gzhung zhabs pa dang sku drag mang pos de la mi dga' ba byung ba dang / dngos shugs gnyis brgyud nas rgyal po de la ma dga' ba chen po byung /
40 'phags yula' byung babarjod pa/phyi lo 1320 lor 19 malika zhis pa sa gnas dilabarapur gyi srid skyong yin pa des rgyal po khusaro pham par byas te ṣṭi bregs/ 'on kyang des de ma thag rgyal sa ma bzung /sku drag tshos kho la rgyal srid 'dzin dgos pa'i skul ma yang yang byas par brten 19 malika gis srid bzung nas rgya gar gyi rgyal por gyur te kho'i ming la gaXsu:na tugalaka gsol ba red/ de dang chabs cig rgyal rgyud gsar pa zhig byung ba red/tugalaka rgyal rgyud/sngar bshad pa ltar khrilanga'i rgyal rgyud tha ma khusaro tshon des nyisnru tsho la phan thogs byas pa de'i grub 'bras su kha che'i chos la mkhregs bzung byed mkhan 19 mamaka tugalaka zer bas phyi lo 1320 lor rgyal po bsad de rgyal rgyud gsar pa zhig btsugs pa red/ rgyal rgyud 'dis phal cher lo brgya tsam di'i'i sulhan gyi rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ spyir btang tugalaka zhes pa de sger gyi ming yin pa las mi rigs dang nang mi'i ming ma yin na yang rgyal rgyud 'di'i rgyal po tshang ma la tugalaka zhes brjod srol byung /gaXsuXn tugalaka (phyi lo 1321—1325)rgyal po 'di ni tuka'i mi rigs yin la/ b.laban gyi bran g.yog gcig dang panāb kyi hāṭa skyes dman gnyis 'dus pa'i bu zhig yin tsang kho tuka'i stobs zhuḍa dang pajajuba'i hortsa'i gshis ka 'jam po gnyis tshoḍa shig yin par bshad/ sngar galā.uXn gyi rgyal srid skabs sog po'i dbung dmag la gdong len byas pas rgyal po 'di skad grags chen po byung / khog rgyal po'i khri bzung skabs kho lo na mtho tsam dang / nyams myong can gyi dpa' bo zhig yin pa red/ khos sa zhing dang las don gang thad gzhung
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 41zhabs rnying pa tsho dang bsnun mkhas byas/galtasuXn tugalaka yi 'dzin skyong / gnāsu:na gyis chab srid 'dzin skyong thad ya yud che ba'i sgyur bcos gsar pa gang yang btang med kyang / 'dzin skyong tshags tshud yag po zhig gi srol gtod yod/ de ni khrims mthun dang cha snyom la gzhi byas pa zhig yin zhing / khong gis mi mang gi bde don yar rgyas su gtong 'dod pa las byung ba zhig red/ sa zhing gi khral gyi srid byur/ des kho'i yul zhin che ba de shes nus/ kho'i sngon gyi sulhan mursāraka dang / khusaro gnyis kyis 'gro gron lhag par che zhing cha ma snyoms pa des rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor nyams rgyud du btang / der brten garngasu:na tugalaka yis gzhis ka tshang ma la zhib gsher tsha po byas shing khrims mthun ma yin pa'i sa gzhis sogs tshang ma gzhung bzhes gnang bas ma tshad sa zhing gi khral bsdu tshul sngar yod de med par bzos nas khral sdud mkhan gzhung zhabs pa rnams la do dam byas/ rgyal po 'dis gzhung khral yang du btang smi sa zhing thon skyed ayau bcu cha gcig gam yang na bcu gcig gi cha gcig gtan 'bebs byas/ kho'i bsam tshul la gzhung la yong 'bab mang du gtong ba de mi mang la khral 'bor mang du gtong rgyu de ma yin par thon skyed mang du gtong ba la rag lus pa yin/ khral gyi skor nyes 'dzol byed mkhan tsho la yang snying rje'i sgo nas bzod pa bzhes shing / zhing chu 'dren ched yur ba khag brkos pa dang / grum ra dang skyed tshal gsar 'dzugs byas pa dang /bsil grib yong ched nags tshal 'dzugs par byas/ sa cha stong pa gang mang bed spyad de zhing sa gang mang rgya skyed byas/ 'dzin skyong gi sde tshan gzhan khag la yang legs bcos sna tshogs byas pa dper na 'grim 'grul legs su btang ste yul gyi sbrag zam gyi las don gsar 'dzugs byas pa dang / dbul 'phongs rnams la rogs ram skyob
42 'phagasayulagyi4ngababarjod pa/gso'i thabs tshul lag len du bstar/ khrims khang dang skor srung ba'i 'dzugs skrun byas te gzhung bun bsdu len gyi skor mnar gcod byed mi chog pa bzos/ dmag mi'i sde tshan de yang tshags ngatshud byas te sgrig lam tsha po bzos nas dpon rigs sam dmag dkyusasus kyang gzhungal ma drang pa mi byed pa'i ched du thabs tshul mang po bzos/lharadran5 btul ba/ sngon galā.uXn gyi skabs lho khul gyi sa gnas waradral de kho'i mnga' risasu gtogs kyang / de ga'i rgyal po grahāpa rudradewa zhes pa des gaXsuXn gyi dbang 'og yin par khas ma blangs pas spru lo 1321 lor sulhan gyi sras rgan pa 64khyan lho phyogs su de mgo ba/non du btang yang lam lhong ma byung bar phyir log byas/ de nas 1323 lor yang bskyar drag dpung rgya che dang bcas lho phyogs su bskyod de 56pa rudradewa pham par byas te 'dzin bzung byas/ telaXnā'i khul tshang ma dbang du bsdus te kha che'i dpon rigs bzhag pa bcas warasgal de dirsā'i sulhan gyi mnga' 'bangs su gyur/baṅgāl btul ba/ baṅgāl gyi khul de ba2dur khyan zhes pa'i 'go khrid 'og rang dbang rang btsan du gyur yod pa yin la/ de bzhin gnas tshul 'ga' zhig gis rkyen pas sulhan rang nyid drag po'i dpung rgya che dang bcas baṅgāl la phyin nas de ga'i rgyal po ba〉dur slon pham par byas te 'dzin bzung byas te baṅgāl dbang 'og tu bsgyur/ phyo lo 1324 lor sog po'i btsan 'dzul ba rnams kyang pham par byas/gaXsu:na che las 'das pa/ rgyal po delngi'i phyi logs su phyin pa'i ring kho rang gi bu che bas rgyal srid phrog pa'i gra sgrig cha tshang byas yod tshod la/ rgyal po baṅgāl nas phyir log phebs skabs dirsā'i nye 'gram du dga' bsu rgya chen po zhig byas pa red/baṅgāl nas khrid yong ba'i glang chen rnams sulhan rgyal po'i drung du phul ba na gur yol
le'u gnyisapa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 43thog rdob kyis sulhan galtasuXn rdab skyon gyis shi ba red/ gur yol thog ldab byung ba de rkyen chags glo bur du byung bar 'ga' shas kyis bshad kyang / 'ga' shas kyis sngon nas byus ngan bsham pa yin tshul 'dod pa yin/ yang 'ga' shas kyis grur yol steng la thog lhung bas gur yol gyi bkod pa tshang ma lhung brdibs su gyur nas gtor zhig tu gyur pa yin zhes bshad tshul 'dugmuhamad bīn tugalaka (phyi lo 132541351)galhasu:na tugalaka gi rjes su kho'i bu rgyal sras snrunālān de khri la 'khod cing /de dang kho'i yab gnyis bar 'das pa'i zla ba 'ga' shas ring 'brel ba yag po ma byung bar phan tshun sdang dgra'i ngang gnas/ rgyurngakhyan 'di snyad rgyal por 'khod rjes muhamad bīn tugalaka zhes pa'i ming yongs su grags/ kho'i rgyal sred de ni rgya gar sulhan rgyal po'i byung rabs nang ya mtshan che shos shig byung yod/ de'i skabs mnga' ris rgya skyed kyi rtse mthar bslebs yod pa yin/rgyal po 'di yi rang gshis ni bzang ngan shin tu 'dres ma zhig yin pas de'i skor shod par dka' ba zhig yin/ dirsā'i sulhan tsho'i nang nas rgyal po 'di dang 'dra ba'i slob sbyong can dang / blo gros can 'gyur ldog chen po gzhan med pas deng dus kho la blo gros chen po yin pa'i bstod ra gtong gi yod cing / mi smyon pa lta bu zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed srol yod/ spyir btang rgyal po 'di phyin ci log dang 'gal ba du ma gcig tu 'dres pa zhig yin zhes bshad srol yod/ kho mkhas pa'i shes yon can zhig dang blo ldan zhig yin na yang kho'i 'char gzhi mang che ba log par phyin pa red/ kho gtan tshogs rig pa dang / shrīka gi mtshan nyid la mkhas shing / ang snas dang phyi
44 'phagasayul gyi 4nga ba brjod pa/dngos po'i tshan rig la do snang chen po yod/ arab kyi skad dang parashilā yi skad yag po yang shes kyi yod pa red/ kho mpi kha che gtsang ma zhig yin pas nyin re'i smon lam rtag tu byed cing sge ra gyi mi 3 la mi4bzang po zhig yin pa red/ kho rang kha che suddhā chos lugs la dad zhin shin tu chen po zhig yod pa red/khos byas pa'i drag po'i las don 'ga' shas dang / 'dzin skyong gi legs bcos 'ga' shas la nor 'khrul byung yod par bshad cing / nor 'khrul de dag phal cher kho spro thung ba dang / 'gal zla la bzod pa sgom ma thub pas lan pa yin/ khos gang la yang gzab gzab dang sngon rtsis gag po btang med pa dang / lag len thog thag gcod byed ma thub par ma zad spyir btang gi bsam shes yag po med pa sogs kyis rkyen pas so so'i mnga' rig su dka' ngal khag la gdong len byed ma thub pa red/thog ma'i dka' ngal/ kho'i rgyal srid dang por tshugs pa'i skabs rgyal po 'di la dka' ngal mang po byung / thog mar rgyal po la ngo log byed mkhan ni phyi lo 1326 lor kho rang gi nye 'brel yin pa lhahā usthān zhursāspa zer pa de red/ rgyal pos de pham par byas shing 'dzin bzung byas te btson du bcug te de'i gong du rgyal po la lho phyogs hoyasālayi rgyal po las rogs ram gang 'tshams thob yod pa red/ lo de'i rjes muXn gyi sred skyong gis ngo log de bas tshabs che ba byas rkyen yang rgyal po rang nyid phebs te srid skyong de pham par byas te srog thog tu btang/chab srid 'dzin skyong / de rjes khong gis khral rigs 'dzin skyong tshags tshud yong ched bka' khyab 'ga' shas btang ba'i thog mar rgyal khab kyi mnga' sde tshang ma'i nang khral dang 'gro gron ji yod kyi deb ther gsal zhing cha tshang ba 'dod dgos pas mnga' sde'i srid skyong tshang mar yig cha sogs cha tshang rgyal sa la gtong dgos zhes
le'uganyisapa/ b.rama'i bsagyi byung bab dpa/ 45bka' gnang ba red/ thag ring gi mnga' sdi baṅgāl dang / ḍaskan dang / gujarātra sogs las kyang yong 'bab dang 'gro gron gyi deb ther yog cha khag dirsā la 'byor zhing las don de 'jam po'i sgo nas byas yod/ sulhan rgyal pos las don 'di'i thad mnga' ris yongs rdzogs su khral rigs kyi 'gro stangs gcig gyur bzo rgyu dang grong gseb su yang deb thor ma 'khod par lus pa mi 'byung ched 'bad rtsol grub 'bras thon pa lta bu'i mthong snang byung ba red/chu'am gtsang po'i mdor khral chen po brgyabs pa/ de'i rjes su kho'i gom rim gnyis pa mpi gtsang po'am chu'i mdor gnas pa'i yul lung khag tu khral chen po rgyag rgyu de yin pa red/ de yang kho la chab srid 'dzin skyong sogs kyi ched gtsang po'am chu bo chen po'i mdo ru chags pa'i sa khul khag la khral shin tu chen po brgyabs pa dang /sa khul de tsho thon skyed che zhing sa zhing gshin po yod pa de la gzhi byas pa red/ sa khul de tshor khral ldab gsum mam bzhi mang ba brgyabs yod par bshad tshul gcig dang /'ga' shas kyis nyis ldab dang / yang 'ga' shas kyis ldab bcu dang snya shu'i bar brgyabs yod tshul bshad srol 'dug gang ltar khral shin tu chen po brgyabs pa dang /rgyal po'i khral sdu mkhan tshos tsha nan chen pos khral bsdus pas zhing pa tsho la dka' ngal chen po byung ste mthar dbul por gyur/ phyogs gang sa nas ngo log byung zhing / sa zhing la 'debs las ma thub par rtsa stong du gyur par ma zad di'i dang / chu bo chen po khag gi mdor mug ge chen po byung / de dang mnyam char pa ma babs pas mu ge lo mthud gnas/ srid byug 'di dang khral chen po brgyabs te mi mang la sdug po btang ba'i 'bras bur mi mang dbul por gyur pa dang / rgyal po'i 'gro ba mi la snying rje med pa'i bya spyod de gsal por bstan pa zhig red/ mi mang rnams dbul por gyur pa'i rgyu
46 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/mtshan ni char chu ma byung ba dang / khral che ba gnyis yin la/ 'on kyang mu ge dang than pa las skyob thabs ma byas shing khral nyung du'ang btang med/ sdus su rgyal pos gnas tshul de thos nas zhing pa tsho la bu lon sprod pa dang / khron pa brkos pa sogs skyob gso'i thabs shes byas kyang phyi drag pas grub 'bras gang yang ma byung /so nam las khungs gsar 'dzugs/ rgyal po 'dis so nam las khungs zhig gsar 'dzugs byas shing / de'i brgyud nas sa zhing 'debs las spor ba dang /dpal 'byor gyi rogs ram byed thabs byas pa dang / le dbar gru bzhi drug rtsu tsam sa zhing med pa tshor bgo 'grems byas shing de'i don du gzhung gis sgor 'bum bdun rtsu tsam 'gro gron btang ba red/ de lta na yang lag len bstar phyogs ma 'grig pa dang /spyod 'chal gyi dbang gis 'char gzhi de lam lhong ma byung ba red/rgyal sa spos pa/ munyasmad bīn tugalaka gis 'char gzhi mang po lag len bstar ba'i nang nas gcig ni phyi lo 132641327 nang rgyal sa de dosmyu nas delhagiri la spos te de'i ming la rdokātyāhād zhes btags pa red/ rgyal sa spo dgos pa'i dmigs yul ni drag po g.yul 9 las don la gzhigs pa dang / byang nub lku sa mtshams nyen kha can las thag ring bas brtan srung che ba dang / lho phyogs kyi hoḥ'i rgyal khams khag la las sla por dbang sgyur byed bde ba bcas yin tshod la/ der ma zad disnya'i tuka'i sku drag tsho dang / kha che tsho'i dbang shugs las ring du byol ba yang dgos pa gcig yin la/ lho phyogs sa khul rnams shin tu phyug pas mnga' khul de tsho'i thon khungs khag bed spyod legs par byed pa la mnga' khul de tsho dang thag nye'i 'brel ba yag po dgos pa'i bsam blo 'khor ba yang yin/rgyal sa spo rgyu thag bcad rjes dirsā'i gnas sdod pho mo phru sdu bcas pa tshang mar
le'uganyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs kyibyung ba brjod pa/ 47so so'i dngos zog khyer nas rdogāthābād la 'gro dgos pa'i bka' gnang nas de tshor mthun rkyen tshang ma sprad pa red/ dirsā nas rdol〉bād bar lam kha bzos shing za chas dang sdod gnas mkho sprod byas pa dang / 'gro song gtong rgyu'i mthun rkyen med mkhan rnams la gzhung gis 'gro song btang ba red/ 'on kyang mthun rkyen de dag tshang ma la grub 'bras gang yang ma byung / di( khu mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud gnas mkhan mi mang de tsho sems shin tu skyo po byung zhing / le dbar bdun brgya tsam gyi 'grul bzhud kyi dka' sdug tshod med byung ba sogs kyis so so'i pha yul dran pa dang / mang po zhig ni lam du 'das grongs su gyur/ der ma zad gzhung thag ring du spos pa las byang nub kyi sa mtshams mnga' khul phyi rgyal ba'i btsan rgol gyi nyen kha'i 'og tu tshud pa sogs gra ma 'grig chen po byung ba red/ mi ring bar rgyal pos gnas tshul dngos gnas pa shes te tshang ma ldillī la slar log dgos pa'i bka' gnang / de la brten nas dogāthābād de grong khyer stong pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / di'i de yang sngon ma ltar phun sum tshogs pa yong bar lo mang po 'gor/ der brten 'char gzhi de lam lhong ma byung ba red/ lam lhong ma byung ba de rgyal sa spos pa tsam gyis ma yin par spo stangs nor bas yin te/ rgyal po des bsam blo zhib tu ma btang bar srid gzhung gi gzhung zhabs pa rnams tsam ma yin par mi mang tshang ma dirsā nas 'gro skyod byed bcug pa de nor 'khrul shin tu chen po zhig red/ de la brten nas rdolhahāshād de nyid nus shugs la bed spyod log pa byas pa'i dran rten du lus pa red/dngul dod 'grems spel/ rgya gar gi ṭam sgor gyi lo rgyus nang murnyasmad bīn tugalaka yis dngul dod ṭam sgor 'grems spel byas pa de gal che'i gnad don zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan des na kho la dngul lam pe shag gi rgyal sras zhes 'bod srol yod
48 'phags yul byung babarjod pa/'dug khos gser dngul gyi sgor mo rin thang chen po de tsho'i tshab tu de dag dang gnad gong gcig pa dang 'grim sprod byed bde ba'i ṭam sgor bzo skrun byed rgyu'i dmigs yul bzung ste/ ṭam sgor bzo 'don gyi lugs srol yongs rdzogs la legs bcos byas pa red/ de yang ṭam sgor 'dra min sna tshogs bzos shing / de tsho phal che ba ni lag rtsal mdzes rig gis brgyan nas btog yod pa red/ khos las don gal gnad che ba zhig ni gser dngul gyi tshab tu ṭam sgor gzhan dag 'grems spel byas pa de yin/gser dngul gyi dod du ṭam sgor 'grems sprod kyi srol ni rgya nag dang parashilā gnyis su phyi lo brgya phrag bcu gsum pa'i nang dar ba yin la/ munyasmad bīn tugalaka yis de 'i skor thos pa yin sred/ dngul dang ma de gong che zhing dkon pas dngul ṭam gyi dod du li dang zangs kyi sgor mo bzo 'grems byas shing de dag dngul ṭam gyi ritshab tu rnam pa kun tu sprod len dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang ba red/ de lta na yang sulhan 'dis ṭam sgor 'di tsho rgyal khab gzhung kho nas bzo 'grems dgos pa'i thabs shes ma byas pa red/ de'i grub 'bras su mi mang tshos so so'i nang du ṭam sgor bzo skrun byas pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis bshad don ltar de skabs hirā tsho nang khrim re re bzhin ṭam sgor par khang du gyur pa red/ der brten gzhung khral tshang ma ṭam sgor rdzus ma rkyang pa sprad pa dang / der ma zad phyi rgyal ba'i tshong pa tshos rgya gar du dngos zog rnams liṃ dang zangs kyi sgor mos nyos te phyi yi yul khams rnams su btsong pa na gser dang dngul gyi sgor mo blangs pas de dag shin tu phyug por gyur cing / gzhung ni shin tu dbul por gyur/ de rjes phyi rgyal gyi tshong pa tshos zangs kyi sgor mo ma blangs pas tshong las la gnod skyon chen po byung / gnas tshul rnyog zing can de mtha' cer bslebs pa na sulhan gyis dngul dod ṭam sgor rnams phyir bsdu byas shing / phyir bsdu
le'uganyisapa/ b.rama'i bsakyibyung babarjod pa/ 49de dngul dod ṭam sgor 'grems spel byas te lo gsum mam bzhi'i rjes su byed dgos byung ba red/ rgyal po 'u thug nas mi mang tsho la zangs sgor dang liṃ sgor rnams gzhung mdzod nas gser dngul gyi ṭam sgor brje len byed chog pa'i bka' gnang bas/ mi mang tsho la khe 'bab ha cang chen po byung / gzhung gi mdzod ni stong pa lta bur gyur/shin tu gnad gong che zhing gzhung mdzod stong pa'i las rim 'char gzhi lam snyong dang ma ldan pa de'i 'gan 'khri tshang ma sulhan rang la byung ba red/chos kyi 'go khrid khag dang 'brel lam/ sngar gyi rgyal po lalā.u②na ltar rgyal po 'dis kha che'i 'char can gyi khrims lugs sharigata zer ba la snang chung byas te sred don la dgos pa byung na khas blangs pa las de min rtsi 'jog ma byas/ de la brten nas kha che'i chos kyi 'go 'khrid yulerā zer ba rnams dang ma 'grig pa byung / der ma zad rgyal pos lha'i rnam bzhag byed mkhan tsho la yang gros sdur byas shing 'on kyang de tsho'i gros 'char rnams dgos pa byung dus khas blangs/ ma byung dus snang chung byas/kha che'i khrims dpon kāX zer ba tshos khrims thag bcad pa rnams kyang skabs rer cas med du btang / srid byus 'di dag gis rkyen pas kha che'i chos kau 'go 'khrid pa khag dang ma 'grig pa byung zhing / de tshog rgyal po la ngo log dang / chos kyi ma dngul sogs la g.yo sgyu byas pa sogs kyi nyes pa byas pa gsal 3 chad pa drag po bcad/legs bcos gzhan khag rgyal po 'di khrims drang po dga' po yod pas kho rang nyid khrims gtug byed sa'i khrims dpon mthar sdug rtser son du gyur cing / chos 'brel lam chos ston pa min pa'i khrims dpon khag bskos te khrims lugs gces srung ched bdun phrag rer khrims rwa thengs gnyis re tshugs/ khrims kyi mdun sar tshang ma 'dra mnyam gyis kha che'i chos ston pa yulem dang / seyud tsho la yang chad pa drag po
50 'phags yulaca byung ba brjod pa/gtong rgyur 'tshor snang byas med/ khos rgyal po rang nyid kyi 'gal nyes la yang kha mchu dang khrims gtug byed rgyu'i bka' gnang yod/ nyes can la skye sa rigs rgyud dang rga gnas sogs la ma ltos par chad pa gcod dgos pa'i lugs srol bzos/sulhan 'di rtag par nyes can la khrims gcod tsha nan byed kyang / gtong phod shin tu nas che ste kho'i sbyin pa'i las khungs zer ba nas lo ltar ṭahā dung phyur mang po btang / mi mang la rngan pa dang grogs ram gyi sgo nas de tsho'i sdug bsngal sel thabs la lhod yang nam yang byas med/rgyal po 'dis sbrag tshugs brgyud nas gsar gnas myur du spel ba'i thabs shes byas yod cing / drag po dpung dmag gi skor dang / gsang ba'i las don thad sngar lalā.uXn dang / galtasu:na gyi srid byus la 'gyur ba ma btang bar de bzhin byas/phyi srid kyi bsam tshul/ sulhan 'dis 'dzam gling yongs rdzogs kyi rgyal po byed 'dod cing / steng lha yul dang / 'og mi yul gnyis ka kho rang gi thad ku'i dbang sgyur 'og tu gnas rgyu'i 'dod pa yod ces byung rabs 'ga' shas kyis bshad 'duglho phyogs su rgyal kha/ rgyal po 'di rgyal sar ma 'khod gong nas lho phyogs su lharalhal de dbang du bsdug rin pa yin pa'i thog khong khri la 'khod ma thag phyi lo 1328lor 1sprirlu zer ba'i rgyal khams chung chung zhig dbang du bsdus te rang gi mnga' ris de lho nub tu tu:bhadra gtsang po'i bar dang / shar lho'i mtshams su 1leka gtsang po'i bar du gtugs byas tsang galā.usthān dang mi 'dra bar rgyal po 'dis ḍamin gyi sa gnas mang ba dang / de bas kyang lho khul sa cha mang ba thad kur dbang sgyur byas/khuXsān la dbung 'jug gi 'char gzhi/ murnyasmad thin tugalaka yis khurasan dang / ṅgārāka sogs la dbung 'jug byas te dbang du bsdu ba'i 'dod rngam
