le'uganyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 69dpal 'byor lhan khang / drag po'am dmag srid lhan khang dang / phyi srid lhan khang dang / mnga' sde dang mnyam sbrel lhan khang bcas yod cing / mnga' sde dang mnyam sbrel lhan khang gis zhing chen so so'i 'dzin skyong la lta rtogs dang / zhing chen gzhung dang dbus gzhung bar gyi 'brel lam mthud mkhan lta bu yin/ de dag las gzhan pa'i khrims don sde tshan dang / zhing las sam so nam sde tshan dang / mi mang 'dzug skrun sde tshan dang / bran g.yog sde tshan dang / rgyal po'i sku sger phyag mdzod khang sogs sde tshan mang po yod pa red/mnga' sde gzhung / rgyal khams ni mnga' sde mang por bgos shing / de rnams sred skyong gis bskyangs pa yin zhing / sred skyong de tsho la naXb zhes 'bod/mnga' sde'i nang zhi bde dang khrims mthun yong ba byed rgyu de mnga' sde gzhung gi las 'gan yin la mnga' sde de tshor yang sde tshan mang po yod/ mnga' sde'i 'dzin skyong pa tsho bsko bzhag byed rgyu dang / gnas dbyung gtong rgyu sogs tshang ma rgyal po'i thugs bcud nyag gcig la rag lus pa red/ mnga' sde'i 'dzin skyong pa tsho la mnga' sde'i nang 'gro gron gtong ba dang / khral bsdu ba sogs kyi dbang cha yod cing / mnga' sde'i nang 'gro song btang ba'i lhag ma rnams rgyal po'i bang mdzod du 'bul dgos/ mnga' sde mang nyung ni dus skabs la ltos shing / muhamad bin tugalaka kyi skabs mnga' sde nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa red/mnga' sde rnams rdzong khag lta bu chung chung du bgos yod cing / de dag kyang paraganu zhes pa ru bgos/ paraganu la dpon rigs gal che ba ni munasapha zhes pa'i mdzod pa dang / kustunago sogs yod cing / 'di tsho ni deng sang yang rgya gar du yod/ de tsho'i las ma'i ngo bo dang / gnas rim la 'gyur ba byung yod srid kyang /
70 'pha sayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/mtshan gnas ni yod mus yin/rgyal khams kyi yong 'bab gtso tra ni sa zhing gi khral yin la/ spyir btang so nam pa tshog thon skyed las brgya cha lnga bcu tham pa khral du 'bul gyi yod kyang rgyal po 'ga' shas kyis gtsang po'i mdo sogs thon skyed gag sa nas brgya cha lnga bcu len thabs byas shing / 'ga' shas kyis bcu cha gcig dang bcu gnyis kyi cha gcig khral du blangs pa'ang yod/dzadzi.ā zhes pa'i chos khral de kha che ma yin pa tshang ma la bkal ba dang / bram ze tsho la khral de sprod ma dgos par dmigs bsal yod kyang / pherodza shāha tugalaka zhes pa 'a bram ze tsho la chos khral 'gel mkhan dang po de yin/ der ma zad khral rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa de tsho'i nang nas 'ga' shas rgyal po 'ga' shas kyis med pa yang bzos/sulhan tsho'i chos kyi srid byus ni kha che'i chos ni rgyal khab kyi chos yin zhing / tshang mas rgya gar gyi chos lugs pa rnams kha che'i chos su sgyur thabs byas/ sulhan a.ā usnrin tugalaka de gcig bus chos ni las 'gan gtso bo min par zhar byung gi las don du brtsis/ sulhan phal cher gyis mi mang nang kha che dang kha che ma yin pa gnyis bar dbye 'byed khyad par chen po byas/ kha che ma yin pa tsho la khrims lugs kyang legs tra ma byas shing / gnas skor sogs la dam drag byas/ kha che las gzhan rgya gar gyi chos lugs kyi shes yon gyi 'dzug skrun dang / lha khang dang / sku 'dra sogs gtor bshig chen po byas rjes kha che'i mchod khang dang pho brang sogs brtsigs/ byung rabs smra ba tshos bshad gsal/ dus rabs bar ma'i dus skabs su 'dzam gling yongs rdzogs la chos lugs la bzod bsran med pa'i dus skabs shig byung ba yin pas rgya gar du
le'uganyisapa/ bar ma'i skabs gyi byung babarjod pa/ 71yang de ltar byung ba yin zhes brjod srol yod/thog mar sulhan de tsho'i stobs shugs chen po med cing / kha che'i chos ston pa tsho'i dbang 'og tu song / phyis su de la 'gyur ba chen po byung nas stobs chen por gyur/ 'on kyang de skabs kyi 'dzin skyong la skyon chen po gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/chos la bzod bsran med pas chos lugs gzhan la sdang zug byas pa des rgya che'i mi mang nas mnyam 'brel dang gzhung zhen byas med pa de yin zhing / gnyis pa ni drag po'i stobs shugs yar rgyas su gtong ma thub par ma zad gnas tshul 'gyur ba nang bzhin dmag shugs kyang che ru gtong dgos pa la de ltar ma thub pas mthar rgyal khams zhig 'thor du gyur pa red/sulhan gyi dus rabs su ñtsā ṇā pa/shā jing/ 'a~X pa ṭwāṃ sprar zlong / chos dang / sgyu sulhan tsho'i rgyal srid ring rgya gar du srin don dang / spyi tshogs dang / dpal 'byor dang / shes rig sogs kyi cha nas 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung yod/ kha che'i rigs 'dra min mang po rgya gar du bslebs pa dper na/ zhorab pa dang / tuka dang /aphaXn bcas red/ de tsho'i chos lugs kyi sgrig 'dzugs dam po dang / drag shul che bas rgya gar du 'dzul ba dang / phyi rgyal ba gzhan rnams dang mi 'dra bar kha che de tsho rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs nang thim par khas ma blangs par so so'i rnam pa dang ngo bo gsal por 'dzin bzung byas/ kha che'i chos khyab spel gang thub byas par ma zad kha che'i mi rnams rgyal khab kyi mi ser dngos gnas par ngos 'dzin gyis rgya gar ba'i chos lugs 'dzin pa tsho la dma' 'bebs dang sdug po btang yod pa red/ der brten rgya gar gyi
72 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/mi mang kha che min pa tshos kha che'i gzhung srid de la sdang po byas pa chos nyid yin zhing /de la brten nas spyi tshogs nang kha che dang 99 gnyis su gyes nas phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing rgyun ma chad pa byas/ de la brten nas dolnga'i sulhan gyi dus rabs de 'che ba can gyi zing 'khrug gi dus rabs shig yin la mthar shes rig gcig gyur gyi ngang du rdzogs pa zhig red/spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs/ lho phyogs kyi hiḥ'i rgyal khams dper na 'dzaya nagaram lta bu stobs chen khag nang ma gtogs gang sar hi('am rgya gar gyi chos lugs pa tsho la dma' 'bebs mthong chung byas yod pa red/ rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs de hiḥ dang kha che gnyis su gyes/ hiḥ tsho'i dbang cha'am thob thang tshang ma kha che'i dbang 'dzin pa'i lag pa nas yong dgos shing/ phru gu tsho la shes yon gyi mthun rkyen gang yang thob kyi yod pa ma red/ der brten nyirdu tsho'i sems shugs nyams pa lta bu byung /kha che tsho la ni thob thang dang lnga dbang yongs rdzogs yod pa dang / de tsho ni dbang 'dzin gral rim nang du gtogs/ sku drag tsho'i nang du tuka dang / arab dang /gaphaspyan gyi mi rigs rnams yin la dus skabs mang che bar tuka'i sku drag tsho shugs che shos byung /bran g.yog dus skabs der bran g.yog gi lugs srol de khyab chen po yod cing / hi( dang kha che gnyis ka la sger gyi bran g.yog yod pa red/ bran g.yog nyo sa'i khrom yang yod pa de nas sgo phyugs nang bzhin bran g.yog kyang nyo 'tshong byed/ kha che'i bran g.yog rnam pa bzhi tsam yod pa ni nyos pa'i bran g.yog dang / rngan pa'ang sbyin pa nas thob pa'i bran g.yog dang / dmag 'khrug gi btson pa dang / so sos btsong pa'i bran g.yog bcas bzhi red/ dbang 'dzin pa dang sku drag tshos bran g.yog
le'u gnyisapa/ bar ma'i skabs: byung ba brjod pa/ 73pho mo mang po nyar gyi yod pa dang / rgyal po'i bran g.yog ni mang shos red/ bran g.yog de tsho la khe dbang gang yang med kyang / skabs re de tsho rang dbang du btang nas 'ga' shas gnas snangs mthon por bslebs nas dbang shugs chen po chags pa'ang yod/ de lta na yang bran g.yog ring lugs ni spyi tshogs nang thabs skyo po zhig red/bud med tsho'i gnas stangs/ sngon dus kyi rgya gar dang bsdur na sulhan tsho'i skabs bud med tsho'i gnas stangs shin tu skyo po yod 'dug cing / hiḥ dang kha che gnyis ma'i bud med tsho la thun mong gi rnam pa 'ga' shas spyi mtshungs su yod pa ni/gnyis ka sngar srol dang rmongs dad kyis bcings yod pa dang / gnyis ka yol ba'i nang sdod dgos pa'am gdong pa 'geb pa'i lugs srol yod/ de lta na yang bud med che mthong can mang po byung ba dper na sulhan raX.ā dang / btsun mo /pamatu dang /smyu364 zhes pa'i rnal 'byor ma sogs skabs 'dir byung yod pa yin/hiX'i bud med brgya phrag mang po kyo ga'i dur mer gson sreg byas pa dang /kha che'i bud med mang po nyen kha'i skabs med par bzos pa'i lo rgyus bris pa yang 'dugmig 'khrul dang / gson 'dre ma'i rig pa dang / rdzu 'phrul phran tshog sogs la dga' po byung yod 'dugza chas/ hiḥ'i tsho'am kha che ma yin pa'i rgya gar ba tsho'i za chas gtso bo ni 'bras dang / tshal dang / dkar chu'i rigs yin zhing / spyir btang de tshos sha la dga' po mi byed/ phyogs gzhan zhig la/ kha che tshos sha'i rigs dang / chang rag la shin tu dga' po byed/ hiḥ tshos kha lag ma zos sngon khrus rgyag gi yod pa dang /khyim nang gtsang ma dang / stabs bde po 'jog srol yod/ kha che tshos spyir btang gtsang sbra yag po mi byed/
74 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/gos sam gyon chag/ dus skabs der skyon chas ni spyi tshogs nang gnas stangs mtho dman mtshon byed du ñtsa ba yin la/ rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i nang 'khor rnams dang / sku drag tsho dang / srid skyong sogs kyis gyon chag rin thang shin tu chen po gyon pa dang / rgyan cha gnad gong chen po mang po 'dogs srol yod/ rgyal po'i nang gi bud med tshos kyang gyon chas rin thang chen po dang rgyan cha mdzes po 'dogs pa dang / phyi yul nas nyos pa'i dri bzang yang bed spyod byed/ mi mang bying rnams ni gyon chas stabs bde po gyon gyi yod cing / khyo ga tshos 52 zhes pa'i smad ras dang /stod thung gyon srol yod/ mgo la zhwa mo'am mgo ras gyon srol yod cing / hiḥ'i bud med tshos mgo la me tog gi rgyan cha 'dogs/ bud med dkyus ma tshos rgyan cha rin thang can gyon ma thub pas phal mo ches gyon chas stabs bde po gyon pa red/dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs/ tunadang / aphaspyan gyi srid yun brgya phrag gsum tsam ring tshod dpag mi thub pa'i dpal 'byor yod pa'i grags pa kun tu khyab yod/ rgyal po dang de yi 'khor rnams kyis rgyas spros shen tu chen po'i mi che skyel gyi yod pa dang / dmag 'khrug ched 'gro song shin tu chen po gtong gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang rgyal khab kyi ched du dpal 'byor gyi srid byus phugs phan yong ba gang yang yod tshod mi 'dug so nam/ de skabs rgya gar gyi thon khungs gtso bo ni so nam yin zhing / tshong las kyang gal chen po yin/ sulhan mang che bas so nam la gal cher brtsis nas zhing las dang / zhing chu 'dren pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzugs skrun byas yod pa dang / pherodza tugalaka ni las don de 'dra byed mkhan grags che shos yin/ mu ge byung dus tsam ma gtogs so nam gyi thon skyed yul du ldeng par yod par ma zad phyir 'tshong byed rgyu yang
le'uganyisapa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung babarjod pa/ 75lhag gi yod pa red/ der brten mi che'i 'tsho ba legs tsam yod 'dug byung rabs mkhan tshos bshad don ltar na de skabs baṅgāl yul de longs spyod che shos dang /'dzam gling nang dngos zog gong chung shos sheg yin zhing tshang ma longs spyod kyis chims pa yod tshul bshad 'dugbzo las/ sulhan tshos bzo las sna tshogs la do snang byas yod pa dper na dar zab bam se leg 'thag las la las byed pa stong phrag mang po bzhag yod pa dang /gser shog bzo las dang / gzhan yang dngos zog mang po bzo 'don byed/ de dag ni phal cher rgyal po'i bzo las khang du bzo 'don byed/ baṅgāl dang / gujarātra ni ras cha bzo 'don dang phyir 'tshong byed mkhan che shos yin/ ras cha'i bzo grwa dang /tshos rgyag sa'i bzo las dang / ras dkar po la ri mo sna tshogs 'bri ba dang / bye ma ka ra'i bzo grwa dang / khams rigs bzo skrun gyi bya ba dang / so phag bzo 'don dang / shog bu'i bzo grwa sogs ni sger gyi bzo las gal che ba khag yin/tshong las/ dus skabs der nub gling yuropa 9 sa cha 'ga' shas dang /malāpa'i gling dang / rgya nag dang / gaphaspyan dang / parashilā dang / bod dang 'brug yul sogs kyi mnyam rgya gar gyi tshong 'brel yod pa red/ rgya gar nas phyir 'tshong bya rgyu'i dngos zog ni ras cha dang / nyal tha sogs yin zhing / rgya gar nas phyor 'tshong byas par spyir btang gser len srol yod/ der brten phyi lo 1351nas 1388 bar gyi dus skabs de rgya gar la dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa yod/phyi lo brgya phrag bcu bzhi pa'i smad cha nas ntaswār gyis dpung 'jug 'phrog bcom byas rjes dpal 'byor nyams rgyud du phyin/ 'on kyang brgya phrag bco lnga pa'i smad cha nas yang bskyar dpal 'byor bskyar gso cung zad byung /
76 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/mi che'i gnas tshad/ skabs der urusu'i gzigs skor ba nigitin zhes pa zhig gis gzigs tshul bkod don/ rgya gar gyi sku drag tsho dang / gzhung zhabs pa rnams ni rgyu nor dang dpal 'byor gyis shin tu phyug la/ grong gseb pa dang dbul phongs rnams ni shin tu skyo po yod pa dang / dbul po de tsho ni khral gyis gnya' non nas bsdad 'dug ces bshad 'dug gang ltar dbang 'dzin gral rim pa rnams ni 'dod yon la longs spyod cing mthun rkyen kun tshang yin pa dang / zhing pa rnams mpi khral gyi gnon smyud 'og mi che ha cang sdug bsngal chen po'i ngang nas skyel dgos/ mu ge byung skabs de tsho'i gnas stangs ni smra brjod kyi lam nas 'das/chos kyi gnas stangs/ disnya dang / sa gnas gzhan bcas par kha che'i srid gzhung tshugs pa de la brten nas spyi tshogs dang chos kyi 'gyur ba gal che ba mang po byung yod pa red/ yeshilā'i dbus phyogs nas yong ba'i kha che'i btsan 'dzul ba de tshos rgya gar de so so'i nang khyim du bzos pa dang / de tsho rgya gar ba'i chos lugs pa tsho'i dkyil du gnas pa na thog mar 96 tshos ngo rgol byas shing rim bzhin gcig gi gcig la shan zhugs pa red/ shes rig gam lugs srol rma mthun pa gnyis dus rabs mang por mnyam du gshib na phan tshun shan zhugs pa chos nyid yin zhing ldog tu med/ des na skabs 'dir kha che'i chos dang hin du'i chos gnyis gcig gi gcig la shan chen po zhugs te mnyam bsres kyi rnam pa gsal po zhig byung yod pa red/2rka tshos dpal nuland+ra gtor bshig byas rjes rgya gar byang phyogs su nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs nyams pa dang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba dgon sde'am gtsug lag khang nyams shing rtsa med du phyin pa na rjes 'jug khyim pa'i mi mang rnams kyang rang shugs kyis rang gi rtsa ba'i chos lugs las chos lugs gzhan du 'gyur yod parashes
le'uganyis pa/ b.rama'iskabs sprebyung ba brjod pa/ 77thub/ lho phyogs su yang nang chos la mi dga' ba'i rgyal po mang po'i ring nang chos la srung skyob ma byung zhing / gang ltar skabs 'dir nang chos nyams pa'i rkyen chen po byung bas mthar rgya gar du nang bstan nub pa lta bur gyur/ de lta na yang nang pa gtan nas med pa yin zhes smra mi 'os te/ sa gnas 'ga' zhig tu nang pa mang po dus phyos su'ang mthong rgyu yod/kha che'i chos rgya gar du bslebs nas kha che'i dbang 'dzin pa tshos dus rabs mang por yul 'dir dbang bsgyur ba las 'gyur ba'am grub 'bras che shos ni/ kha che dang hiḥ gnyis nas phan tshun chos lugs kyi bsam tshul mang po dang len byas pa de yin/ de la brten nas chos kyi bsam tshul la gzhi byas pa'i chos kyi las 'dul chen po gnyis byung ba ni/ suphyi zer ba'i kha che'i chos kyi las 'dul dang lha) ste brtse dad kyi las 'grul gnyis red/dang po suphyi zhes pa'i kha che'i las 'dul de ji ltar yin zhe na/ bshu'i brgya phrag bcu gcig pa'i nang parashilā (zhwanān )dang yul gzhan nas yong ba'i kha che tsho'i nang du suphyi kha che'i rnam 'byor ba 'ga' shas kyang yod pa red/ de tsho rgya gar gyi sa cha sna tshogs la gnas chags te rgya gar ba mang po yang de tsho'i rjes 'jug par gyur/ skuphyi'i rnal 'byor pa tshog bshad don/ gal te gang zag gcig gi sems su dkon mchog la brtse ba'i bsam pa yod na de dkon mchog dang so so'i grogs po 'gro ba mi rnams kyi drung du nye bar bsleb thub kyi red/ dkon mchog la brtse ba de gal chen po bcas pas de tsho chos lugs gzhan rnams kyi skor la yang bsam rgya che ba yod/ skunyi tshos bshad don ltar na dkon mchog gi drung du bsleb pa la lam rma 'dra ba mang po yod srid pas chos lugs gzhan rnams kyang dkon mchog gi drung du 'gro ba'i lam yin zhes dang /
78 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/'gro ba khra rigs tshang ma gcig pa yin zhes shugs chen pos khyab spel byas/ khong tshos bsam tshul de sngon srol 'dzin pa'i kha che'i chos ston pa ulim tshog khas ma blangs shing gang lags zer na suphyi'i rnal 'byor pa tshos bshad pa'am bsam tshul de rtsa ba'i kha che'i /chos dang mthun gyi med pa red/ gang ltar swānyi rnal 'byor pa de tsho la tshang mas dga' po byas/ de tshog hi( tsho kha cher sgyur thabs ma byas pas ma tshad de tsho la dkon mchog la dngos 'brel brtse ba byas te hiḥ yag po zhig tu gnas dgos pa'i slob gso bya'abu/ma.inuṣṭhan ciX zer ba de de skabs kyi su'i rnal 'byor pa che shos yin zhing /khong ajamer la yun ring po bzhugs nas phyi lo 1236 lor zhing la phebs/ khong gis yid ches gnang don ltar na/ brtse dad kyi glu dbyangs ni dkon mchog gi drung du bgrod pa'i lam zhig yin la/ gal te dad pa'i smyu dbyangs sam/ rol dbyangs legasangapar blangs na sems la bde ba chen po thob pa dang / sems la bde ba ji tsam thob pa de tsam dkon mchog gi drung du nye bar bslebs pa yin zhes gsungs/ khong gi rjes 'jug pa tshos chos kyi tshogs lta bu tshogs nas tshogs pa'i nang zlu dbyangs spus legasatshad mthon po dag blangs nas rol mo yang dkrol bar byed/ rgya gar skad hi:'i nang gtong ba'i glu dbyangs khag la tshang mas shin tu dga' mos byed/ smyu dbyangs 'di tsho ni nga tsho bod pa'i 'don pa khag dbyangs su 'don pa lta bu zhig yod/skuphyi rnal 'byor pa gzhan khag ni 66pharid dang / ni:muXn sogs mang po yod pa dang / nināmādzān mpi dirsā la sdod kyi yod pa red/ de ni rang gi bsam tshul rang dbang du 'char mkhan zhigayin pas gal srid rgyal po'i las ka zhig la dga' po ma byas na gsal por thad kur lab kyi yod pa red/ des su la'ang 'jigs snang mi
le'uganyes pa/ bar ma'i skabs gyi byung babarjod pa/ 79byed pa zhig yin pa red/ khong la rgyal po dang 'bangs gnyis kus sdus bkur chen po zhu gi yod pa red/kha che'i su'i chos kyi bsam tshul de la brten nas hiḥ'i chos lugs pa tsho la yang 'gyur ba byung yod cing / de yang sngar srol chos lugs mdo mkhregs dam 'dzin gyis rkyen pas spyi tshogs su skyon cha lhag pa de tshor legs bcos byas te kha che'i chos 9 gdong len bya rgyu'i bsam tshul yang byung yod la kha che'i rnal 'byor pa tsho las legs cha blangs nas so so'i chos lugs kyi sgo nas bshad pa byas pa'ang yin srid/ gang ltar skabs 'dir lha: ste brtse dad kyi las 'grul byung bas dus rabs 'di la brtse dad las 'gul gyi dus rabs zhes brjod srol yod/ brtse dad kyi las 'gul byed mkhan rnal 'byor pa mang po byung zhing / de yang thog mar 'phags yul lho phyogs nas byung zhing hāmil sa gnas kyi rnal 'byor pa tshos gtam rgyud dang zlu dbyangs kyi sgo nas brtse dad kyi lugs srol btod/ lugs srol de grong khyer khag tu tshong pa khag dang / bzo las pa rnams dang / grong gseb tu zhing pa tshos dga' mos byas/ brtse dad kyi las 'grul byed mkhan mang che ba bram ze las gzhan yin/ de tsho mang che ba mkhas pa'i skye bo yang min la grub thob bam rnal 'byor pa lta bu yin/brtse dad kyi lam zhes pa'i chos de tshang ma la 'chad spel byas/ khong tshos bshad gsal ltar na/ dkon mchog dang mi gnyis kyi 'brel ba ni brtse ba'i bsam pa la gzhi byas pa zhig yin la/ chos kyo cho ga phyag len khag las brtse ba dang ldan pa'i dad pa ste brtse dad la nyams len byed pa legs pa yin/ pha ma bu spun phan tshun brtse ba ltar dkon mchog la brtse ba gal che zhing / de yang dad pa dang ldan pa'i brtse ba byed dgos zhes bshad/ khong tshos 'gro ba mi tshang ma dang chos lugs tshang ma la brtso
80 'phagasayulagyi byung babarjod pa/ba dang bzod sgom byed par nan tan gyis bshad/brtse dad kyi lam ston mkhan rnal 'byor pa gzhan ni baṅgāl du nyutanu dang /lharāṇaṅgā la ṇḍabīradus dang / panāb la (shunānaka dang / rā4lhan gyi rnal 'byor ma smyunāshā.i sogs grangs med byon/ de tshos kha che dang nyirdu'i bar gyi 'khon 'dzin med pa bzo ba'i thabs shes byas shing / ming tha dad pa tsam las don du kha che dang hiḥ'i dkon mchog gcig pa yin tshul bshad/ de tshos dkon mchog la brtse ba'i zlu dbyangs mang po sa gnas kyi skad nang rang rtsom byas te rol mo'i brgyud smyu ru blangs/ de tshos brtsams pa'i dad pa'i glu dbyangs zhes pa de tsho go bde la don zab po yod cing mgur ma lta bu yod/ rnal 'byor pho mo de tsho phal che ba mkhas pa min yang grub pa thob pa lta shtsa yod tshod/ gang ltar hirā'i chos lugs su bsam tshul gsar pa'i las 'gul zhig byung yod pa red/ grub 'bras gal che shos ni kha che dang hi( gnyis ku'i dkon mchog gi rmang mi 'dra ba tsam las don du ngo bo gcig pa yin pa'i bsam tshul byung ba yin/brtse dad kyi bsam tshul las byung ba'i las 'gul de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs kyi shan nam nus pa las byung ba yin tshul gsung mkhan yang 'dug pa cha tsam bden yang sred/khang bzo'i rig pa/ parashilā dang / dbus yeshiX nas tuka dang a phaspyan tshos sgyu rtsal dang khang bzo'i rig rtsal sogs 'khyer yong ba dang / lugs srol de tsho rgya gar gyi lag rtsal dang 'dres pa na khang bzo sogs kyi rnam pa gsar pa zhig yar rgyas su phyin pa red/ dus rabs 'dir khang bzo'i rig rtsal gyi dmigs bsal gyi rnam pa gal che ba ni rgyal sgo'i steng gi phyed zlum rtse snon po dang / thog kha'i dbyibs rlung po khag yin/ 'di tsho bzo ba ni ang cas dang 'phrul las gyi tshad mthon po la brten pa
le'uganyis pa/ b.rama'i skabasakyi byung babarjod pa/ 81yin zhes brjod srol 'dug pa ltar yin/bran g.yog rgyal rgyud skabs bzhengs pa'i dirsā'i kutubaminār dang / de'i nye 'gram gyi kha che'i mchod khang dang / pherodza shāha koṭalnga dang / tugalaka bād rdzong dang / yordu sulhan tsho'i bang so bcas mdzes shing khyad mtshar ba'i dpe mtshon tsam lha//pa /shāX hūm̐ /pa /ta swā tsam du~X ༵ paX mnga' tshon rnyi/ shā sbyang )(dri dzog mb+ya ༵ kā che'i mchod khang dang rgyal po'i pho brang sogs mang po brtsegs yod pa de tsho ni sa gnas de tsho'i bzo las pa'am lag rtsal mkhan tshos bzos pa dang sa khul de ga'i hi('i rgyal po tshos bzos pa'i khang bzang khag gi shan zhugs pas kha che'i bzo skrun yin yang hiḥ'i rnam pa 'dres yod pa yin/skad dang gzhung lugs/ gong du bshad pa ltar brtse dad kyi las 'gul byed mkhan rnal 'byor pa tshos sa gnas so so'i skad rang gi nang du chos bstan pas sa gnas skad la gar rgyas phyin yod/ rgya gar byang phyogs su hi: skad yar rgyas su phyin yod pa thog mar skad 'di la rnam pa gnyis yod de brang skad dang / awa〉 skad gnyis yin zhing / 'di gnyis ni deng sang brgya phrag nyi shu pa'i nang gi hi:'i skad 'di dang 'dra po yod pa dang 'di'i a ma lta bu yin/ deng sang gi hiX'i skad 'di ha cang rnying pa zhig gtan nas min par skad rigs gsar pa lta bu zhig yin/ 'on kyang 'di'i rtsa ba'i gzugs ni sngar nas yod cing legs sbyar skad la thug yod/ der ma zad pa:ba kyi skad dang / nub phyogs su grujarātra skad dang / byang nub tu marāhā skad dang / lho nub tu 169 skad dang / lho phyogs su telagu skad dang tamil mid dang shar phyogs su baṅgāl gyi skad dang / uriX'i skad dang / āsam gyi skad sogs
82 'phagasayulagyi grang ba brjod pa/yar rgyas su phyin yod/ skad de tsho 'ga' shas ni zur chags kyi skad dang / rang bzhin pa'i skad las yar rgyas su phyin pa yin/skabs der yul gyi cha shas mang por parashilā'i skad dang / arab kyi skad dar so byung zhing / parashilā'i skad de skabs der srid gzhung gi skad yin/ parashilā'i skad dang hiX skad 'dres pa las udwa zhes pa'i skad gsar pa zhig byung ba red/ legs sbyar saskrota skad la rgyal po'am gzhung nas srung skyob ma thob pas de la yar rgyas phyin med/ de lta mod kyang mkhas pa nyung shas kyis bod spyod byas te ma nyams par bzung /hi: rgyal po tshos de la skyong thabs byas/ legs sbyar skad du yod pa'i gzhung lugs khag sa khul so so'i skad du bsgyur/ kha che'i mkhas pa nyung shas kyis legs sbyar skad la slob sbyong byas yod par ma zad 'irodzashāha sogs kha che rgyal po gcig gnyis kyis leḍa sbyar gyi skad nang yod pa'i bstan bcos 'ga' shas parashi lā'i skad du sgyur bcug pa red/ri mo dang rol dbyangs/ phra ba'i ri mo 'bri ba'i sgyu rtsal ni rgyun gnas byung ste ri mo ba dzes skabs der dbang 'dzin ge tsho dang mi drag tsho'i dpe cha mdzes po bzos te ri mo sna tshogs bris/ skabs re de tshos so so'i sbyin bdag rgyal po tsho'i snang brnyan ri mo 'bri srol yod cing / skabs rer deb nang gi gnas tshul byung ba rnams 'dra ris su 'god par byed/parashilā dang / arab sogs kyi rol dbyangs dang 'dres nas rgya gar gyi rol dbyangs gsar pa khag gar rgyas byung zhing / skabs der siṅgār dang sāraX zer ba'i rgyud mang gnyis dang / tabalu zhes pa'i rnga chung sogs ni rol mo'i yo chas dar so che shos yin/ suphyi rnal 'byor pa tshos dbyangs dang rol mo la dang 'dod byas pas rol dbyangs la dga' mos chen po byung / kha che'i rgyal po re zung gis rol
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabasakyi byung babarjod pa/ 83dbyangs la bkag sdom byas kyang / rgyal po'i 'khor rnams kyis zhu 'bod byas pa las mthar bkag sdom ma thub/ spyir btang kha che'i sulhan tsho rol dbyangs la dga' po yod par ma zad khyilaspru rgyal po tshos rol dbyangs la bdag gces chen po byas shing 'ga' shas rol dbyangs la mkhas po yang byung yod/mugal 7gong ma'i rgyal rgyud kyi rmang gzhi tshugs shing rgyal srid mnga' thang rgyas pa/tong du bshad pa ltar kha che'i rgyal po sulhan gyi dus rabs de rdzogs nas phyi lo 1526 nas rgya gar du mugal rgyal rgyud spi rmang gzhi tshugs pa yon zhing / de yang rgyal rgyud de'i rmang gzhi 'dzugs mkhan ni kha che'i rgyal po bābar zhes pa de yin/ rgyal rgyud 'di yishu'i dus rabs bcu dgu pa bar du gnas pa yin la/ de rjes rgya gar la dbang sgyur byed mkhan kha che'i rgyal po'am rgyal po gzhan su yang ma byung /bābar/bar skabs su urusu'i mnga' 'og tu tshud pa 0dzabagistun zhis pa'i mnga' sde nang pharaganu zer ba'i rgyal khab chung chung zhig yishu'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang byung /sa gnas 'di deng dus/ pharaganu de la rgyal po mi( (umar)shekha zer bas dbang sgyur byas shing / kho la phyi lo 1483 lor sras gcig 'khrungs pa de nyid bābar yin/bābar de pha'i phyogs nas 93 ra dang nye 'gro zhing / 9myur ni sngar rgya gar la dbung 'jug gis 'phrog bcom byed mkhan de yin/ a ma'i phyogs nas sog po'i rgyal po cangageshakhran dang nye 'brel du 'gro ba yin pas kho ni ekaX'i dpa' bo grags can gnyis kyi rigs rgyud yin/pha mipa umar shekha shi ba'i rjes su phyi lo 1494 lor bābar khri la 'khod
84 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/nas pharaganu la dbang byas/ de dus kho rang lo bcu gcig red/ khos rang gi rnam thar zhig bris 'dug pa de ni de skabs kyi bris rtsom rnam thar yag shos yin par bshad/rnam thar de'i ming la tu(ka e bābarī zhes bya zhing / kho rang pharaganu'i khri la 'khod pa nas bzung te bshad pa 'khod 'dug cing / skad la rang dbang thob pa zhig yin 'dugder brten kho la thog mar shes yon nam slob sbyong yag po thob yod nges/bābar khri la 'khod nas kho la rang gi nye 'brel tshog dka' ngal gang 'tshams bzos shing / 'on kyang khos dka' ngal de tsho la gdong len byas/ de nas khos samarakanda la dbang sgyur byas te de nas rang gi rgyal khab la 'dzin skyong byed rtsis byas/'on kyang kho samarakanda la yod skabs rang gi skyes yul pharaganā la nyen kha byung zhing kho pharaganu la bskyod pa na samarakanda shor/ de 'dra lan gnyis tsam byung yod/ gang ltar rjes su lngabul la dbang sgyur byas te/ de nas rgya gar la dpung 'jug dbang sgyur byed pa'i bsam blo 'bor ba red/ samarakanda la rgyal sa bzos nas sa gnas de ga nas mnga' ris la dbang sgrur byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi de lam lhong ma byung bas khos rang gi rgyal khams che ru gtong rgyu'i ched shar phyogs su dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i thag bcad pa reng/ shar phyogs zhes pa ni kho'i bsam tshul la hi:stun zhes pa'i rgya gar de red/bābar gyis dbung 'jug byed kha la hiḥstun gyi srid don gyi gnas stangs ni shin tu skyo po rgyal khams chung chung khag phan tshun 'khrug 'dzing gis gcig gyur med pa zhig yin/ phyi rgyal ba dpung 'jug btsan 'dzul mkhan sus kyang btsan 'dzul byed chog chog lta bu'i gnas stangs 'og yod pa red/ bābar rang nyid kyis bris pa ltar na/de skabs rgya gar la kha ches bskyangs pa'i rgyal khab lnga tsam dang/ hi༈ rgyal pos bskyangs ba'i rgyal khab gnyis yod pa red/
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 85dang po ni dosmyu sulhan gyi rgyal khams yin zhing / de ni de skabs 'ordu sulhan gyi rgyal po tha ma e:lham loXs bskyangs yod pa dang / de ni rang gi 'bangs rnams dang sku drab tshos dga' po ma byas/gnyis/ pa grujarāto yin zhing de ni mu'ophar shāha gnyis pas dbang sgyur byed bzhin yod/ gsum pa ni mālalha ste de skabs musmud gnyis pas dbang 'og tu gnas rāXrsāgā zer bas rgyal po de stobs zhan par bzos yod / bzhi pa ni baṅgāl te de skabs nusarata shāha zhes pa'i dbang 'og tu yod/ lnga pa ni meXr yin te de yang kha che'i dbang 'og tu yod kyang skabs der rnyarmāsaXm sihas dbang sgyur byed bzhin yod cing des bābar la dbung 'jug byed rogs zhes 'bod skul zhus pa red/lho phyogs su bahamani rgyal khams zhes pa'i yul zhig yod pa de de skabs kha che'i sulhan zhig gis dbang sgyur byed bzhin yang rgyal khams dum bur phyin nas skyo ba'i gnas skabs zhig yin tshod/yin la shā tshosta ṭwāṃ hiX/ nārnyi drimatsha sbyinās poche stoXpa // (pa pa/( lha spra ༵ [ pasna shā yod/gong gsal gal che'i rgyal khams de dag las gzhan pa'i phyi rgyal dbang 41gas zhig kyang rgya gar la yod pa de ni poracagis dbang shugs de red/ poracugal gyi mi rigs 'ga' shas 3 lo 1498 lor rgya gar du 'byor zhing / de tshor/ lho phyogs bī:bur gyi sulhan gyi lag pa nas golnga zhes pa'i sa khul de blangs nas de gar dbang sgyur byed bzhin yod pa red/ srid don gyi gnas stangs de 'dra zhig gi skabs bābar gyis rgya gar la dbung 'jug byas pa red/
86 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/bābar gyis rgya gar la dpung 'jug btsan 'dzul thengs lnga byas shing / thengs lnga pa'i skabs khos phye lo 1525 lor 54pata zer ba'i sa gnas su e'i3m loX pham par byas te bsad pa red/ dmag 'khrug gi mthar bābar gyis dzispri dang / āgarā gnyis 'dzin bzung bya ched dmag dpung khag gnyis btang / khos rang nyid bādashāha ste 7gong ma yin pa'i dril sgrag byas/ kho'i dpung dmag tshos dersā dang / āgarā 'dzin gzung byas/ bābar kho rang nyid delngi la 'byor/ der brten pāsmyupata'i g.yul des rgya gar la rgyal rgyud gsar pa zhig ngo sprod byas pa red/ de skabs bābar smi dbang 'og tu yod pa'i rgya gar de'i nang panāb dang / disnya dang āgarā'i nye khul gyi sa gnas khag tshud yod/ de rjes khos rgya gar du bsdad nas rgyal khams rgya skyed gtong rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa red/kho phyi rgyal ba zhig yin pas rgya gar la ngo rgol byung ba red/ der brten khos pāXpata'i dmag 'khrul rjes rgya gar la dngos gnas dbang sgyur byed pa'i go skabs byung yod pa red/ khos aphaspyan gyi gzhung zhabs pa tsho dang / nyirdu tsho la yang dbang sgyur thub pa byung yang / rā46ta'i rgyal khams tshogs pa des kho la ngo rgol byas pa red/ tshogs pa de'i mgo khrid rwarngas:ma sihas byed kyi yod pa dang / rgyal khams tshogs pa de'i nang rgyal po che ba bdun dang / chung ba dgu dang / mi dpon brgya dang bzhi yod pa red/ rārā la rta dmag brgyad khri dang / glang chen gyi dmag lnga brgya yod pa red/bābar gyis rā6sa bābar la rolas ram bya rgyu khas blangs pa la sor gnas ma byas pas de la ya lan sprod 'dod byas pa dang / phyi lo 1527 lor khrinalnga zhes pa'i g.yul sa ru gdong thug byung zhing / bābar gyis chang rag spong rgyu'i dam bca' byas/ dmag mi tsho la sems shugs skyed par byas te bābar gyi mugal dmag mi tshos
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs sprebyung ba brjod pa/ 87dpa' ngar chen pos 'dzings pa na rā45ta tsho pham par byas/ dmag 'khrug des bābar gyi rgyal khri brtan po bzos pa yon par byung rabs mkhas pa tshos brjod/ de nas khos dmag 'khrug 'ga' shas brgyabs te mnga' ris rgya skyed byas/ phyi lo 1530lor bābar gyi mnga' ris kyon ni nub phyogs su okasas (0553) gtsang po'i bar dang / shar phyogs su :ghanā gtsang po'i bar dang / byang phyogs su ri bo gangs can bar dang / lho phyogs su bāliyar bar du khyab yod pa yin/ rgya gar gyi mi drag tsho'i bsam par bābar de nyid rgya gar du rgyu nor mang po 'phrog bcom byas te phyir log 'gro gi red snyam pa byung yang des de ltar ma byas par rgya gar du sdod rgyu'i thag gcod byas/khos rang nyid 7gong ma'i mtshan gnas bzhes pa yin zhing / sulhan gyi ming khas ma blangs te/ sulhan 'es pa de 'o rang gi che ba'i gnas stangs las dma' ba yin par ngos 'dzin byas/ 'on kyang kho yun ring sdod khoms ma byung bar phyi lo 1530 lor glo bur du 3 las 'das pa red/ kho rgya gar du lo bzhi las sdod longs ma byung zhing /lo bzhi'i ring drag po'i las don lam lhong dang ldan par byung ba red/nyumālha/bābar gyi bu rgan shos nyumālha yin zhing / de phyi lo 1508 lor ༷bul la skyes shing / de'i ming dngos gnas nusaru dran muhamad yin/ kho'i mi che'i skor dang po ga 'dra yin min zhib gsal shes ma thub/ phyi lo 152041527 bar khos mang 'a sde zhig gi sred skyong gi las 'gan blangs pa dang / 1522—1527 nang pāXpata dang / khrinalnga gnyis kyi g.yul sar dmag 'khrug nang zhugs/ phyo lo 1530 lor bābar grongs pa na kho khri la 'khod/
88 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/humaswā gi pha bābar gyis rgya gar gyi sa yul rgya chen po la dbang sgyur gyis mugal rgyal rgyud kyi 'dzugs skrun byas kyang mnga' ris de la dgra bo rnams las srung skyob kyi gra sgrig 'thus tshang byed ma khom par ñtsha lar/ 'das pa'i rkyen gyis huma'i la thog ma nas dka' ngal mang por gdong len byed dgos byung ba red/ mugal rgyal po 'khor bcas rgya gar du bslebs nas yun ring ma phyin pas de tsho'i gnas stangs brtan po bzo bar dka' ngal gang 'tshams byung / aphaspyan mi rigs kyi 'go khrid tshos da lta yang mugal rnams rgya gar nas phyir 'bud byed cas byas te/ rgyal srid gsar pa de la btsan rgol byed bzhin yod pa red/ gujarātra yi dbang 'dzin pa baspridur shāha zer ba de di5 la btsan rgol byed grab yod pa red/ humaswā la gzhung gi 'dzin skyong dang khral rigs sogs la do snang byed rgyu'i go skabs ma thob par drag las byed dgos byung ba red/ khos 1jarātra dang / mālalha'i mnga' khul rnams len pa la lam lhong byung yang rgya gar nub phyogs su dbang sgyur byed ma thub pa red/ rgya gar shar phyogs su dus skabs der 'dod rngams dang drag shugs shin tu che ba'i aphaXn gyi rgyal po zhig gis dbang 'dzin byed bzhin yod cing / des mugal 7gong ma la sprugs ra bskul bas ma tshad de'i steng rgol 'dzing yang byas pa red/ de ni sherashāha zhes pa de red/sherashāha yis mugal 7gong ma nyumā'i dang mnyam dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis brgyabs par thengs gnyis kur huma3 pham pa red/ der brten mugal rgyal po byang phyogs nas 'gro dgos byung ba dang / panāb dang / kubul la dbang 'dzin mkhan kho'i spun mched kyis humachi la rogs ram byed dgos rgyu yang de ltar ma byas pa red/ bābar gyis dbang du bsdus pa'i mnga' ris de humachi gi lag pa nas shor ba red/ huma'i de nyid sidha dang rāngalhan la sa gnas gcig nas gcig tu 'khyam dgos byung ba red/
le'uganyisapa/ bar ma'i skabasakyi byung babarjod pa/ 89'khyam bzhin pa'i skabs shig la thengs gcig kho a marakoṭa la yod skabs kho la bu gcig skyes pa de nyid rjes su akabar zhes pa'i mtshan thog nas rgya gar gyi 7gong ma chen por gyur pa red/ gang ltar mthar nyumā'i des rgyal srid bzhag nas parashilā la btsan byol du 'gro dgos byung ba red/ der brten gnas skabs rgya gar du mugal rgyal srid kyu bar mtshams chad pa dang / aphaspyan rigs kyi sheraXha suri rgyal rgyud kyis phyi lo 1540 nas 1555 bar du rgya gar byang phyogs su dbang bsgyur ba red/sherashāha/sheraXha zer ba de aphaspyan mi rigs sur zer ba'i dpon po hasan zhes pa'i bu yin zhing / hasan ni dzonabur srid skyong 'og tu sprihār gyi sāhārām zhes pa'i gzhis ka gcig gi dpon po yin pa red/ sherashāha de'i rtsa ba'i ming ni 3lngad yin pa red/des sa khul rgya chen por dbang bsgyur te drag po'i dpung dmag stobs chen po bzos pa'i rjes rang nyid mnga' khul de'i dbang 'dzin pa rang dbang rang btsan yin pa'i dril bsgrags byas/ gong du bshad pa ltar hunāswā pham par byas te rgya gar byang phyogs kyi 7gong mar gyur/ de ni kho'i lam lhong gi rtse mtha' de yin la/ khos rgya gar gyi rgyal po byed rgyu tsam zhig ma yin par 'dzin skyong byed mkhan mkhas pa zhig yong rgyu'i 'dod pa byas par ma zad sngar sulhan a.ā u②na gyi srid byus kyis yid 'phrogs shing / lhag par de'i dmag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs byed tshul dang sa khral sdu tshul sogs kyi srid byus la dga' po byung /der brten kho rgyal por gyur ba dang thog mar dmag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs gsar bzo dang / dmag shugs che ru btang / dmag dpon tshor phogs 'char
90 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/can rgyun sprad de de tsho sems khengs par byas/ de ltar des 'dzin skyong tshags tshud byas/ sherashāha ni rgya gar du zhi ba'i 'dzin skyong ngam zhi ba'i srid gzhung gi rnam pa gsal btod byed mkhan gyi kha che'i rgyal po zhig yin zhing / kho'i 'dzin skyong de gzhan la phan pa'i bdag nyid cig red/ gal srid mi su zhig la dka' rnyog byung na de sherashāha yi rtsar phyin nas de la zhu chog gi yod pa red/ byas tsang kho mi mang tshos shin tu dga' po byed sa zhig tu chags pa red/ so so'i gzhung zhabs las byed pa rnams la gziḍa rtogs ched phan tshun phebs skyod gnang gi yod cing / zhing pa tsho las so nam kyi khral mang po bsdu len mi 'byung ched khral bsdu len la gzigs rtogs gzab gzab gnang gi yod pa red/ sa zhing la tshad 'jal nas sa khral gtan 'bebs byas yod pa red/sherashāha yis bzo skrun byas pa'i 'grul lam la kho rang gis spobs pa byed kyi yod pa red/ lam gyi g.yas g.yon la bsil grib can gyi shing sdong btsugs pa dang /khron pa gsar brus byas shing / 'grul pa tsho'i ched ngal gso khang bzos yod pa red/rgya gar byang phyogs su sngon rmorwa'i 7gong mas bzos pa'i rgya lam de la bzo bcos byas pa sogs 'dzugs skrun rgya che byas/sherashāha de rgyal po chen po zhig yin yang stabs ngan pa zhig la cu'i che ring po ma byung zhing lo lnga las sred 'dzin ma thub par spru lo 1545 lor dmag gar kho'i gdong par me mda' gad nas rkyen ngan gyis shi ba red/ de'i rjes su kho'i bu gzhon pa jalal tshon gyis phyi lo 1545 nas 1553 bar srid bzung/ de'i rjes de'i bu lo na ma lon pa pherodza dang / de bsad nas mubaredza khun gyis phyi lo 1556 bar srid bzung / 'on kyang sherashāha shi ba'i rjes kho'i rjes 'jug pa tshos 'dzin skyong yag po byed ma thub pa dang / phan tshun nang tshag 'dzing reg byas pas rgyal srid nyams rgyud
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 91du gyur pa red/sherashāha mgyogs por sho ba des humaswā la to skabs yag po zhig thob nas des dirsā'i gser khri de slar thob pa'i thabs shes byas pa red/ parashilā'i rgyal po sa54khri'i rgyal rgyud kyis roḍa rams byas pa la brten nas humaswā gis kraṅgār blangs te ༷bul la slar yang dbang 'dzin byas pa red/ ༷bul la rmang gzhi byas nas phyi lo 1555lor pañtsab blangs nas di: dang āgarā la yang bskyar dbang byas pa red/ de ltar rgya gar la mugal 7dong ma'i rgyal srid slar gso byung ba red/ de lta na yang rgyal srid slar gso byung ba'i bde ba de lo gcig las myang ma thub par kho shi ba red/ phyi lo 1556 lor nyin gcig dgongs mo kha che'i smon lam gyi rjes su skas 'dzeg nas 'bab bzhin pa'i skabs skas 'dzeg las lhung nas shi ba red/sneakabar (phyi lo 155641605)gong du bshad pa ltar nyumālha de btsan byol du 'khyam bzhin pa'i gnas skabs shig la kho amarakoṭa zer ba'i sa gnas la yod skabs 3 lo 1542 lor sras gcig 'khrungs pa de akabar yin pa red/ phyi lo 1556 lor yab dgongs pa rdzogs pa na khong mugal 7dong ma'i khri la 'khod pa red/ de dus khong dgung lo btsu gsum yin pa red/ akabar la phug ron gnam la 'phur 'jug pa dang / gzig gi rngon byed rgyu la dga' po yod red/ slob sbyong la dag 'dod chen po yod pa ma red/'on kyang dran pa'i nus pa shin tu che zhing / gzhan la dpe deb klog bcug nas nyan rgyu la dga' po byed/ khong dgung na shin tu chung bas khong gi dge rgan lta bu beram khyan zer ba des rgyal srid la lta rtogs byas/ akabar gyis rgyal srid tshul bzhin skyong
92 'phagasayulagyi byung babarjod pa/thub pa ma byung bar du yul gyi gnad don dang / 'dzin skyong dang / drag po dmag gi 'gan khur tshang ma traram khyan gyis blangs pa red/'phags yul byang du mugal tsho'i rgyal srid brtan po bzo ba'i go skabs nyumālha la ma thob pas las don de akabar gyi ched du lus yod pa red/ 'thab 'dzing thog ma de 9swā dang mnyam du byed dgos byung zhing / 9myu zer ba de aphaXn gyi rigs kyi dmag dpon zhig yon la/ de yang sherashāha yi rjes 'dzin mubaredza zhes pa ming gzhan gardul shāha zer ba de'i blon po yin zhing / sherashāha'i srid yun ring des rang gi gnas sta ngas mthon por bzos yod pa zhig red/ gang ltar helha dang akabar gyi dpung dmag tsho'i bar phyo lo 1556 lor pāXpata yi dmag sar dmag 'khrug byung bar nyemyu la pham nyes byung ba red/ dmag 'khrug 'di la 54pata'i dmag 'khrug gnyis pa zer gyi yod pa red/ de dus akabar dgung na chung bas theram khyan gyis dbung dmag gi dbu 'khrid gnang yod pa nges/ dmag 'khrug de'i rjes rgya gar byang phyogs su musal tsho'i srid dbang brtan po bskyar du tshugs pa red/ akabar dgung na lon pa na khong gis zeram khyan gyi lag nas chab srid gyi 'gan tshang ma bzhes pa red/dirsā dang / āgarā la so so'i gnas stangs brtan po bzos te khong gis sa gnas gzhan dag khag la mnga' ris rgya skyed gnang rgyu'i thag gcod gnang ba red/ long gis 1legar dang / ajamer dang / dzonabur sogs grong khyer dang / rdzong gal chen po khag dbang du bsdu ba'i las don gnang bar ma zad myalanywa yang mnga' 'og tu bcugder brten akabar de nyid rā46ta tsho'i khyim mches su gyur pa red/akabar gyis khra che'i chos ston pa khag dang / kha che'i dmag spre tsho la yid ches ha cang chen po ma gnang bar rā46ta tsho dang / hi: tsho dang grogs po'i mdza'
le'u gnyisapa/ b.rama'i bas spre byung ba brjod pa/ 93'brel gang gzab gnang ba red/ rang gi nang mi tsho dang / rā46ta yi nang mi 'dra min bar gnyen 'dun byas te de tsho dang mdza' 'brel gyi thabs shes gnang ba red/der ma zad khong rang gis kyang hiX'i rgyal po'i sras mo mang po btsun mor bzhes te de tsho dang gnyen 'brel byas/ rā46ta tsho dang nye 'brel dang mdza' grogs kyi srid byus de las khong gi gnas stangs shin tu brtan por gyur/ khong gis rā46ta sogs hi: tsho srid gzhung gi go gnas mthon por bsko bzhag gnang ba dang / de tsho'i nang nas gal che shos dang rje la gus pa'i dpon rigs rāju mānasiha lta bu rnams rā46ta rgyal po red/ akabar la ngo rgol byed mkhan rāṇa blo〉pa lta bu'i rā46ta gzhan mang po dang dmag 'khrug byed dgos pa byung / ra9tha5ra dang / citor lta bu'i rlangasprun 9 mkhar rdzong shin tu btsan po de dag kyang akabar gyis blangs pa red/ akabar gyis rgya gar yongs rdzogs rgyal khab gcig yin par bsam nas rgya gar yongs rdzogs la dbang sgyur byed rgyu'i 'dod pa byung / der brten rgya gar gyi mnga' khul khag tu dmag dpung btang nas sa khul rnams rang gi mnga' ris su bsdu ba'i 'bad rtsol byas pa na (jarāto mnga' khul dbang du bsdus/ sa gnas de ga'i mtsho 'gram gru kha khag nas arab dang / nub gling yuropa ayau yul /bag dang tshong 'brel chen po yod pa red/de'i rjes su baṅgāl yang akabar gyi mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ sa khul de dang lho shar yeshilā dang / rgya nag sogs bar tshong 'brel chen po yod pa red/phyi lo 1595 bar akabar gyis kāshasmyur dang / rshadha dang / uris dang /rgya gar dbus dang aphaXnistun gyi sa gnas kund+rar bcas dbang du bsdus te/ dbus yeshilā dang / par yā dang mnyam 'brel lam gag po 'dzugs thub pa byung ba red/rgya gar gyi shar khul lngasām dang / lho phyogs phyed gling gi rgyal khams rnams rang
94 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/dbang rang btsan yin/ akabar gyis lho phyogs su dbang sgyur byed 'dod shugs cher ma byas kyang / khong gis bsam par lho phyogs su dbang sgyur byas na rgya gar yongs rdzogs la dbang byed thub par bsam nas gnyamad nagar gyi thog btsan rgol byas shing lo brgyad rjes sa gnas der dbang sgyur byed thub pa byung / lo de ga tsam 'dor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni skabs der lho phyogs kyi rgyal khams tshang mas mugal rgyal po'i kha gtad du nus stobs gang yod bton pa red/ de lta na yang mthar khyan desha dang / b.rār dang / ahamad nagar gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig mugal 7gong ma'i mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa red/ de nas lho phyogs su goduwarā ste chu bo ba sbyin ma zhes pa'i 'gram bar du mugal 7gong ma'i mnga' ris rgya skyed byung ste/ akabar de nyid 'phags yul gyi sa cha'i cha mang che ba'i bdag po 7gong ma chen po zhig tu gyur pa red/mugal 7gong ma chen po akabar gyi 'dzin skyong de ni mig dper 'os pa'i 'dzin skyong zhig yon zhing / khong gis blon chen lhan tshogs dang / dpon rigs tsho'i brgyud nas 'dzin skyong byed kyi yod kyang / dbang cha tshang ma yod pa ni 7gong ma rang nyid gcig bu yin pa red/ khong gi rgyal khab de mnga' sde mang po bgos yod cing khong gi sku che'i ring mnga' ris de la mnga' sde bco lnga yod par bshad/ mnga' sde rnams gzhung zhes pa khag tu bgos shing / gzhung de rnams rdzong khag lta bur bgos pa dang / de yang mthar grong gseb khag tu bgos/ gzhung zhabs dpon rigs rnams sa gnas gcig rang la yun ring gnas pa yin 3 des gzhan la mnar sbyong byed srid par ma zad de nus shugs chen por 'gyur ba sogs yong srid pas gzhung zhabs pa rnams sa gnas gcig rang la ma bzhag par gnas spo byed kyi yod pa red/ sulhan tsho'i skabs blon chen khag dang / gzhung zhabs che khag rnams la dbang cha shin tu
le'uganyis pa/ b.rama'i skabasagyi byung babarjod pa/ 95chen po yod pas de tshos 'dod pa ltar gzhung don byed kyi yod na yang / akabar skabs de ltar ma yin par 7gong ma rang nyid stobs shugs shin tu chen por gyur pa red/mugal rgyal sred la yong 'bab kyi khungs gtso che ba gnyes ni/ sa zhing las bsdus ba'i sa khral dang / tshong don gyi khral gnyis red/ grong gseb sa khul so so'i thon skyed mi 'dra bar ma zad rtag par thon skyed gcig pa min par skabs re thon skyed legs la skabs re zhan pas sa zhing gi khral yang de mtshungs bsdu len dgos par gzigs nas akabar gyis thon skyed mang nyung la ltos pa'i khral bsdu len dgos pa dang de'i :sa khra yig cha rgyas par 'god rgyur nan tan byas/ sa zhing thon skyed kyi gsum cha gcig khral du bsdu len byas/ khral de yang dngul thog nas len rgyur gtsor 'don byed/tshong las la sa zhing lta bu'i yong 'bab med na yang / baṅgāl dang / grujarātra la sogs pa nas tshong khral yag po thob kyi yod pa dang / rgya gar gyi mtsho 'gram gyi gru kha khag nas phyi yul du tshong zog btang ba las yong 'bab chen po byung / de dus rgya gar gyi rma tsho 'gram khag tu gru gzings 'bab tshugs chen po khag yod pa yin/ rgya gar gyi tshong pa tshos ras cha dang / mthing / zi tsha dang / sman sna sogs phyo yul khag tu 'tshong gi yod pa red/rgya mtsho'i brgyud kyi tshong 'brel gyi skor nub gling yuropa pa'i mi mang po akabar gyi drung du bcar ba'i nang nas mang po zhig gis yul du tshong las byed pa'i bka' yi gnang ba 'thob pa'i don du yong ba red/ por4gi mi rigs tshos rgya gar du sngar nas tshong gi basmi gnas btsugs zin pa de dag dang mnyam rgya gar nub phyogs mtsho 'gram gyi tshong pa tsho dang mnyam du tshong las byed kyi yod pa red/ khong tshor kho skyed chen po byung ba de la dbyin rdzas phrag dog byas/ der brten nas dbyin ji'i tshong pa 'ga' shas
96 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/kyis akabar las tshong byed chog pa'i zhu ba phul yod 'dug kyang / akabar gyis nubphyogs pa'i tshong pa mang po de tsam la tshong las kyi gnang ba sprod 'dod ma gnang ba red/akabar de nyid ni slob sbyong med pa zhig yin zhing / de lta na yang dpe deb zabmo khag rgyus yod cing yon tan yag po zhig thob pa'i don du dus tshod mang po btang gnang ba red/ khong gis dpe deb shin tu mang po gzhan la klog tu bcug nas gsanpar byed cing / mtshan nyid pa rnams dang / mkhas pa khag dang / 'bri rtsom la mkhas pa rnams dang bgro gleng byed kyi yod pa red/ khong snyan ngag la dga' po yod pa dang / snyan ngag gi tshogs bcad mang po skyor chog chog yod pa red/ phyi 'byung ba'i tshan rig la do snang chen po yod pa red/akabar gyi rgyal khab kyi gzhung skad ni parashipa'i skad yin la/ khong gis sakṛta legs sbyar gyi skad nas dpe deb mang po parashilā'i skad du sgyur bcug pa red/dper na rgyal po dga' byed kyi rtogs brjod dang / rgya gar chen po'i gtam rgyud sogs parashilā'i skad du bsgyur yod 'dug de ltar byed mkhan mkhas pa mang po la bya dga' gsol ras ba375/ mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis legs sbyar skad du rgyal po'i mdzad pa bris shing / hiX'i skad nang snyan ngag rtsom mkhan mang po byung yod 'dugrol dbyangs la mkhas pa mang po byung ba'i nang snyan grags che ba tanasen zer ba de rgyal po'i khrims ra'i nang gi 'thus mi red/ der ma zad khong gi khrims rar ri mo la mkhas pa yang mang po yod 'dugskabs der dpe deb rnams shing gi lo ma'am shun pa'i thog ma yin par shog gru'i steng 'bri srol yod/ spyir btang shog gru ni thog mar rgya nag la bzo 'don byas pa yin zhing de nas nub yeshilā la phyir 'tshong byed kyi yod pa red/ yesdu'i dus rabs
le'u gnyisapa/ bar ma'iskabs kyibyung ba brjodapa/ 97btsu bzhi pa'i nang bar du rgya gar gyi tshong pa tshos shog swā nang 'dren byas shing de nas rgya gar du yang bzo 'don byas pa yin zhes lo rgyus nang gsal yang / shog gru'i rigs 'di rgya gar la ga dus bzo 'don byas yod min da dung gsal shes ma byung bas dpyad dgos par snang / gang ltar de skabs dpe deb rnams lag 6 sa 'bri srol yod/ rgya nag dang nub gling du par khang gi srol dar zin yod kyang rgya gar la de skabs par khangdar med pa 'dra/ lag pas 'bri ba de la dus tshod mang po 'gor zhing / par khang nas par brgyabs pa nang bzhin grangs mang po yang 'bri mi thub pa gsal po red/ de skabs parashilā'i dpe deb rnams parashilā'i yi ge mdzes po khag nang 'bri srol dang /hi: dang sakṛta dpe deb rnams ni spyir btang rgya gar byang phyogs kyi yi ge dewanukarī ste lha'i grong gi yi ge'i nang 'bri srol yod pa red/akabar bhee ring khang bzo'i rig pa yang khyad du 'phags pa byung ste di5 dang āgarā la khong gi khrims ra 'tshogs kyi yod pa dang / 'on kyang āgarā la rgyal sa bzo bar thag bcad de der grong khyer gsar pa bzos shing / de la phartaṅgāpār sekarī zhes 'bod cing deng dus āgarā'i nye 'gram du yod/ der rdo dmar po'i pho brang mdzes po zhig bzos shing / khang bzo'i lag rtsal de la parasho.ā dang / dbus yeshilā dang /rgya gar gyi khang bzo'i reg pa 'dres pa lta bu zhig yod/ rang gi yab kyi bang so zhig disnya la bzhings yod pa de yang ngo mtshar ba yod/gakabar la akabar chen po zhes bya ste/ khong la chen po zhes 'bod pa de mnga' ris rgya skyed chen po mdzad pa tsam gyis ma yin par de ni khong gi chos kyi srid byug sam chos kyi bsam tshul mtho bas khong la chen po zhes 'bod pa yin par nges/akabar ni kha che mgo mkhregs gcig ma yin zhing / dgung na lon pa dang rim bzhin
98 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjodapa/khong gi chos mpi bsam tshul la 'gyur ba byung yod pa red/ de yang khong gi btsun mo hoḥ'i chos lugs byed mkhan tshos khong la 'gyur ba chen po byung ba red/ der brten khong gis mnga' ris yongs su chos kyi srid byus la 'gyur ba chen po btang ba dang / sa gnas tshang ma dang mi tshang ma la bden pa'i cha shas rang chas su yod par ngos 'dzin gnang / phyo lo 1563 lor thog mar gnas skor gyi khral zhes pa de med par bzos pa dang de rjes 1564 lor ngadzi.ā zer ba'i chos khral sdang zug can de yang med par bzos/ de las khong gi mnga' 'bangs su mi ser tshang mar thob dbang 'dra mnyam du gyur pa red/ de nas rim bzhin kha che ma yin pa'i chos lugs khag la do dam dgag bya byas pa tshang ma med par bzos te yishu'i mchod khang dang / rgya gar gyi lha khang bzhengs skrun sogs la rang dbang sprad/ kha che'i mdun sar spyi tshogs su hiḥ'i mchod pa dang dus chen sogs byed mi chog pa'i khrims de dag tshang ma med par bzos pas ma tshad khong rang gi pho brang nang du btsun mo tshos lha sku bzhings pa dang de dag la mchod pa sogs byed pa'i chog mchan gnang yod pa red/ der ma zad khong gis kha che'i chos lugs su btsan dbang gis bsgyur mi chog pa bzos shing / sngar btsan dbang gis kha cher bsgyur ba rnams slar hiḥ'i chos lugs su zhugs chog pa yang bzos phyi lo 1603 lor yishu rnams la so so'i 'dod mos kyis zhugs chog par bzos kha che'i chos de rgyal khab kyi chos yin pa'i gnas stangs de med par bzos nas chos 4tshe tshang ma gcig mtshungs su bsgyur ba red/ mang mos can gyi hiḥ'i chos lugs pa tsho'i dad 'dun dang / grus rtsi mtshon pa'i ched du rgyal po'i gsol thab khang du glang sha za mi chog pa'i bka' gnang ba dang / lo re'i nang nyi ma mang por gsol thab nang dud 'gro gsod mi chog par bzos gnang / khong rang gis phal cher sha za rgyu spangs
le'u gnyis pa/ b.rama'i skabs kyibyung babarjod pa/ 99pa lta bur mdzad de rgya gar gyi chos lugs dang 'brel ba'i dngos po du ma dang gyon chas mang po dang du blangs/ khong rang nyid rgya gar gyi chos 'brel dus chen khag la zhugs nas phebs pa sogs mdzad/ khong gis kha che'i chos las gzhan pa'i chos lugs khag la zhabs tog chen po zhug yod/ der brten khong gis chos lugs la bzod bsran nam chos dad rang dbang gi srol chen po btod gnang ba red/gakabar gyis kha che dang hi: gnyis ka gcig mtshungs gyis gzhung zhabs su bskos shing / drag po'i dpung dmag nang hoḥ khyon chen po btsugs/ hiḥ'i chos lugs pa tsho'i kha mchu thag gcod ched bram ze rnams khrims dpon du bskos pa red/akabar gyis chos lugs tshang mar rang dbang thob thang 'dra mnyam sprad nas gus bkur byas kyang / sngar srol khrims lugs dang mi mthun pa'i lugs srol rnams la dgag bya yang gnang yod pa dper na/ byis pa'i chang bza' zhes pa'i khrus pa lo na ma lon par chang bza' rgyag rgyu'i srol ngan de la dgag bya byas shing / hiḥ'i bud med rnams rang gi kyo ga shi ba'i dur me'i nang gson sreg byed pa satu zhes pa'i srol ngan de rma chog pa'i bka' gnang / der ma zad hiḥ'i bud med yug sa lus pa rnams slar yang chang bza' rgyag chog pa'i skul ma gnang ba sogs spyi tshogs la legs bcos gang thub gnang yod/akabar gyis chos lugs lta bu bsam tshul gsar pa zhig gi srol gtod gnang ba de la dīn e i.ā& zhes brjod/ de ni khong gis chos lugs 9 mkhas pa rnams dang bgro gleng gis chos lugs tshang ma'i grub mtha' legs pa rnams phyogs bsgril gnang ba lta bu zhig red/ chos lugs de sgrig 'dzugs legs par ldan pa'i lta grub la gzhi byas pa zhig ma yin la/ dkon mchog sogs kyis gnang ba sbyin pa yang ma yin par de ni
100 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/spyi tshogs la legs bcos dang / kun spyod bzang du gtong thabs byas pa lta bu zhig red/ byis pa'i gnyen mdun dang / sha nye rus nye tsho'i bar phan tshun gnyen mdun byed pa dang / dbang yod kyis sa3 (gyo ga'i ro dang mnyam dur mer mchongs pa )byed du 'jug pa sogs 'gog pa dang / khyo shug re re'i lugs srol bu rgyu dang /kun spyod gtsang ma byed rgyu dang / sho sbag dang / chang rag la dam drag dang /chang rag nyo tshong la yang dam drag dang / yug sa mo tshor slar yang khyo ga dang gnyen mdun byed rgyu dang / sems can 3 srog la gnod skyon mi byed pa sogs la shugs brgyabs gnang ba red/chos lugs 'di ni chos lugs tshang ma'i bsam tshul legs shog rnams phyogs bsdug byas shing / 'jig rten yongs khyab kyi bzod bsran la gzhi byas pa zhig yin zhing chos lugs 'di ltar na sha za mi chog pa red/ khong gi chos lugs des kha che dang hi( su la'ang dga' po ma byung bar ma zad khong grongs pa'i rjes su nub pa red/dngos 'brel byas na gakabar gyi bsam tshul de shin tu nas legs shing rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yin pas khong gi chos lugs de tshang mas khas len bya rgyu yang /khong gis rang gi rtsa ba'i chos lugs kha che'i chos ma dor 'ong / kha che yin par 'dod bzhin du kha che'i chos dang ma mthun pas kha che tshos dga' po ma byas tshod/ kha che'i mi zhig gis hiḥ'i sngar srol mang po la dgag bya dam drag byas pas hi( tsho yang dga' po ma byung / der brten khong gi chos dad gsar pa de yun ring ma gnas pa red/ 'on kyang khong dpa' mdzangs dang snying stobs shin tu che bas khong gi sku che'i ring sus kyang ngo rgol byed ma nus par nges/ der brten rgya gar 9 sred blon dam pa naharus gakabar ni rgya gar gyi rgyal gces pa tsho'i pha mes lta bu zhig red ces gsungs yod pa
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs gyi byung babarjodapa/ 101red/ phyi lo 1605 lor akabar gyi sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs shing / khong gi smyu phung de nyid āgarā'i nye 'gram du khong rang gis de snga nas bzo skrun gnang ba'i sikadarā zhes pa'i bang so'i nang sbas pa red/ bang so de ni rgyal po chen po de yi che ba'i rtags mtshan lta bu zhig yin/ mugal 7gong ma chen po akabar de ni kha che'i rgyal po tsho'i nang nas chos srid gnyis thad nas legs shos yin par gdon mi za'o//ngahāXr/ (phyi lo 160541627)ngahādīr ni akabar gyi sras yin zhing yab bzhugs pa'i ring khong gawadha dang baṅgāl gyi srid skyong du bskos/ 1605 lor yab dgongs pa rdzogs pa na 7gong ma'i khrir 'khod/spyir btang rgyal po 'di'i ring zhi bde gnas 'jam du gnas shing dmag 'khrug chen po ma byung / baṅgāl du mugal rgyal po'i dbang cha shugs che ru btang zhing / yab kyis melhar gyi rgyal po mahārāṇa dang 'khrug zing byas pa de da cha 'go mnan nas med par bzos/ panāb kyi ri khul sa gnas su dmag mi btang ste kāgarā'i khul dbang du bsdus/ gahamad nagar gyi rtsod rnyog de dka' ngal che tsam de bar byung na'ang / rgyal po 'dis darka/'a ngal de med par bzos/ de dag la brten nas aphaXn rigs kyai dpon po mugal 7gong ma'i 'og tu 'du 'dod med pa rnams kyang rgyal po 'de'i 'og tu 'du dgos pa byung / de ltar 7gong ma'i mnga' thang rgyas 6 ra mdzad/de lta na yang grahāXr la dka' ngal chen po zhig byung ba ni aphaXnistun du gaṅgār zer ba'i mnga' sde de parashilā'i rgyal pos blangs pa des mugal 7gong ma'i mnga' thang la gyong chen po byung ste mnga' khul de ni nub oshilā'i mnyam du tshong 'brel
102 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/dang / yul gyi srung skyob gnyis thad nas gal che bas de stag gzig (parashilā ) gi rgyal por shor ba des skyon chen po byung ba red/ der ma zad nub gling pa poracugis tshos kyang tshong las dang 'brel ba'i dka' snyog gang 'tshams bzos shing / rgyal pos poracugis rnams kyis rang skyon ngos len ma byas par mugal 7gong ma'i mnga' ris su tshong las byed rgyu'i gnang ba ma sprad pa red/ dus skabs de tsam nas dbyin rdzas rgya gar dang mnyam du tshong 'brel byed 'dod bstan pa de la poracugis tshos ma dga' ba'i phrag dog byas pa red/ ngahāXr gyi skabs dbyin ji rgyal pos sar ṭoms ro zer ba de pho nya'i tshul du āgarā la ja3)ra gyi drung du btang ba des rgyal po dang mnyam du tshong 'brel gyi mthun gros 'jog 'dod byas kyang jaspridīr gyis mos mthun ma byas pa red/gar stums ro de nyid tshogarā la lo gsum bsdad nas khos mugal 7gong ma'i khrims ra'i mi che'i skor bshad pa don dang mthun pa bris 'dugngahāXr la dka' ngal che ba yong gzhi ni nang gi dka' ngal yin zhing / de ni btsun mo dang sras gnyis la thug yod pa red/ phyi lo 1611 lor spyarajaspri zhis pa'i bud med mdzes shing blo gros dang ldan pa zhig btsun mor bzhes pa red/ rim bzhin rgyal po de nyid btsun mo rgyurangahā yis dbang bsgyur byas pas sku sger tsam du ma zad rgyal srid kyi las don tshang ma mo'i dbang 'og tu can pa red/ de la brten nas nang don mi mthun pa'i gnas tshul mang po byung / dzahādīr la sras mang po yod pa'i nang nas shuhangahā zhes pa de stobs che shog su gyur pa dang / de dang rgyurangahā bar mi mthun pa chen po byung ba na jigāṅgār gyis rang gi bu la bkod dbang bsgyur ma thub par de tsho nang tshag 'khrug 'dzing chen po byas te/ mthar sras gzhan rnams dang rgyal po dang btsun mo bcas pham par byas te shānyagrahā la rgyal kha thob pa red/
le'u gnyis pa/ bar ma'i skabs kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 103ngahāXr gyis rang gi yab akabar ltar spyi tshogs la legs bcos dang chos lugs kyi bzod bsran sogs gyi thabs shes byas kyang yab lta bu'i blo gros chen po med pas lam lhong ma byung tshod/ 'on kyang khong la rig gzhung la dang zhen chen po yod cing / slob sbyong yag po byas yod 'dug khong ri mo'i lag rtsal la dga' po yod 'dug phyi lo 1628 lor khong 3 las 'das shing / sngar nas thag chod zin pa ltar khong gi sras shāhangahā khri la 'khod pa red/shānyajahū/ (phyi lo 162841658)rgyal po 'di ni phyi lo 1628 lor yab ñtsha las 'das rjes khri la 'khod pa dang / rgyal po 'di ni 'dzam gling na mdzes pa'i dpe mtshon byed 7jamanyal zer ba'i bang so dang / tattahā.ās zhes pa'i gser khri skad grags chen po de gnyis ni tshang mas dran gso bya yul yin zhing / tujamanyal ni khong gi btsun mo mumatuja zhes pa'i phung po sbas sa'i steng rdo kumuru pas bzos pa'i bang so skad grags can de yin pa dang /taṅgātu.us zer ba'i gser khri la rin po che'i phra rgyan bkod pa srid na dkon pa de'i thog shāhangahā bzhugs kyi yod pa red/rgyal po 'di'i ring gnas tshul gal che gzhan yang byung ste/ de dag gis mugal 7gong ma'i rgyal srid kyi byung rabs la gal chen por ñtsa/ rgyal sar 'khod rjes thog mar budelakhaṭa dang snyo phyogs kyi ngo rgol la gdong len byed dgos byung zhing / budelakhaṭa yis ngo log byas pa de las sla por mgo gnon thub kyang / lho phyogs nas ngo log byung ba de las sla por mdo gnon ma thub/ 'on kyang mthar ahamad nagar dbang du bsdus te mnga' khul de blangs/ tolakuṭā dang / bīḥpur mnga' khul gyis mugal
104 'phagasayulaca byungab brjod pa/7gong ma'i chab 'bangs su bas blangs nas zhi bde'i mthun gros bzhag shārnyajaspri yis rang gi sras charagajeb zhes pa de lho phyogs kyi srid skyong du bskos/ de lta na yang golakuṭā dang bīrāpār mnga' khul de gnyis mugal rgyal po'i mnga' ris kyi cha shas rang ma yin par de'i grib 'og lta bu zhig yin nam snyam/lho phyogs kyi dka' ngal bsal rjes rgya gar byang nub kyi mtshams su do snang byas te shānya4gā yis parashilā'am inān gyi rgyal po'i lag nas kraṅgār slar len thub pa byung yang / bskyar du sho ri/ de rjes tshur thob thabs thengs gsum byas kyang don smin ma byung bas mthar 'bad pa ma byas/deng dus kumakata'i nye 'gram nyugarlu sa khul de por4gis tsho'i lag par yod pa de ga'i tra racugis tsho dang yang shāhangahā gyis rgol 'dzing byas/ de yang poracugis tshos baṅgāl gyi sa khul hugarlu la rten gzhi byas te baṅgāl gyi mtsho khug la rgya mtsho'i jag bcom byed kyi yod pa red/ mugal dmag mi tshos de tsho hugazhwa nas phyor 'bud byas/de nas dpung dmag rnams byang shar phyogs su bskyod de lngasām gyi kāmarāpa la dbang bsgyur/rgyal po 'dis mkhar dang bang so mang po bzhings pa'i nang nas rang gi btsun mo'i dran brten bang so 7jamahal zhes pa de ni 'dzam gling nang gi ngo mtshar che shos gras yin/ khong ni mes po gakabar ltar bzod bsran gyi srid byus kyi rjes su 'brang mkhan zhig yin la blo gros che ba'i rgyal po zhig yin pas phrunarsā'i mi rigs yin pa'i de skabs kyi 'grul skyod pa daweranagar (ga'601rsā131) zer bas bshad don/ shānya4gā gyis rang gi mi ser tsho la rgyal po lta bus dbang ma bsgyur bar so so'i nang mi dang phru gru la pha yis dbang bsgyur ba lta bu zhig 'dug ces bris 'dug shānyajaspri gyi

le'u gsumapa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 185de 1855 lor dbyin ji la thim/de bzhin lho phyogs todzor gyi rgyal po shi ba na bu mo gnyis dang btsun mo yug sa ma bcu drug rjes su lus pa na 'phral du dbyin jis tardzar rgyal khams de blangs nas so so'i mnga' 'og tu bcug de bzhin pānu la marlagā'i peXlha grongs pa na 1853lor dbyin jis de yang blangs pa red/der ma zad dirsā'i dbang 'dzin pa ming tsam gyi mugal 7gong ma shāha.ulam de la rgyal po'i mtshan gnas med pa bzo rgyu'i thabs shes byas kyang / dbyin yul du yod pa'i tshong tshogs kyi las khang lte ba'i dbang 'dzin tshogs pas de ltar byed pa'i ngos len ma byas pa red/ nidzām gyi mnga' 'og hu yod pa'i mnga' khul berār zer ba de yang bu lon gyi rtsod rnyog sogs la kha 'dog byas nas 1853 lor dbyin jis blangs te tshong tshogs su thim/de ltar thim pa'i grub mtha' 'am khrims gzhi la brten nas rgya gar gyi rgyal khams sngar dbyin ji'i 'og ma yin pa ji snyed cig dbyin ji'i mnga' 'og tu thim par ma zad gzhung gis srid skyong tshul gag po med pas mi mang la dka' sdug yong gi yod tshul bsnyad nas rgyal khams 'ga' shas ḍalaho: yis blangs pa dper na gawadha yi nalngab lhajid arlu zer ba des gzhung skyong tshul log par byas pas mi mang la dka' ngal sna tshogs byung lugs la bsnyad btags nas nanywab de dbang med du khri las phabs te 1856 zu ba 2 tshos bcu gsum nyin dbyin jis awadha rgyal khams de dbang du bsdus pa dang / nanywab lhajid de mi ñtsha gang po sprulakastu la rgan phogs cung zad blangs nas sdod dgos byung ba red/ awadha'i nalhab de dbyin ji la rtag tu dga' po yod kyang ḍalartozlos de ltar byas pa red/
186 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/awadha dbang du bsdus pa de ḍal)gli yis rgya gar gyi rgyal khams du ma dbang sgyur byed pa'i rim pa tha ma de yin zhing / kho'i srid byus de ni rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams rtsa med du btang ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs shig yin par gdon mi za zhing / 'on kyang dbyin ji la ni srid dbang sogs kyi khe bzang tshod med byung yod cing rgya gar du dbyin ji'i tshong tshogs kyi srid dbang mtho ba'i rtse mor bslebs pa red/de ltar na yang rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran tshang mas de tsho las srid kyi thob dbang phrogs pa'i tshor snang drag po skyes pa sogs gyis mthar 'chad 'gyur ltar 1857 lo'i ngo log zing 'khrug chen po 'byung ba'i rkyen du'ang gyur pa red/ de lta mod kyang āṇḍa ḍalartozlo de nyid rgya gar du btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi srid byug lag len du star mkhan zhig dang rgyal khams dbang du bsdu ba po tsam zhig ma yin par 'dzin skyong tshags tshud byed mkhan zhig dang / rgya gar la deng dus kyi yar rgyas 'dzugs skrun byed pa po zhig kyang yin pa red/ khos baṅgāl du srid skyong spyi khyab kyi las rogs shig bskos pas khong rang gis dbus gzhung gi 'dzin skyong la do snang shugs chen po byed thub pa byung ba dang / baṅgāl me skyog dmag sde'i las khang lte ba de sprulakaX nas meratta la spos shing / sa dmag las khang lte ba de yang shimalā ru spos pa red/ de la brten nas rgya gar dbus dang byang phyogs su tshong tshogs kyis dbang sgyur la shugs thebs pa red/de bzhin khral bsdu phyogs dang / khrims lugs dang / mnga' sde khag gi 'dzin skyong la legs bcos sna tshogs btang nas tshags su tshud pa byas yod pa red/rgya gar du dbyin ji'i tshong don dang dmag don sra brtan gong 'phel du gtong ched kāṇḍa ḍalaho:sa rgya gar du me 'khor gyi 'dzugs skrun byas pa de ni rgya gar la deng dus 9 yar rgyas la phan thogs chen po byung yod pas bsngags par 'os pa zhig red/
le'ugasum pa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 187thog mar balharmā nas sprupa bar 3 lo 1853 lor me 'khor 'grul skyod btsugs pa dang / phyi lo 1854455 nang hawarā nas rānilnga bar dang / de nas 1856 lor mjus ananam bar du me 'khor 'gro skyod kyi lam srol btsugs pa red/de rjes ḍalahoshrī'i rjes 'dzin gzhan tshos me 'khor 'grul lam rgya skyed mu mthud btang bas deng dus rgya gar gyi me 'khor 'grul skyod rgya chen po 'di byung thub pa red/me 'khor 9 lcags lam bting nas me 'khor 'gro skyod kyi las don byas pa des rgya gar du dbyin ji'i dpal 'byor la phan thogs chen po byung ba bshad ma dgos kyang / de las rgya gar gyi yul la phyogs gang thad nas phan thogs shin tu chen po byung yod pa red/ āṇḍa ḍalahoshrī'i dmigs yul ni rgya gar yul gyi chig sgril yong rgyu de ma yin yang / khos rgya gar du me 'khor btsugs pa de las rgya gar yul gyi chig sgril la phan thogs shin tu chen po byung yod pa red/ yul ga 'dra zhig yin rung deng durnga5 dang mthun pa'i gar rgyas 'gro ba ni tshan rig dang 'brel ba'i shes yon dang / 'phrul las dang / 'phrul 'khor gyi 'grim 'grul gyi mthun rkyen nges par dgos pas me 'khor sogs kyi ༷dza sdu pa /shā /rmo ༵ ༵ ༈ /pa ༵ /( ༵༵ /gsar 'dzugs byas pa de yang gal che'i bya ba zhig yin zhing / khos srid skyong spyi khyab byas ring mjus nas bkarmā bar dang / sprulakanā nas bshāwar (deng sang pāṇḍastun la yod )bar le dbar (spyi le )4000 tsam gyi ring tshad kyi smir skud 'then nas spyir gtong len byas pa red/ de yang rgya gar deng dus su sgyur bar gal che'i bya ba gcig yin zhing / dbyin ji kho rang tsho la yang gang ci'i phan khyad byung yod pa red/ḍalaho: yis rgya gar la sbrag las 'dzugs skrun byas pa de yang gal che'i bya ba
188 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/gsum pa de yin zhing / deng dus kyi sbrag las 'go 'dzugs byas te rgya gar yul yongs rdzogs la sbrag gla sogs gcig mtshungs dang sbrag 'dzin sogs gsar 'grems byas shing / kho rang gis srid skyong spye khyab ring rgya gar du sbrag khang bdun brgya lnga bcu nga brgyad tsam sgo phyes nas sbrag pa sogs las byed pa mang po bskos pa sogs byas pa red/kho'i las don rnam pa gsum po de las rgya gar yul du deng dus kyi rnam pa dod pa dang / gcig gyur la phan khyad chen po byung yod/ de skabs rgya gar ba'i hiḥ 'ga' shas kyis me 'khor dang / tur dang / sbrag gsum ni dbyin ji'i dpal 'byor la phan pa tsam ma zad dbyin jis rgya gar du btsan rgyal ring luḍa spel ched yin pa las rgya gar la phan thogs med pa'i skyon brjod byas kyang / de ltar khran par gnas skabs dbyin ji la phan thogs byung yang phugs su rgya gar la phan thogs shin tu nas chen po byung nas phyis su rang dbang gi 'thab rtsod las 'grul la yang me 'khor dang / tur dang / sbrag las phan thogs chen po byung yod/der ma zad āṇḍa ḍalahosmis rgya gar du shes yon la yar rgyas chen po btang ba de ni shin tu nas bsngags par 'os pa zhig red/ khos thabs shes sna tshogs gyis dbyin yul gyi gros tshogs sogs dang 'brel gtugs kyis rgya gar du deng dus kyi shes yon yar rgyas gtong thabs byas pa red/ rgya gar la sngon 'gro'i slob grwa dang / 'bring rim slob grwa dang / mtho rim slob grwa dang / gtsug lag slob khang chen mo sogs 'dzugs skrun byas shing / sger gyi slob grwa 'dzugs skrun la yang rgyud bskul byas yod pa red/gal che'i mnga' sde gsum la gtsug lag slob khang gsum btsugs pa de ni phyi lo 1857 lor sprulakasmi dang / madrus dang / balngashrī gtsug lag slob khang gsum gsar 'dzugs byas pa red/ gtsug lag slob khang chen mo de gsum ni deng dus kyang
le'ugasum pa/ deng dus kyu byung babarjodapa/ 189gal che ba'i shes yon gyi bsti gnas su gnas yod/ de ltar khos rgya gar du shes yon gyi sgrig gzhi bzos nas tshul dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yar rgyas btang zhing / de'i sngon dbyin ji'i skad 'ba' zhig shes yon gyi lam yin yang ḍalaho:sa dbyin ji'i skad tshab tu sa gnas kyi skad so so'i nang shes yon sprod 'go btsugs par ma zad bud med rnams la shes yon slob sbyong gal che bar brtsis pa red/ der brten shes yon slob sbyong gi yar rgyas thad ḍalartozlo de shin tu byas rjes che ba'i srid skyong spyi khyab cig yin pa red/ḍalaho: yi sngon mi mang las don sde tshan zur du med par dmag mi dang mnyam sbrel nas yod kyang ḍalahoshrīs mi mang las don sde tshan de zur du phyes te 'phrul las pa chen mo zhig gi 'og tu bzhag ste/ sde tshan des yur ba dang / zam pa dang /'khor lam sogs bzo skrun byed pa'i 'gan blangs/ de la brten nas zhing chu 'dren pa'i las don yar rgyas btang bas so nam gyi bya ba la yar rgyas chen po byung ba red/ḍalahosmi yis tshong 'brel la yar rgyas btang ba dang / kho ni do dam dang dgag bya med pa'i rang dbang ba'i tshong 'brel la dga' po zhig yin pas 1rāṇi'i gru kha dang / basbra'i dang / zhalakastu dang / raḥn sogs 9 gru kha khag tu legs bcos dang / chu thog gam chu'i brgyud nas dbor 'dren gyi bya ba la yar rgyas btang yod pa red/ shing bal dang / 'gru rigs rnams rgya gar nas dbyin yul du phyir 'tshong shin tu rgya chen po dang ha cang mang du btang yod pa red/ 'ga' shas kyis de ni rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor la bshu gzhog byas pa yin tshul gyi skyon brjod kyang byas yod/rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal khams rgya che chung la dpags nas ḍalaho'i yis drag po dgag gi stobs shugs kyang che ru btang ba dang / sngar bshad zin pa ltar sa dmag las khang lte ba de kulaka1 nas shomalā la spos pa dang / rgya gar gyi dmag mi
190 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/rnams bgo 'grems byed rgyu la gzab gzab byas yod/ kho la gorakhā'i mi tsho'i dmag 'dzing pa'i rtsal la yid ches chen po yod pas gorakhā'i dmag mi mang du btang / de lta na yang nub gling pa'i dmag mi'i grangs nyung du gtong 'dod med par ma zad rgya gar du nub gling pa'i dmag mi mang du btang yod pa red/ḍalaho: yi ngo bo'am rnam pa gal che ba ni/ kho la yon tan nam legs pa'i cha shas mang po yod de/ de la rgyal khams 'dzugs skrun byed thub pa'i 'jon thang yod la/ blo gros sno zhing srid don la mthong rgya chen po yod/ kho thog mar rgya gar du 'byor skabs khos rgya gar gyi skor rtsung zad las shes kyi med rung / dus tshod thung thung zhig nang gnas lugs rnams zhib tu shes thub pa byung / byung rabs pa gtso che ba rnams kyis ḍaladhasmi de 'jon thang shin tu che ba dang / nus shugs can dang / brtson 'grus chen po dang / bsam 'dod la bcos su mi rung ba dang / drang po dang /so so'i yul gyi ched du sha zhen ldan la rgya gar ba'i mi mang tsho'i bde don la do snang chen po zhig red ces bshad yod/ spyir btang kho btsan rgyal ring lugs pa zhig yin yang /gzhan gyi bde don la do snang shin tu chen po yod pas gzhan la phan thogs mang po byung yod/ kho ni 'dzin skyong la tsha po dang / drag shul che bas gzhung gi sde tshan tshang ma las las don 'jon po dang chogs tshud po yong ba'i re 'dod kyang byed 9 yod pa red/de lta med kyang ḍalahosmi'i srid byus de dag la brten nas phyi lo 1857 lor rgya gar du gyen log chen mo zhes pa'i ngo log zing cha chen po de byung ba yin tshul bshad srol yod/1857 gyi gyen log chen po/lān ḍalartogā'i rjes phyi lo 1857 nas 1862 bar āṇḍa dzinisga srid skyong spyi
