le'ugasumapa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 201'di nas spos te mthar phyi lo 1947 lor mjug rdzogs pa yin par go bar bya'o//ngo log gyen lang gi grub 'bras/ phyi lo 1857 lo'i ngo log gyen lang chen po'i grub 'bras gsham gsal ltar/ dang po ni gyen log de las rgya gar srid gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs bskyar du byed dgos byung ba de yin te/ shar rgya gar tshong don tshogs pa'i srid dbang mjug bsdoms byung ba red/ phyi lo 1858 lor dbyin ji'i gros tshogs kyis rgya gar srid gzhung gi khrims gzhi zhes pa gcig bton pa'i sgo nas rgya gar gyi srid gzhung de tshong tshogs gyi lag pa nas dbyin ji'i gzhung gis blangs pa red/de dang lhan rgya gar gyi sred gzhung de'i 'gan tshang ma dbyin ji'i gros tshogs su bslebs pa red/ phyo lo 1858 phyo zu bcu gcig pa'i ches gcig snyan dbyin ji'i rgyal mo khrirtsoriX zhes pa'i mtshan thog nas rgya gar gyi srid gzhung bzhes pa dang / rgya gar du yod pa'i srid skyong spyi khyab la dbyin dzi'i rgyal tshab kyi go gnas kyang sprad cing / sngar dbyin yul du yod pa'i tshong tshogs kyai dbang sgrur lhan tshogs dang / nges ston pa'i lhan tshogs gnyis kyi tshab tu rgya gar las don gyi drung che zhes pa zhig sko bzhag gis des rgya gar gyi srid dbang la gzigs rtogs byas pa red/ngo log gyen lang de dang mnyam rgya gar du dbyin ji'i srid dbang gi le'u gcig rdzogs pa dang / sngar gyi 'dzin skyong gi rnam bzhag thams cad med par gyur pa dang /de yi bar du dbyin ji'i mnga' 'og tu ma bsdus pa lhag ma rnams rang sor bzhag nas dbyin 'og tu ma bsdus/ 'on kyang de tsho'i dngos 'brel gyi rang dbang brlags nas lag len thog dbyin ji'i 'og tu gnas pa lta bur gyur/ rgya gar gyi skor dbyin ji'i srid byus la 'gyur ba chen po byung zhing / de la brten nas rim bzhin rang dbang gi las 'gul 'go tshugs yod pa red/
202 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal srid kyi gzhung /gong du bshad pa ltar phyi lo 1857 lo'i ngo log gyen lang gi rjes su rgya gar du dbyin ji'i srid dbang gi ngo bo gsar pa zhig 'go tshugs pa dang / de nas rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor dang / spyi tshogs dang / gshis rig dang 'brel ba'i mi hnā la 'gyur ba byung ba dang / rgya gar gyi rgyal yongs kyi las 'gul gsar du byung ba red/ dbyin gzhung gis sgyur bcos ga re btang yang de'i dmigs yul ni rgya gar du dbyin ji'i srid dbang brtan du gtong ba dang / ma 'ongs par ngo log gyen lang 'gog pa'i ched yin pa red/ der brten dbyin gzhung gis rang gi srid dbang brtan po bzo ched rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran rnams dang / sger pa khag dang / sa zhing bdag po rnams so so'i phyogs su sgyur ba'i thabs shes byas shing / dbyin snga'i bsam par de tsho'i rgyab skyor las mi mang gi yid ches 'thob klu red bsam pa red/phyi lo 1858 lo'i khrims gzhi dang dbyin ji rgyal mo'i dril bsgrags/phyi lo 1858 6 rla brgyad pa'i nang dbyin ji'i gros tshogs nang rgya gar srid gzhung gi khrims gzhi zhes pa zhig gtan 'bebs byas te zla ba gnyis rjes de la gzhir bzhag pa'i dbyin ji rgyal mo'i dril bsgrags shig byas pa red/ de skabs dbyin yul du 〉〈rilnga zhes pa'i rgyal mo zhig yod pa dang / dbyin yul du gros tshogs kyis srid dbang skyong tshul gar rgyas phyin zin pas srid dbang gi dbang shugs che shos ni gros tshogs la yod cing / des khrims bzo gi yod pa dang / dbyin gzhung de gros tshogs rang la brten yod pa red/ de lta na yang ming tsam gyi ched du rgyal sred kyang gnas yod pas gzhung gi 'dzin skyong ji snyed rgyal po'am rgyal mo'i mtshan thog nas byed
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 203srol yod/ des na rgya gar du dbyin gzhung gi 'dzin skyong yang rgyal mo'i mtshan thog nas byas shing thog ma'i dril bsgrags de yang rgyal 7 'i mtshan thog nas byas/de skabs rgya gar gyi mi tsho'i sems la ngo log gyen lang gi nyes chad lta bur grub 'bras ngan pa da dung yong dogs kyi 'jigs skrag sogs yod pa dang dbyin ji'i mi riḍa tsho la dgra sha len rgyu'i bsam tshor drag po bsdad yod pa de dag la bsam zhib legs byas kyis dbyin ji rgyal mo'i dril bsgrags de gzab gzab byas te bris shing / shin tu mdzes po dang / ming tshog gam brjod tshog gzi brjed dang ldan pa yod pa red/ bshad tshul ltar na dril bsgrags kyi zin bris dang po de rgyal mos phyir slog gnang nas bskyar bris bya dgos tshul gsungs te/ gzhan phanatsho dang / chos lugs la bzod sran dang /bzang spyod kyi tshor ba skyed thub ba'i brjod tshog dang bcas dril bsgrags bya dgos zhes bka' gnang ba red/ ces bshad srol 'dugrnang ltar phyo lo 1858 lor phyo rla brtsu gcig pa'i ches gcig nyin dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab lo9 kuni gis ṇḍa.ātarsād la rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran rnams dang / me mang bcas kyi tshogs 'du dmigs bsal zhig bskongs nas dbyin ji rgyal mo'i dril bsgrags sgrog byang byas pa red/ dril bsgrags kyi don tshan mdor bsdus gaphunaskyob ga'595 ltar/don tshan dang po ni/ shar rgya gar tshong las tshogs pas 'dzin skyong byas pa'i rgya gar gyi mnga' khul rnams kyi srid gzhung de rgyal mo smi6riXs bzhes kyi yod ces dang /gnyis pa/ mi mang tsho la sngar tshong tshogs kyi mnga' khul du gnas pa tshang mas rgyal mo'am rgyal mo'i rjes 'dzin pa la drang pos brtse zhen zhu dgos pa'i 'bod skul
204 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjodapa/byas te rgyal mo'i mtshan thog nas bskos pa'i gzhung zhabs pa rnams la mgo 'bul zhu dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas yod pa red/gsum pa/ de skabs kyi srid skyong ñtsa khyab rngarlas jonyan khrisaka'unta kusmidma de rgyal tshab tu bskos nas des dbyin ji'i rgyal mo'i mtshan thog nas gzhung gi 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa dang / de yang rgya gar las don drung ches bka' dang / khrims srol khag dus dus su gnang rgyu bzhin gzhung 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa'i drel bsgrags byas yod/bzhi pa/ de dus las don byed bzhin pa'i shar rgya gar tshong las tshogs pa'i zhi drag gi las byed pa tshang ma dbyin gzhung gi las byed par nges rgyu dang / phyes su bca' khrims dang / rgyal mo'i dgongs bzhed ltar de tsholtar snar lag len bstar rgyu 'khod yod pa red/lnga pa/ sngar shar rgya gar tshong las tshogs pa dang / sa gnas rgya gar gyi rgyal po tsho'i bar chings yig sogs gang bzhag pa thams cad dbyin gzhung gis khas len byed rgyu dang / sa gnas rgya gar rgyal po tshos kyang de mtshungs dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas yod 'dugdrug pa/ de skabs dbyin dzi'i mnga' 'og tu yod pa'i mnga' ris de slar yang rgya skyed mi byed pa dang / de snga rgya gar gyi rgyal khams dbyin ji'i 'og tu ma bsdus pa rnams rang sor bzhag pa las dbyin jis mnga' 'og tu bsdu thabs mi byed pa'i khas len byas par ma zad rgya gar rgyal po de tsho dang / de tsho'i mi mang tshang ma'i che mthong dang / khe dbang mtha' dag la brtsi skur byed rgyu'i khas len byas yod pa red/bdun pa/ dbyin ji'i rgyal mo rang nyid la dbyin yul mi mang gi don du las 'gan ga re yod pa de ga nang bzhin mo rang la dbyin ji'i mnga' khongs rgya gar yul mi
le'ugasum pa/ deng dus kyi byung babarjodapa/ 205tsho'i don du las 'gan yang gcig pa yod pa dang / las 'gan de dag rtsa khrims dang mthun par cha tshang bsgrub rgyu yin par gsal yod/brgyad pa/ khong gis mi mang su'i thog la yang mo rang gi rang 'dod btsan 'gel byed rgyu min la/ chos lugs sogs gang gi thad nas kyang kha shas la kho phan dang /kha shas la btsan dbang sogs nye ring dang phyogs ris med par tshang mas khrims kyi thob dbang gcig mtshungs su spyod chog rgyu ma zad chos dad la gzhung gis the byus mi byed pa'i dril bsgrags gnang yod pa red/dgu pa/ gzhung gi las byed pa'i sko bzhag skor dbyin ji'i mi rigs dang mnyam rgya gar ba tsho la thob dbang gcig mtshungs dang go skabs gcig mtshungs sprod rgyu dang / rigs rus la ma bltas par so so'i shes yon dang 'jon thang la dpags pas rgya gar ba tshos gzhung zhabs pa'i mtshan gnas ga 'dra zhig la yang rang dbang gis rig med du zhugs chog pa gsal por bshad yod/ bcu pa/ rgya gar ba tsho la so so'i pha mes nas byung ba'i sa gzhis la brtse zhin yod pa ltar de tsho'i sa gzhis kyi thob dbang la ñtsa 'jog bya rgyu dang / rgya gar gyi mna' srol goms gshis sogs la sdus rtsi byas te de dang mthun par khrims gzhi bzo rgyu'i khas len byas yod pa red/bcu gcig pa/ ngo log gyen lang skabs dbyin ji rgyal mo'am dbyin ji'i mi rigs thog mtshon ldan ngo rgol byed mkhan rgya gar ba tsho la spyir btang bzod bzhes gru yangs gtong rgyu ma zad phyi lo 1859 zla ba dang po'i ches gcig gi sngon bde bar rang khyim du log chog pa'i 'bod skul byas yod pa red/bcu gnyis pa/ dril bsgrags gyi mtha' sdom la rgya gar gyi mi mang tsho'i ched
206 'pha sa yul 9 byung ba bajed pa/du phyi dngos po'i phun tshogs dang / nang sems kyi yar rgyas yong ba'i don du dbyin ji rgyal mos 'bad brtson yod dgu rtsal sgrug gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhis gnang yod pa red/rgyal mos rgya gar du bzo las gar rgyas btang nas mi mang la bed spyod yod pa'i dngos rigs mtha' dag yar rgyas btang ba dang chabs cig rgya gar gyi mi mang tsho'i khe phan ched rgya gar gzhung gi 'dzin skyong tshags tshud gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gsal por gnang yod pa red/de ltar rgyal mo'i bka' khyab de ni dbyin gzhung gis rgya gar dang rgya gar mi mang la dbang sgyur bya rgyu'i grub mtha' gzhi bzung byas shing / de phyin rgya gar du dbyin gzhung gi srid byus tshang ma de la gzhi bzhag nas srid dbang bzung ba yin la/ de la gzhi bzung byas pa'i srid byus de lo drug cu tsam bar gnas shing / phyi lo 1917 lor dbyin gzhung gis dril bsgrags shig bskyar du gnang ba dang / des 'gan 'khur dang ldan pa'i srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs rgyur dmigs pa red/ 'di'i skor 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur/dbyin ji rgyal mo'i bka' khyab bam dril bkaka de la skyon shin spye chen po zhig yod pa ni rgya gar ba tsho la srid don gyi thob dbang ngam khe dbang gang yang sprad med cing /so so'i yul gyi 'dzin skyong gi 'gan dbang gang yang yul mi la sprad med pa de red/gong du bshad zin pa ltar dbyin ji rgyal mo'i bka' khyab dril bsgrags nang rna bar snyan la yid du 'thad pa'i don tshan de dag phyis su lag len du bltar med cing /gzhung gi las byed pa mtho sa tshang mar rgya gar ba ma bzhag cing / spyi tshogs la legs bcos dang / dpal 'byor gar rgyas sogs la do snang ma byas shing / sngar dbyin 'og tu ma 'dus pa'i rgya gar rgyal po rnams dngos su rang btsan yin tshul bshad kyang /
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 207don dam du dbyin ji'i bkod dbang du gyur pa sogs brjod kyis mi lang /gong du bshad pa ltar 1857 lo'i ngo log gi rjes su rgya gar yul dbyin gzhung gi thad ku'i 'og tu phyin pa dang / de'i grub 'bras su dbyin ji'i khe phan de rgya gar ba'i khe phan las gal che ru gyur pa dang / bzo las gsar brje'i rjes su dbyin yul gyi srid don la dbyin ji'i bzo las bdag po tshos dbang cha chen po byung nas/ 'dzam gling spyi dang / lhag par allīkā la dbyin jis rgya skyed byas shing / de yi ched du dbyin jis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa gzhan rnams dang 'thab 'dzing byed dgos byung /'thab 'dzing dang rgya skyed las 'grul la dpal 'byor mang po dgos shing / dbyin yul gyi dpal 'byor gyi srung skyob ched rgya gar bed spyod byas pa dang / rgya gar gyi thon khungs dang thon skyed la brten nas dbyin yul gyis yul gzhan dang mnyam shin tu 'gro gron che ba'i g.yul 'khrug byed thub pa byung ba red/skabs 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni/ ngo log gyen lang rjes rgya gar dbyin gzhung gi thad ku'i dbang 'og tu bslebs te 1858 nas bzung rgya gar las don drung che zhes pa des rgya gar la srid dbang byed rgyu'i las don byas/ rgya gar las don drung che de la rgya gar las don blon chen zhes kyang 'bod srol yod 'dug cing / de nyid dbyin yul gyi blon chen lhan tshogs kyi 'thus mi yin pas dbyin gzhung gi blon po gzhan ltar kho yang blon po gcig yin pa red/ blon po yin pas de nyid dbyin yul gyi gros tshogs la brten yod pa red/ de lta na yang dbyin yul gyi gros tshogs kyis rgya gar gyi las don skor la do snang cher ma byas/ rgya gar las don blon po la gros 'debs mkhan rgya gar lhan tshogs zhes pa gcig btsugs pa de'i 'thug mi ni dbyin ji'i dpon rigs rgya gar la las ka byed myong mkhan 'ba' zhig red/ lhan tshogs de la dmigs
208 'phags yul 9byung ba brjod pa/bsal dbang cha gang yang med la/ de tshos gros 'debs byas pa tshang ma rgya gar las don blon pos khas len dgos pa'ang ma yin/sngar srid skyong spyi khyab tsho'i dus su de tshos so so'i rnam dpyod dang bstun nas las don byed cing / dbyin yul du yod pa'i dpon rigs tsho dang mnyam yig 'grul byed rgyur dka' tshogs yod cing de la dus tshod mang po 'gor gyi yod pa red/ bzo las la gsar brje byung rjes 'grim 'grul dang yig 'grul 9 mthun rkyen rgyas pas las sla ru phyin/ chu rlangs 'phrul 'khor can gyi gru gzings la brten nas rgya gar dang dbyin yul bar gyi 'grul skyod myur du phyin/ 1870 lor rgya gar dang dbyin yul bar 3 tur lam tshuḍa pa de las gru gzings brgyud snyan sgron gtong len ma dgos shing gang ci'i bka' bsgugs nas yun ring sdod ma dgos par rgya gar gzhung dang / rgya gar las don blon chen gnyis bar nyin ltar gros bsdur byed thub pa byung / der ma zad snyu lo 1869 lor rsāja yur sgo phyes pas sa gzhi'i dkyil mtsho dang / mtsho dmar po gnyis phan tshun mthun sbrel byung bas rgya gar dang dbyin gzhung bar thag thung du phyin/ de nas allīkā'ilho mtha'i ra ba'i gling rtse nas bskor ma dgos pa byung ba red/ de ltar 'grim 'grul dang sbrag hār gyi yar rgyas phyin pa las dbyin jig rgya gar la dbang sgyur ched rgya gar las don blon po la phan thogs chen po byung ste rgya gar du nyin re'i gnas tshul rnams shes pa'i sgo nas dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab la bka' bkod nyin re bzhin byed thub pa byung / de la brten nas rgya gar du bzhugs pa'i rgyal tshab de snga ma'i srid skyong spyi khyab tsho nang bzhin rang dbang che bar ma lhag par grub mtha' dang lag len gnyis ku'i cha nas rang dbang gis las ka byed ma thub cing / dbyin yul du bzhugs pa'i rgya gar las don blon po de nyid kyi bkod dbang du gyur par ma zad rgyal tshab de rgya gar mi mang
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus 9byung ba brjod pa/ 209la brten pa yang ma yin par dngos don du rgya gar las don blon po'i sku tshab tsam du gyur/ rgya gar las don blon po de nyid dbyin yul gros tshogs la brten pa yin rung /gros tshogs kyis rgya gar gyi khe phan la do snang ma byas pas blon po de nyid rang 'dod kyis dbang sgyur byed mkhan zhig tu gyur pa dang / kho'i bka' khrol med par rgya gar gzhung gis srid byus gang yang lag star byed ma thub pa red/ de skabs dbyin yul gyi gzhung de la rang yul gyi gzhung dang / rgya gar du yod pa'i dbyin gzhung de la rgya gar gzhung zhes btags/ grub mtha' dang lag len gnyis thog nas rgya gar gzhung de rang yul gyi gzhung de'i 'og tu phyin/rgya gar gzhung gi dmigs yul ni dbyin yul gyi khe phan sgrub rgyu de yin pas gzhung gi las don 'dzin skyong tshang ma'i nang nas dbyin yul gyi khe phan de gtso che shes su brtsis yod pa red/sngar srid skyong spyi khyab skabs su de tshos srid skyong spyi khyab lhan tshogs zhes pa zhig gi rogs ram las 'dzin skyong byed kyi yod pa lhan tshogs de'i nang srid skyong spyi khyab las gzhan pa'i 'thus mi bzhi dang / dmag spyi chen mo ni dmigs bsal 'thus mi yin pa red/ de la rgyun las lhan tshogs kyang 'bod srol yod 'dug 1853lor 'thus mi drug mang du btang nas khrims bzo lhan tshogs kyi rnam par bsgyur ba na/de yi nang rgya gar ba yang dgos pa'i dgos 'dun byung yang dgos 'dun de khas ma blangs pa red/1861 lor khrims gzhi zhig bzos te lhan tshogs ayau sgrig 'dzugs bskyar du bzos te 'thus mi'i grangs 'bor bcu gnyis bzos pa dang / de tsho'i nang gzhung zhabs pa ma yin pa'i mi sna khag bcug pa dang / rgya gar ba rnams kyang tshud pa de tsho
210 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/ni gral rim mtho ba rnams dang / phyug po dang / sa zhing bdag po dbyin yul la sha zhen yod pa khag thad bskos byas pa red/ 'on kyang khrims bzo lhan tshogs des spyir btang khrims bzo chog kyang / des bzos pa'i khrims de rgyal tshab kyis khas len dgos pa'i nges pa med cing / gal ti rgyal tshab kyis khas blangs na yang dbyin yul gzhung gis khas ma blangs pa srid/ des na khrims bzo lhan tshogs de ni nus shugs ma ldan par rgya gar ba rnams mgo skor byed mkhan lta bu zhig las med pa red/1861 nang khrims gzhi zhig ltar maṅgās dang / bka.i yi mnga' sde'i nang la yang khrims bzo lhan tshogs bzos nas de tshos mnga' hra so so'i nang gi khrims gzhi bzos/ 1892 lor rgya gar lhan tshogs kyu khrims gzhi zhes pa zhig gi sgo nas lhan tshogs kyi 'thus mi'i grangs 12 las spar te bcu drug tu bzos/ 'on kyang mang che ba gzhung zhabs pa yin pa red/ khrims bzo lhan tshogs de tsho'i nang du rgya gar ba 'ga' shas yod kyang de tsho tshang ma dbyin ji'i rgyal srid la sha zhen can 'ba' zhig yin pa red/der brten dngos don du rgya gar gzhung gi srid dbang 'dzin tshul de ni mi gcig gis rang 'dod kyis dbang sgyur byas pa zhig rang du gnas la de yang dbyin yul dang / —dbyin ji tsho'i khe phan gtso bor byas pa zhig red/sngar dpal 'byor gyi cha nas 'dzin skyong gtan 'bebs gang yang med de gzhung gi yong 'bab dang / 'gro gron dang / dbus gzhung gi yong 'babs las mnga' sde'i gzhung la bto 'grems soḍa kyi rnam bzhag gtan 'bebs byas med kyang / phyo lo 1860lor dngul rtsis sam 'char 'dod dngul rtsis gtan 'bebs byas te 'gro gron dang yong 'babs la tshod dpag byas te 'char 'god zhib par byas pa dang / brgya phrag bcu dadu pa'i bcu phrag brgyad pa'i nang dbus gzhung dang mnga' sde gzhung bar gzhung
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjodapa/ 211'babs bgo 'grems byas te/ sbrag ljor dang / me 'khor dang / nyal tha dang tshwa gnyis kyi tshong khral dang / sho gam bsdus pa rnams ni cha tshang dbus gzhung la thob pa dang / sa khral dang / chang rag tshong khral sogs kyi yong 'bab rnams dbus gzhung dang /mnga' sde'i gzhung gnyis bar bgo bsha' byas shing / gzhung 'bab mang du gtong ba'i thabs shes kyang byas pa bcas dpal 'byor thad 'dzin skyong gtan 'bebs byas/de bzhin drag po dmag mi'i cha nas kyang 'dzin skyong gtan 'bebs gsar du byas te/ de yang 1857 lo'i ngo log gyen lang la dmag mi tshos las 'gul gtso bor byas yod pa la brten nas dbyin jis dmag mi tsho'i skor sgyur bcos bskyar du sgrig 'dzugs bzos/ de yang phyis su ngo log sogs mi 'byung ched rgya gar ba'i dmag mi tsho me sgyigs dang go mdzod las zur du phral nas nub phyogs pa'i mi rigs kyi dmag mi mang du btang / rgya gar ba'i dmag mi gnyis thog yu rob pa'i dmag mi re re bzhag cing / rjes su de la 'gyur ba btang ste rgya gar ba lnga re'i thog nub phyogs pa gnyis re bzos pa de 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po ma byung bar du rnam bzhag de rang gnas pa red/ dmag dpon tshang ma nub gling pa yin pa las rgya gar ba su yang dmag dpon du ma bskos pa red/kha bral du btang nas dbang sgyur ces pa'i srid byus bzung nas rgya gar 3 sa khul dang / rigs dang / mi tshogs so so'i ming thog nas dmag sde khag bzos pa de ma 'ongs par gal sred ngo log byung na dmag sde gcig gi thog dmag sde gzhan pa de bed spyod yong bar dmigs pa zhig red/ der ma zad dbyin jig rgya gar ba rnams dpa' rtsal dang ldan pa dang / me ldan pa gnyis su phyes nas dpa' rtsal dang ldan pa'i mi rigs kho na dmag mi'i nang bcug de bzhin da dung yang sgyur bcos mang po
212 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/btang nas dbyin jis rgya gar du dmag dpung chen po bzhag pa de rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal khams kyi srung skyob tsam gyi ched du min par 'dzam gling yul gzhan du dbyin ji'i rgyal khams rgya skyed byed pa'i don du'ang yin pas aphaXnistun dang / b.ramā sogs su rgya gar gyi dmag mi tshos dbyin ji'i phyogs nas 'thab 'dzing byas yod pa red/srid gzhung 'dzin skyong ched zhi ba'i sri zhu zhes pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byas te zhi ba'i gzhung zhabs pa rnams rgyugs sprod kyi sgo nas 'dems sko byed srol bzos pa red/de ni 1853 lo nas 'go 'dzugs byas shing / 'gran bsdur rgyugs sprod de bzhin dbyin yul du gtong dgos pas rgya gar ba nyung shas las 'gro thub kyi yod pa ma red/der ma zad rgyugs sprod de dbyin skad kho na'i nang 'bri dgos pas rgya gar ba tsho la dka' ngal yong gi yod pa red/ dbyin ji'i rgyal mo khrirtsorigs zhi ba'i sri zhu'i nang rgya gar ba tsho la dbyin ji'i mi rigs dang 'dra bar go skabs sprod rgyu yin tshul khas len byas kyang don du de ltar ma byas par rgya gar ba tsho gzhung zhabs go gnas mtho sar gtan nas sko bzhag ma byas pa red/ zhi ba'i sri zhu'i nang rgya gar ba tsho zhugs dgos kyi dgos 'dun rtag tu bton yang de la do snang ma byas/3 lo 1879 lor 'dzin skyong sre zhu zhes pa zhig gsar du bzos pa de'i nang lo ltar rgya gar ba zhugs chog pa dang thub pa red/ 'on kyang sko bzhag byed stangs de 'gran bsdur rgyugs sprod la gzhir ma byas par dbyin jis mthong tshul legs po yod sa'i rgya gar ba 'ba' zhig 'dems sko byas pa red/ phyo lo 1886 lo'i rjes su sri zhu gsum bzos te/ gcig ni sngar gyi zhi ba'i sri zhu zer ba de yin zhing / de'i nang gzhung zhabs dpon rigs sho gnas mtho ba tshang ma yod pa dang / de tsho mang che ba dbyin ji'i mi rigs red/ de nas mnga' sde khag tu yang mnga' sde'i zhi ba'i sre zhu dper
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 213na baṅgāl zhi ba'i sre zhu soḍa bzos pa dang / gsum pa las don so so'i sri zhu yang bzos pa dper na shes yon gyi sri zhu sogs yin la/ sri zhu tha ma gnyis po de'i brgyud nas rgya gar ba rnams 'dems sko byas yod pa red/ gang ltar dbyin ji'i 'dzin skyong de la gal che shos dpon rigs tsho yin zhing / dpon rigs tshos rang nyid mi dmangs las zur du mtho ba yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / de tsho'i nang nas 'ga' shas las don hur thag byed mkhan yod/ 'on kyang de tsho'i dmigs yul ni me mang thog dbang sgyur byed rgyu de yin pa las mi mang la rogs ram zhabs 'degs zhu ba ma yin/rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams kyi skor la yang dbyin ji'i srid byus la 'gyur ba phyin yod cing / de yang rang gi srid dbang brtan po bzo ched 1857 rjes dbyin ji'i rgyal mo'i rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams kyi srid dbang la ñtsa 'jog bya rgyu dang / dbyin jis slar yang rgya skyed rma byed pa'i dril bsgrags gnang yang / dngos don du tshang ma dbyin ji'i bkod dbang du song ba dang / dbyin ji'i ches mtho'i dbang shugs kyi 'og tu phyin yod pa red/phyi lo 1857 rjes su dbyin ji'i dbang 'og tu dngos su med pa'i rgya gar kyi rgyal po'am rgyal phran lnga brgya dang drug rtsu re gnyis yod cing / dbyin jis rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran de tsho so so'i rogs skyor byed mkhan du bad spyod byas te gzhis bdag sger pa rnams la yang rgyal po'i che mthong sprad pas grangs de tsam byung ba red/de tsho'i nang nas rgyal phran 'ga' shas ni shin tu rgya chung ba mnga' khul me liṃ gru bzhi ma re dang / mi mang brgya tsam las yod pa ma red/ kusha'ir dang / rtedurāpād sogs ni shin tu nas rgya che ste dbyin yul las kyang rgya che ba yod pa red/phyi lo 1857 gyi rjes su dbyin jis rgya gar la rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis
214 'phagasayul 9 byung ba ba da pa/bzos te dang po ni dbyin ji'i mnga' 'og gi rgya gar dang / gnyis pa ni rgya gar ba'i rgyal po'am rgyal phran tshos bskyangs pa'i rgya gar mnga' khul red/ dang po de la dbyin gzhung gis srid dbang bsgyur la/ gnyis pa de tsho rgya gar ba'i rgyal po rnams kyis srid dbang sgyur gyi yod pa red/ 1857 sngon du dbyin rdza'i srid dbang dang rgya gar gyi rgyal po de tsho bar 'brel ba gcig mtshungs med par so so'i dbar gros mthun chings yig ga re bzhag yod pa ltar yin/ 'on kyang 1858 rjes 'brel lam de la 'gyur ba phyin te/ dbyin rdzas da can rgya gar gyi rgyal po'am rgyal phran rnams dbyin rdza'i mnga' 'bangs su 'jug rgyu min pa'i khas len byas yod kyang / dngos don du dbyin ji'i rgyal srid de mchog gi rgyal srid dam ches mtho'i rgyal srid yin pa'i grub mtha' la gzhi byas pas rgya gar gyi rgyal po de rnams dbyin ji'i bkod dbang 'og tu gyur pa red/dbyin ji'i rgyal srid de mchog gi rgyal srid yin pa'i grub mtha' la gzhir byas pa'i khrims gzhi bsgrags nas phyi lo 1877 phyi zla dang po'i ches gcig nyin dbyin ji'i rgyal mos 7gong ma'i mtshan gnas dngos su bzhes te/ de'i skabs 7gong ma'i rgyal tshogs zhes pa dbyin ji 7gong ma'i bsil grib 'og tu gnas pa'i rgyal po'am rgyal phran tshang ma'i tshogs 'du zhig tshogs pa der rgya gar gyi rgyal po tshos rgyas spros chen pos so so'i phun tshogs dang gzi brjed ngoms par gal chen por brtsis pa red/ de dus rgya gar gyi mnga' khul mang por mu ge 'byung bzhin yod pa red/de nas rgya gar ba'i rgyal po'am rgyal phran tsho'i phyo nang gnyis thad nas srung skyob bya rgyu de dbyin ji'i las 'gan du gyur pas dbyin jig de tsho'i las don la the byus byed pa'i go skabs thob pa dang / rgyal po tshang ma'i shul 'dzin nam khri 'dzin skor dbyin gzhung gi bka' khrol dgos shing / rgyal po zhig lo na ma lon bar dbyin jis yul
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 215der srid dbang gi las don byas/ gal srid rgyal khams gang zhig la ngo log sogs byung ba'am 'dzin skyong nyes pa byung na rgyal po de khri las phabs nas gzhan zhig khri la 'god par byed/ de lta na yang rgyal khams de dbyin ji'i mnga' 'bangs su dngos su ma bsdus par bzhag pa red/ rgyal po de tshos 3 rgyal yul gzhan dang 'brel ba nam yang byed mi chog cing / phyes su āṇḍa ku na rgyal tshab byed skabs su rgya gar gyi rgyal po'am rgyal phran de tsho dbyin ji'i bka' khrol med par phyi rgyal du 'gro mi chog pa bzos/rgya gar gyi rgyal po de tsho'i dmag mi'i grangs 'bor yang nyung du btang /rgya gar gyi rgyal po 3 rgyal du phyin pa na phyi rgyal ba de tshos de rnams dbyin ji'i mi mang zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed rkyang byas pa red/ de ltar rgya gar gyi rgyal po de tsho tshang ma dbyin ji'i bkod dbang 'og tu phyin par ma zad de tsho tshang ma dbyin ji'i grogs po dang rogs ram byed mkhan du gyur/rgya gar gyi rgyal po tshos so so'i dbang tshad shin tu chung ba de dga' pos khas len byas 'dug gang lags zer na de tsho'i mnga' khul de tsho dbyin jis dbang 'og tu dngos su bsdu rgyu'i nyen kha med cing / mi mang gis ngo log zing 'khrug byung na dbyin jis srung skyob byed kau yod pa red/ der brten de tshos khra 3 shin tu skyid po byas nas 'dod yon longs spyod la mdo 'khor nas bsdad pa red/ so so'i mnga' khul du khrims bzos nas 'dzin skyong byas te dbyin gzhung la ngo bstod byas nas bsdad na skyid po dang dga' po'i ngang nas mi che skyel chog pa byung / rang skyong ljongs zhes pa de de lta bu zhig la zer ba yin pa 'dra/ dbyin rdzas rgya che sa nas bltas nas rgya gar gyi rgyal po de tshor che ba'i mtshan gnas sna tshogs sprad pas rgyal po de tsho'i ming ches rdzig po dang ring du phyin pa red/ de lta na yang de tsho la don dam gyi rang dbang med par ma zad de
216 'phags yul: byungab brjod pa/tshos mi mang gi don du gang yang byas med pa lta bu red/gong du bshad pa ltar dbyin jig kha bral btang nas dbang sgyur ces pa'i srid byus lag len du bstar yod/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pa su zhig yin rung des dbang 'og hu phyin pa'i yul de yi mi mang kha bral du btang nas so so'i srid dbang brtan po bzo ba ni spyir btang gi gnas tshul yin pa ltar dbyin gzhung gis kyang de bzhin byas te/dper na zhing bdag rnams kyis rgyab skyor byed rgyur dmigs yul du bzung nas sa zhing bdag po rnams slar yang bskyar gso yong thabs byas/ yul gyi cha shas mang por sa zhing gi rnam bzhag gsar pa gtan 'bebs byas te zhing bdag ring lugs med par bzos zin pa yin yang / 1857 gyi ngo log rjes sa zhing rnams zhing bdag tshor bslogs pa dang / zhing bdag gi bu rnams la gzhung gi las ka yang sprad de spyi tshogs kyi gral rim gzhan dang mnyam dbye 'byed byas pas rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs nang mi mthun kha bral gyi gnas tshul gyur/ der ma zad 1857 gyi rjes su spyo tshogs legs bcos gang yang byed rgyu min tshul bshad nas spyi tshogs su skyon rnams rang sor bzhag nas mi 'dod pa'i gnas tshul rgyun mthud bzhag der ma zad chos lugs mi mthun pa bskyar bslangs byas te/ kha che tsho ni dbyin ji'i dgra lte bar bzung ba dang / gzhung gi las byed 'dems skor kha che tsho dang phyogs ris byas shing / dpe deb khag tu'ang kha che rnams hi( tsho la dbang sgyur mkhan dang sdug po gtong mkhan yin tshul bris pa de dag ni hi( rnams la dbyin sngar rgyab skyor thob pa'i ched du yin/ 'on kyang rjes su srid byus de la 'gyur ba btang ste kha che'i gral rim mtho ba rnams kyi phyoḍa byas te hiḥ'i chos 93 de kha che'i 'gal zla gtso bo yin tshul gyi rnam pa bstan/ mdor na kha che dang hi: gnyis kha bral du btang nas dbyin jis rang don bsgrub thabs byas pa zhig red/
le'ugasum pa/ deng dus 9 byungab ba da pa/ 217dus rabs bcu dasdu pa'i phyed gnyis pa'i nang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rgya skyed mpi dus skabs yin pas/ nub gling pa'i stobs shugs mang pos yul gzhan btsan 'og tu 'jug ched btsan rgol byas shing / mi ser spel yul tsho'i don du btsan rgyal ring lugs pa rnams kyis phan tshun 'gran zla chen po byas pa dang / de las phan tshun dmag 'khrug kyang mang po byung / de bzhin dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang btsan rgyal ring lugs ayau rgya skyed shar gling yeshilā la byed bzhin yod pas dbyin gzhung gis kyang do snang byas yod cing / urusu'i rgya skyed 'gog ched dbyin jis aphaganistun nang nus shugs spel thabs byas te 1878 lor dbyin jig gaphanānistun thog dmag 'khrug byas kyang dbyin jis gaphaXnistun cha tshang la dbang sgyur nam yang ma byas byas thub/de bzhin brla'i stod kyi mnga' khul de dbyin ji'i dbang 'og tu yod cing lhag ma rnams la yul de'i rgyal pos dbang sgyur byed bzhin yod kyang / phrunasi yis lho shar yeshilā'i yul khag nang dbang nus spel bas dbyin jis thabs shes sna tshogs byas te/ mthar 1885 lor dbyin jis b.ramā'i thog btsan rgol byas/ mtha' mar dbyin jis brla'i yul de dbyin ji'i mnga' 'bangs su bcug pa red/de ltar spru lo 1857 gyi gyen lang ngo log gi rjes su rgya gar gyi thog dbyin ji'i srid byus la 'gyur ba chen po byung nas dbyin ji'i 7gong ma'i mnga' 'og tu dbyin gzhung gis rgya gar thog sred don dang / dpal 'byor dang / dmag don bcas cha thams cad nas dbang sgyur byas te/ dbyin ji dang dbyin yul gyi khe phan gtso bor byas pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul nang rgya gar du rgyal yongs kyi las 'dul 'do tshu9 shing /1905 bar rgyal yongs las 'grul shon tu stobs shugs che bar gyur pas de la dbyin jis btang snyoms byed ma thub pas gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod/
218 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/gong du bshad pa rnams ni 'chad 'gyur gyi byung rabs kyi don snying po gsal bar rtogs pa'i don du mdor bsdus pa yin par go bar bya la/ da ni byung rabs dkyus la 'jug par bya'o//dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab āṇḍa kunilha (phyi lo 185841862)rgya gar du shar rgya gar tshong las tshogs pas bskos pa'i srid skyong spyi khyab tha ma ni āṇḍa kunirsha yin la de nyid 3 lo 1856 lor srid skyong spre khyab kyi las don du bskos pa dang / phyi lo 1857 lor ngo log gyen langs chen po'i rjes rgya gar du tshong las tshogs pa'i srid dbang rdzogs te/ dbyin gzhung gis srid dbang blangs skabs 1858 lo'i 3 zla bcu gcig pa'i nang dbyin ji'i rgyal mo'i dril bsgrags gnang ba ltar kunig de nyid la srid skyong spyi khyab tsam ma zad rgyal tshab kyang bskos te/phyi lo 1862 bar rgya gar du srid bskyangs pa red/de'i rgyal tshab kyi dus yun ring thog mar dbyin ji'i mi rigs the bas nub gling pa'i dmag mi sngar tshong tshoḍa kyi las byed pa yin pa tshang ma da cha dbyin gzhung gi dmag mir 'gyur ba de la nub gling pa'i dmag mi de tshos ngo log byas te/ khong tshos 'dod tshul la ma dris par tshong tshoḍa kyi las byed pa nas dbyin gzhung gi las byed par sgyur mi thub tshul brjod pa de la ngo log dkar po'am dkar po'i ngo log ces brjod/ dmag mi de 'dra'i grangs 'bor chig khri brgyad stong tsam yod/ de tshos yang na dmag mi nas dgongs khrol dang yang na rngan pa gsar pa'i dngul 'bor sprod dgos tshul rnyog khra bshad pa red/ mthar dbyin gzhung gis dmag rma khri gcig tsam dgongs khrol btang ba dang / de dang mnyam ngo log dkar po de mgo gnon thub pa byung /
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus 9byung ba brjodapa/ 219rgya gar gyi rgyal po'am rgyal phran tsho'i phyo nang gi srung skyob byas te de tsho'i las don la the byus byas pa dang / rgyal po'am rgyal phran tshang mas dbyin ji'i rgyal srid kyi stobs shugs su ngos len byas te/ dngos don du tshang ma dbyin gzhung gi bkod dbang 'og tu gyur/der ma zad rgyal tshab kunig gis dpal 'byor dang / khral bsdu sogs la legs bcos byas shing / phyi lo 1861 lor rgya gar du mu ge chen po byung bar/kuni5 gis mu ges gdung ba tsho la skyob gso sprad pa dang / mu ge 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan la brtag dpyad sogs byas/khrims gzhi'i skor la yang legs bcos byas te/ srid skyong spyi khyab bam rgyal tshab kyi lhan tshogs la 'gyur ba btang ba dang / 1861 lor rgya gar lhan tshogs kyi khrims gzhi ltar khrims bzo lhan tshogs dang / mnga' sde'i khrims bzo lhan tshogs sogs bzos/de bzhin mtho rim gtsug lag slob grwa khag 'ga' shas btsugs nas sheg yon yar rgyas gtong thabs byas shing / dmag mi'i sgrig 'dzugs bskyar du byas te/ nub phyogs pa'i dmag mi bdun khri drug stong dang / rgya gar ba'i dmag mi chig 'bum sum khri lnga stong (135000)bsdu skong byas/ dmag dpon tshang ma ni nub gling pa yin pa red/'dzin skyong thad zhi ba'i sri zhu sogs la legs bcos gang mtshams btang /dbus gzhung dang / mnga' sde gzhung tshang ma'i 'dzin skyong la do snang chen po byas /spyir btang mi de brtson 'grus chen po zhi bde'i thabs lam la mkhas pa dang / phugs bsam ring po gtong mkhan gyi rgyal tshab cig red/las don la brel zing che rkyen gyis sku gzugs 'phrod bsten la do phog byung zhing
220 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/khong gi sku zla grongs pas da dung skyo ru phyin pas phyi lo 1862 lor dgongs pa zhus te dbyin yul du phyir log byas pa'i zla ba gsum rjes dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ ngo log gyen lang skabs dbyin yul nas rgya gar bas dbyin jir ngo log dang gnod skyon byas par brten rgya gar ba'i mi rnams la chad pa shin tu drag po gcod dgos tshul gyi nan skul byung yang / kuni gis de ltar drag las ma byas par zhi bde thabs mkhas kyis phugs bsam ring po btang bas rgya gar de dbyin ji'i rgyal sred kyi 'og tu gnas thub pa byung / khong gis ngo log zing 'khrug dngos su byed mkhan 'ga' shas las mi mang byings la chad pa btang med pa de bsam blo rgya che zhing gnas tshul dngos dang 'brel ba zhig red/āṇḍala'urenda/ (3 lo 186441869)phyi lo 1863 lo 'gor dbyin yul du āṇḍa kunig 3 las 'das rdzis sar jonyan la'uresga la rgya gar gyi sred skyong spyi khyab bam rgyal tshab tu bskos pa red/ kho ni thog mar dbyin ji'i tshong tshogs kyi las byed pa dma' rim zhig yin zhing rim bzhin no gnas 'phar mthar dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab tu gyur pa red/ khos rgya gar du go gnas dang las 'gan sna tshogs su las don byas shing / ngo log gyen lang skabs khos 'bad brtson chen po byas pa dang / dirsā len thub pa byas te 1858 lor di5'i sa khul gyi 'dzin skyong de la'urenda la len bcug pa red/ khos pahāb khul la 'dzin skyong byas te mthar 1859 lor las don nas 'khyol ba yin yang / slar yang 1864lor rgya gar du dbyin ji 7gong ma'i rgyal tshab byas pa red/ khos srid dbang byas ring rgya gar du spyir btang zhi bde sming 'jag gi gnas stangs byung yod pa red/
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 221phyi lo 1864 nas 1865 nang 'brug yul dang dmag 'khrug cig byung ba de yang dbyin jis spru lo 1826 lor āsam la 'dzin bzung byas rjes dbyin 'brug gnyis bar thag nye'i 'brel lam byung zhing / 'brug pa tshos btsan dbang gis 'brug yul nas lngasām yong sa'i la 'ga' shas btsan bzung byas pas ma tshad ārsām dang baṅgāl gyi rdzong 'ga' shas nang thog rgyag yang yang byas pa red/ phyi lo 1863 lor 'brug pas dbyin ji'i dpon rigs 'ga' shas btsan rku byas te de tshor lngasām la yong sa'i la rnams la dbyin ji'i dbang cha med tshul gyi chings yig la dbang med kyis ming rtags 'god bcug pa na/ dbyin gzhung gis chings yig de la khas len ma byas shing /dbyin ji'i mi rigs btsan 'khrid byas pa tsho glod dkrol dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas kyang 'brug pas lan gang yang ma sprad par brten dbyin jis nub phyogs brgyud kyi gtsang po'i bar gyi sa khul khag blangs par ma zad 'brug pa la gun gsab kyang ma sprad pa red/ phyi lo 1865 lor 'brug pas glo bur du dbyin ji'i sku tshab thog rgol 'dzing byas te de tsho dewanagiri nas phyir 'bud byas pa red/ 'on kyang dbyin rdzas de 'phral dmag 'thab byas pas dus thung ngu zhig nang 'brug dmag pham nas dbyin ji dang mnyam zhi ba'i gros mthun bzhag ste 'brug lho shar khul 9 la bco brgyad dbyin ji la rtsis 'bul byed dgos byung zhing / de'i gun gsab lta bu dbyin jis lo ltar 'brug pa la dbyin sgor lnga stong re sprod rgyu byas pa dang / slad phyin dbyin ji dang mnyam 'brug pas grogs po'i 'brel lam mu mthud byed rgyu byas pa red/ la'uredra la las don de'i thad skyon brjod byed mkhan byung yang / 'brug pa las blangs pa'i sa khul de tsho rin thang shin tu che ba'i ja zhing bzang po dag yod pa red/la'uredra yi skabs rgya gar dbyin gzhung la dka' ngal che shos ni apha1nistun
222 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/skor gyi srid byus de yin la/ urusus de phyogs su dbang shugs 'phel rgyas byas pas dbyin dzo la dka' ngal byung / rgya gar dbyin gzhung gis aphaXnistun la drag pos 'jigs snang yang bskul yang aphaXnilhan cha tshang la dbang sgyur byed ma thub pa red/la'urenda yis krasha'ir rgyal po la khri 'dzin pa gzhan nyar chog pa'i gnang ba can pa dang / khos rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams dang gzhung 'brel gros bsdur yang yang byas pa dang / rgya gar gyi rgyal po tsho'i mnga' khul du chos dad rang mos kyi thob thang sprad cing / sa khul 'ga' shas su khyo shi ba'i dur me'i nang chung ma gson sreg byed pa'i lugs srol med pa bzos/ der ma zad sa khul 'ga' shas la mi gson po sa 'og sba ba'i srol yang med par byas shing / bu mo skyes ma thag gsod pa'i lugs srol yang mi chog par bzos pa dang / bran g.yog lugs srol dang / yan lag dang dbang po la skyon gtong ba'i khrims gcod sogs mi chog ge bzos pa red/ de ltar rgya gar gyi rgyal po'am rgyal phran sus kyang khrims lugs las 'gal ba'i srol ngan rnams byed sa med pa lta bur gyur pa red/la'urenas yis dbyin yul gyi che mthong la ma gnod par byas te/ so so'i sger gyi dbang nus kyi sgo nas rgya gar gyi mi mang rnams skyed po dang / phun sum tshogs pa yong thabs byas te/ so sos dbang sgyur bya sa'i khra mang rnams la gdung sems dang khrims mthun spru khe dbang sprad na de tshos kyang dbang sgyur mkhan la snang chung mi byed pa'i yid ches byas te/ nang gi 'dzin skyong la do snang gis mi mang rnams la skyid po yong thabs byas pa red/ der brten de'i ring spyir btang rgya gar la mi rnams blo khongs pa yod pa red/
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 223āṇḍa myayo/ (phyi lo 186941872)sar jonyan la'urenda yi rjes su āṇḍa mayo zhes pa de rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab tu bskos shing / de ni rgya gar gyi rgyal po rnams dang / nub gling pa'i mi tshang ma'i nang dga' mos sam sgyi mos byed sa zhig yin pa red/ kho rang sger gyi rang gshis bzang zhing bag spro po zhig yod tshod/āṇḍa 4yo yis rgya gar du dpal 'byor bgo 'grems byas te dbus gzhung dang /mnga' sde'i gzhung gnyis ku'i dpal 'byor la dbang sgyur dam po byas pa dang chabs cig mnga' sde so so'i 'gro gron rnams kyi 'gan mnga' sde gzhung so sor sprad nas 'gro gron gyi rtsis gzhi zhib phra dgos par gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / skor srung ba dang /btson khang dang / shes yon dang / sman khang ngam 'phrod bsten gyi bya ba rnams mnga' sde gzhung gi 'gan khur 'og tu bzhag de dag gi ched du mnga' sde'i gzhung la dgos dngul rgyas bcad kyis sprad/ gal te dgos gal byung na mnga' sde'i gzhung la khral 'phar bsdug te dgos dngul mang du gtong ba'i dbang cha yang sprad pa red/ de ltar dpal 'byor thad dbus gzhung gis gcig dbang ma yin par dpal 'byor bgo 'grems byed srol gtod mkhar thog ma ni āṇḍa myayo 'di nyid yin/ kho'i srid yun ring kha che tsho la slob sbyong sprod rgyu'i ched du do snang che ba byas yod pa dang / rgya gar du dbyin ji'i lugs srol ltar gyi slob sbyong 'go 'dzugs byas rjes kha che'i mi rigs tsho ni mi rigs gzhan dag rnams las slob sbyong skyo ba byung nas rjes lus thebs pa de shes te lā〉 lngayos phyi lo 1871 phyi zla 8 tshog bdun nyin gros chod gtan 'bebs byas te grong sde lhan tshogs sogs sa gnas 'dzin skyong sde tshan khag la kha che tshor dbyin ji'i lugs srol ltar deng dus kyi slob sbyong la do snang byed dgos pa'i thabs shes byas pa
224 'phagasayul 9 byung babarjod pa/red/ der ma zad ajamer la mayo mtho rim slob grwa zhes pa zhig rgyal sras tsho dang /sku drag tsho'i phru gu tsho'i slob sbyong ched du rmang gzhi bting yod pa red/rgya gar gyi lho shar mtsho gling añtsamān la gzhung gi 'dzin skyong nor 'khrul can de la legs bcos thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sgrug byas pa red/ 'on kyang phyi lo 1872lor kha che'i mi rigs pasmyun zhig gis āṇḍa myayo bkrongs pa red/āṇḍa no buruka (phyi lo 187241876)āṇḍa nothaburuka zhes pa de ni mi dogs zon chen po zhig dang gzab gzab byed mkhan zhig yin par bshad cing / de la spyod lam mdzes shing 'dzin skyong la mkhas pa'i cha nas bstod bsngags zhus dang zhu bzhin pa red/ kho la 'gyur ba gtong 'dod med par des sngon ma tsho'i rjes su 'brangs pa red/ 1873 lor khos khral yang du gtong rgyu dang / dgos gal mi che ba'i khrims gzhi bzo rgyu mtshams 'jog bya rgyu'i dril bsgrags byas pa red/ kho ni 'bri rtsom la mkhas pa min zhing / skad cha shod mkhas po yang med pa zhig yin yang khrims thag gcod mkhas po yod pa zhig red/āṇḍa lngayo'i skabs nas aphaXnistun gyi skor rmyog khra zhig yod bzhin pa de āṇḍa nothaburuka skabs su yang gnas pas dka' ngal gang mtshams byung yod pa dang / rgya gar du bca' bzhuḍa dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab kyis gros 'debs byas pa de dbyin yul gyi rgya gar las don blon pos khas len ma byas par ma zad des rgya gar du bca' sdod dbyen ji'i rgyal tshab sogs gzhung zhabs pa tshang ma kho'i 'og tu gnas pa yin pas dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab kyis gros 'debs dang bsam tshul la khog dgag bya byed rgyu'i dbang cha yod tshul bshad pa na/ rgyal tshab āṇḍa no buruka gis rgyal tshab kyis gtsos pa'i gzhung
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjodapa/ 225zhabs pa tshang ma rgya gar las don blon po'i 'og yin yang dbyin ji'i gros tshogs kyis dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab la thob dbang chen po ma sprad na yang rgyal tshab kyi lhan tshogs la dbang cha gang mtshams sprad yod tshul rtsod gleng byed dgos byung /de'i srid yun ring pañtsab nang gi kuX zer ba'i chos lugs la mgo mkhregs po yod pa'i tshogs pa zhig gis kha che mang po dmar gsod btang ba red/ der ma zad de tshos so so'i khrims las gzhung gi khrims la : gi yod pa ma red/ kuX'i mi rigs 'dzin bzung byas pa rnams la nyes chad btang yang da dung khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod mang du song bar ma zad de tsho'i tshogs sde gcig gis lāḥlānā'i nye 'gram mkhar rdzong zhig thog btsan rgol gyis gzhung mdzod sogs la 'phrog bcom byed pa'i 'bad pa byas par brten/ gzhung gis drag po'i las don byed dgos byung ste/ lāḥlānā'i rdzong dpon sogs dpon rigs gnyis kyis kuka'i mi rigs 'tsho ba la zhugs pa 68 'dzin bzung dang / lnga bcu tham pa me 'phen gyis dmar gsod btang ba dang / mthar lhag ma 68 yang srog thog tu btang ba red/ las don de yongs rdzogs la nyes can tsho la khrims zhib gcig kyang byas med pas sa gnas gsar shog nang rdzong gi dpon rigs gnyis pos spyod tshul ngan pa byas pa'i skor thon bkod byas pa na mi dmangs kyis dpon rigs de gnyis kyi las don la ngo rgol gyis skad 'bod sogs byas pas rgya gar dbyin gzhung gis zhib dpyod kyis rjong dpon las 'khur nas phyir 'bud byas shing / rdzong dpon las rogs gnas spo byas pa red/nothaburuka gi srid yun ring gujarata'i sa gnas b.rodu yi dbang 'dzin pa gāyakalhar de srid dbang 'dzin tshul nyes pas khri las phabs te gzhan zhig khri la bkod pa sogs byas te sa khul der zing cha che tsam byung yod tshod/
226 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/phyi lo 1873474 lor bahār mnga' khul dang / baṅgāl gyi cha shas 'ga' ru mu ge byung bas 'phral du gzhung gis dngul 'bor chen po 'gro gron btang nas mi mang sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba tsho la rogs ram rgya che byas yod 'dug de min kho'i srid yun de zhi bde lteng 'jag lta bu zhig byung ba dang / khos rgya gar la che mthong gi rnam pa ston mkhan zhig dang / rgya gar gyi las don la do snang mu mthud byed mkhan zhig yin pa red/āṇḍa lebyon/ (phyi lo 187641880)nonaburuka gi rjes su āṇḍa letsun rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab tu bskos shing /kho ni blo stobs che ba dang / dran rgyu mang zhing / khengs dregs dang nus pa che ba zhig yin pa dang / phyi lo 1831 phyo zla brtsu gcig pa'i ches brgyad nyin skyes pa red/kho'i ming dngos gnas ni iṇawaṇḍa robarla bulawar lebyon zer zhing / khos herara'u dang / jaramen gyi grong khyer sbon la slob sbyong byas pa red/ kho ni 'bri rtsom la mkhas shing rang lo sum cu tsam du snyan ngag pod gnyis par 'debs byas yod pa red/kho ni rtsom la mkhas pa ma zad skad cha shod mkhas po zhig kyang yin pa red/ kho dbyin ji'i phye srid kyi sri zhu ba yin pas nub gling du go gnas sna tshogs su las don byas/spru lo 1875 lor rgya gar la madrusa'i srid skyong du bskos kyang des khas len ma byas par snyan ngag 'bri rtsom gyis mi che zhi bde'i ngang skyel 'dod byas pa red/ 'on kyang lo gcig gi rjes rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab bam srid skyong spyi khyab tu sko bzhag byas par kho rang gi chung mas go gnas de khas len bya dgos tshul nan tan gyis bskul bar brten kho 1876 lor dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab tu yong ba red/
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 227kho rgya gar du 'byor ma thag mu ge'i 'jigs pa la gdong len byed dgos byung ba red/ phyi lo 1875 nas 1878 bar rgya gar la mu ge'i 'jigs pa byung ste mi zog gnyis ka la skyon chen po byung ba red/ zla ba mang por char pa ma byung ba dang /char pa byung dus chu log byung ba bcas kyis mu ge byung nas de'i grub 'bras ngan pa yun ring po'i bar gnas/ miswār dang / rtedarā6da dang / baṅgāl gyi rdzong mang po dang /basbra'i rdzong khul khag mang po dang / maXsa'i cha shas mang por mu ge'i gnod skyon tshabs che byung bar ma zad nub byang gi mnga' khul khag dang / awadha la yang gnod skyon byung bas mi sa ya sum cu so dgu tsam dang / sa khyon le dbar mi le gru bzhi nyis 'bum tsam la gnod skyon byung yod pa red/ de bzhin gzhung khral du sgor bye ba gnyis lhag tsam gyong gun byung ba red/der brten gzhung gis ches mtho'i lhan tshogs shig btsugs te mu ges gdung ba rnams la skyob gso sogs sprod rgyu'i thad zhib 'jug gis mu ges gdung ba'i sa khul khag dang / mi mang rnams la skyob gso rogs ram byas pa red/lebyon gyis sngon ma'i rgyal tshab gsum gyi srid byus 'jam po de las ldog ste gapha1nistun gyi skor srid byus drag tu btang nas rgyal sa ༷bul la dbyin ji'i sku tshab 'dzugs dgos rgyu dang / aphaXnistun gyi phyi srid kyi dbang cha dbyin ji la dgos tshul gyi thabs shes byas kyang aphashānilhan gyi rgyal pos dbyin ji'i sku tshab dang len mi byed pa'i lan btab pa sogs la brnyad de 1878 lor dbyin jis aphaXnistun thog dmag gi dril bsgrags byas te dka' tshogs cher ma byung bar aphaXnistun gyi mnga' khul gal che ba rnams blangs te rgyal sa ༷bul la dbyin ji'i sku tshab bzhag pa dang / chings yig bzhag pa red/ 'on kyang 1879 lor dbyin ji'i sku tshab dmar gsod btang
228 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjed pa/ste dbyin ji la ngo rgol shin tu drag po byas pa red/ der ma zad lenan gyis aphaXnistun la dam ga 'thab byas pa de la 'dzam gling yongs rjogs kyis skyon brjod byas pas de la don phan ma byung bar ma zad skyon cha chen po byung yod/de nas lenan gyis nor 'khrul gnyis pa byas pa ni yul skad kyo gsar khang gi khrims gzhi zhes pa zhig phyi lo 1878 lor bzos pa de yin la/ de yang rgya gar gyi mi'i srog dang rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor 'gro gron du btang nas don med aphaspyanastun thog dmag 'khrug brgyabs par brten rgya gar gyi mi zog gnyis thad nas chud zos su phyin pas mi mang la dka' ngal byung tshul sogs skyon brjod ji snyed cig rgya gar gyi skad rigs kyi gsar shog khag tu bkod pa dang / de la phugs bsam med cing mgo mkhregs pa'i rgyal tshab lebyon gyis dbyin yul du rgya gar las don blon po la hār btang nas rgya gar gyi gsar shog tshos 'che ba'i las 'dul byas te ngo log slong gi yod tshul gsal bshad byas te/ gsar khang gi khrims gzhi la zhal bzhes yong ba'i 'bod skul zhus/de'i nyin mo rang du khrims bzo tshogs pa 'bod 'grugs kyis yul skad kyi gsar khang khrims gzhi zhes pa de bzos pa dang / khrims gzhi de ltar na rgya gar 9 skad rigs nang gsar shog tshang ma'i rtsom sgrig pa rnams nas gzhung la mi dga' mi 'dod pa'i gnas tshul gang yang 'god rgyu min pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos pa red/ de ni smra brjod kyi rang dbang 'phrogs pa'i bya spyod thabs sdug cig red/ dbyin dzo'i skad nang gi gsar shog la de 'dra'i dam bsgrags yod pa ma red/ de nas baṅgāl skad nang amṛta hādzār pasprikā zer ba zhig phyo lo 1868 nas 'don spel byed bzhin yod pa de glo bur du dbyin skad gsar shog tu gyur pa dang / maXs nas thon pa'i di hiḥ zhes pa'i gsar shog de yang dbyin skad du gyur par ma zad nyin re'i gsar shog tu yang gyur pa dang /
le'u gsum pa/ deng dusasprebyung ba brgyud pa/ 229de'i 'bras bur rgya gar gyi mi mang tshos dbyin ji'i byed stangs la ma dga' ba che ru phyin pa dang / letsun gyi so so'i dmigs yul yang ma grub pa red/lebyon gyis dpal 'byor gyi skor 'gyur ba 'ga' shas btang ba ni sngar rgya gar dbyin gzhung gi mnga' hra so sor tshwa yi khral che chung mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bsdu srol yod pa dang / 'ga' shas la tshwa bzo 'don byed pa'i thob thang yang med pa yin yang lebyon gyis sa khul tshang mar tshwa khral gcig mtshungs bzos pa red/ der ma zad khos shing bal gyi gos sogs dngos rigs sna kha nyi shu rtsa dgu'i thog phyi zog nang 'dren gyi khral med pa bzos pa red/ āṇḍa mānas dpal 'byor gcig bsdu min par bdo 'grems byas pa ltar letsun gyis dpal 'byor bgo 'grems mang du btang nas da dung las don mang ba mnga' sde'i gzhung la sprad yod pa red/lebyon gyis rgya gar gyi rgyal khams tsho'i las don skor gros 'debs byed ched dbang 'dzin rgyal po tsho'i tshogs pa rgya gar ba'i sger gyi lhan tshogs zhes pa zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i gros gzhi phul yang rgya gar las don blon pos ngos len ma gnang ba red/ 'on kyang rjes su phyi lo 1919 lor tshogs pa de 'dra bo zhig btsugs te de la rgyal sras lhan tshogs zhes btags yod pa red/ āṇḍa letsun gyis 1878lor rgya gar mtshon cha'i khrims gzhi zer ba zhig bzos te rgya gar ba'i mi rigs tshos mtshon cha ltar 'dod na de tshos lag khyer thob dgos pa red/ 'on kyang nub gling pa'i mi rigs tsho la de ltar ma dgos/lebyon gyi skabs su shes yon la yar rgyas cung zad byung yod de/ aliXṭa sa gnas su dbyin ji shar phyogs kha che'i mtho rim slob grwa zer ba zhig btsugs pa de dus phyis su aliXṭa kha che'i gtsug lag slob khang chen mor gyur yod pa de red/

le'u gsumapa/ deng dusakyi byungab brjodapa/ 239āṇḍa 9phrarin/ (phyi lo 188541888)āṇḍa ripon gyi rjes su āṇḍa ḍathorin rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab tu bskos pa dang / ḍa5rin de nyid gzhung zhabs pa rnying pa zhig yin la srid don dang / phyo 'brel gzhung tshab khang sogs su yun ring nyams myong dang ldan pa zhig yin par ma zad phyo lo 186441868bar rgya gar las don yig tshang gi drung che gzhon pa gnang ba dang / kenāX'i yul du dbyin ji'i srid skyong spyi khyab dang / urusu dang / tuka la dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab dang / dus yun gang mtshams ring yijisna la dmigs bsal dbyin ji'i sku tshab chen mo bcas gnang myong yod pa red/ kho ni rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab byed par lo na rgan skyon yod pa zhig yin pas dka' ngal gsar pa rnams la gdong len dang / srid byug gsar pa 'do 'dzugs byed 'dod med pa zhig yin pa red/ de lta mod kyang gzhung don la nyams myong che zhing 'jon thang can zhig yin pas las don gag po byas yod pa red/ḍathorin gyis phye lo 1885 dang / 1886 dang / 1887 bcas so sor sa zhing g.yar 'dzin gyi khrims gzhi gsum bzos pa des rim bzhin baṅgāl dang /gawanta dang / pañtsab bcas kyi zhing pa rnams la phan thogs chen po byung yod cing /de yang baṅgāl gyi sa zhing g.yar 'dzin gyi khrims gzhi des zhing pa tsho la srung skyob bam brtan cha chen po byung bar ma zad sa zhing g.yar 'dzin gyi gla cha'am bogs ma rnams sa bdag tshos rang 'dod kyis gang byung len mi chog pa bzos pa dang / gawadha'i sa zhing g.yar 'dzin gyi khrims gzhi des zhing pa tshos sa zhing rnams lo bdun re nyar chog pa dang chabs cig sa zhing yar rgyas gtong ched sdun gsab kyang sa bdag gis sprod dgos pa'i thob thang sprad pa red/ 1887 gyi panāb sa zhing g.yar 'dzin gyi khrims gzhi de
240 'phagasayulagyi byung ba brjod pa/zhing pa tsho las khrims thog nas sa zhing 'phrog pa'i sa bdag gi dbang cha nyung du btang bar ma zad sa zhing g.yar 'dzin gyi gla cha'am bogs ma spor mi chog pa'i skor gtan 'bebs byas/ khrims gzhi de dag las gzhung gis sa zhing bdag po tsho'i byed stangs la the byug sogs byed thub pa byung zhing byed dgos pa yang byung tshod/ḍathorin gyi srid yun ring shin tu gal che ba'i gnas tshul gsar pa zhig byung ba ni rgya gar rgyal yongs kāñdzas tshogs pa zhes pa'i 'dzugs skrun byung ba de yin zhing /de ni dbyin ji'i zhi ba'i sre zhu ba las don nas 'khyol ba irsān okakhrigan snum zer ba de dang rgya gar ba'i dbu 'khrid grags can kha shas kyis 'go 'dzugs byas pa zhig red/thog mar tshogs pa de ni rgya gar gyi rma mang rnams kyi sred don yar rgyas dang / spyi tshogs legs bcos dang / kun spyod sogs yar rgyas ched du dmigs pa'i tshogs pa zhig yin zhing / rim bzhin tshogs pa 'di la 'gyur ba sna tshogs byung nas 'go 'khrid grags pa can dang / yul zhen ldan pa ji snyed gcig gis yar rgyas btang nas mthar rang btsan gyi las 'dul mthar phyin don ldan byas pa red/ 'di'i skor 'og twā 'chad par 'gyur/phyi lo 1886 dang 1887 lor mi mang sri zhu tshogs pa'am mi mang las byed bdag gnyer khang 'dzugs skrun byas te/ 1891 nas las don lag len du bstar yod 'dugyang phyi lo 1886 lor gaXlegar mkhar rdzong de mahārāju si:tshi la cas sprod byas shing / berār sa khul de yang bzhag nas de'i tshab tu 〉rsā'i grong khyer blangs yod tshod/phyi lo 1887 lor dbyin ji'i 7gong ma rgyal mo khri9rilta yis rgyal srid

246 'phagasayul gyi grang babarjod pa/nang dmag mi chig athi+-i nyis stong tsam yod pa red/ de ltar dbyin snga'i dmag dpung rnams sa mtshams mthar ma bzhag par rgyab tu bsdad nas dbang sgyur byas shing dngos gnas sa mtshams mthar sa mtshams kyi mi sde tshogs pa'i dmag mi btsugs te de tsho'i dpa' rtsal dang dmag 'thab kyi yon tan la bed spyod byas pas srid byug des sa mtshams brtan po byung bar ma zad nub byang sa mtshams sa khul zhes pa'i mnga' sde gsar pa zhig kyang bzos pa red/ mnga' sde gsar pa de'i nang chu bo sirnyu'i pha rol gyi sa tshogs ring po de dang / aphaXnistun gyi sa mtshams kyi ri khul sa gnas rgya chen po de tshud yod pa red/ mnga' sde gsar pa de 3 lo 1901 lor dngos su bzos pa de spyi khyab chen mo gcig gi thad ku'i dbang 'og hu bzhag pa red/ der ma zad aphaXnistun dang mnyam rtsod gling sogs byung mthar yul der dbyin ji'i nus shugs yod pa gang zhig la mthun 'brel gyi gnas stangs su gyur pa red/parashiya'i mtsho khug parashilā'i mtsho khug la dbyin ji'i gnas stangs shin tu legs shing khul de yongs rdzogs su dbyin ji'i nus shugs kyis khyab yod pa dang /dbyin snga'i bde don lta ched der dbyin ji'i sku tshab gcig yod pa red/ khul de'i rgyud rgyal khab gtso che ba khag ni masageṭa dang / omān dang / ku3ta dang / bsarā dang / btasthān dang parashilā bcas yin ba red/ der ma zad parashilā'i mtsho khug de ni dbyin yul dang rgya gar bar gyi tshong lam gal che lte ba yin yang āṇḍa kuradzan rgya gar la ma 'byor tsam du yul 'di tsho'i gnas stangs dka' rnyog chen por gyur/ de ni nub gling gi yul gzhan dper na phrusadang / jaraman dang / urusu dang / tuka sogs kyi bya spyod dang nus shugs 'phel ba las byung yod pa red/ nub gling pa de tshog yul de tshor mdza' 'brel byed tshul dang / dpal 'byor gyi 'char gzhi 'dzugs skrun

248 'phags yul 9 grang ba brjod pa/dpon ya hasaben yis bod gyi dbu 'khrid dpon rigs mtho ba rnams dang mthar gros bsdur gyis chengs yig bzhag pa red/lha sa'i chings yig de rjes su bzo bcos byas te/ dmag 'khrug gi gun gsab sprod phyogs gtan 'bebs byas yod pa red/ chings yig de'i don tshan gzhan dag ni/bod kyi sa gnas rgyal tna dang / sgar thog dang / gro mo la dbyin dzi'i tshong las kyi rten gzhi 'dzugs rgyu dang / dbyin ji'i tshong don do dam pa rgyal rtse la gtan sdod bya rgyu dang / de nyid lha sar 'gro skyod chog rgyu dang / bod kyis so so'i sa khul gzhan la sprod rgyu min pa dang / 3 rgyal gzhan 9 sku tshab dang len rma byed rgyu dang / dbyin gzhung gi bka' khrol med par su la'ang thob dbang mi sprod pa sogs 'khod yod pa red/chings yig de bzhin rgya nag gis khas blangs yod cing / spru lo 1907lor dbyin ji dang urusu gnyis bar chings yig gcig bzhag ste bod du rgya nag gi srid dbang gi bsil grib yod par phyogs gnyis mas khas blangs shing dbyin ji dang rgya nag gnyis kyi chings yig nang gi don tshan tshang ma yang khas len byas pa red/mda' dpon ya hasaben yi dpung dmag lha sar 'dzul zhugs byas pa de las dbyin ji dang rgya gar gnyis ched phugs kyi grub 'bras gang yang ma thon pa yin zhing / rgyal rbha dang sgar thog la tshong las kyi rten gzhi tshugs pa de gcig pu dpung 'jug byas pa'i grub 'bras yin/ grub 'bras dngos gnas ni bod du rgya nag gi sred dbang gi grib ma yod pa de rgya nag gi srid don dbang shugs dngos gnas su gyur pa de yin pas dbyin jis bod du dpung 'jug byas pa des bod kyi ched du grub 'bras shin tu ngan pa zhig byung ba red/ dbyin dmag bod nas phyir log rjes bod la srung skyob gang yang ma byas pas bod yul de la rgya nag gis ngan byus byed thub ba byung ba dang /
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus gyi byung ba brjod pa/ 249dbyin ji'i rgyal khams kyi mnga' ris rgya skyed kyang ma byung ba red/ kuradzan gyis gal te dbyin ji 7gong ma'i rgyal khams kyi mnga' ris rgya skyed ched bod la dpung 'jug byas pa yin na dbyin dmag la rgyal kha thob rjes dbyin jis bod du dbang sgyur byed dgos kyang de ltar ma byas pa dang / chings yig bzhag pa la lag len tshul bzhin bstar na bod la srung skyob ji bzhin 'jog dgos pa sogs yin yang de yang ma byas pa de shin tu nas khyad mtshar la brjod dka' ba zhig red/ gang ltar dbyin jis urusu'i nus shugs bod nas phyir 'bud byas shing tshong 'brel sgo nas bod dang mthun 'brel yag po byas nas bsdad yod pa red/nad rims 'gog thabs/ āṇḍa kuradzan phyi lo 1899 lor rgya gar du 'byor rjes dka' ngal dang po ni nad rims kyi dka' ngal de yin zhing / phyi lo 1896lor balha.āo la nad rims yod par gtan khel byung / phyi lo 1898 lor kralakarmā la nad rims yod par ngos zin yod pa de ni mchan khung skrang sbos kyi nad rims zhig yon tshod/ kuradzan gyis nad rims de'i khyab 'phel 'dog thabs la dmigs te balharmā dang 6spya la phyin nas nad rims bcos sa'i sman khang sogs la lta skor dang nad rims sngon 'dog gi thabs tshul khag la dngos su zhib 'jug byas/ phyi lo 1904lor nad rims skor nyams zhib tshogs pa btsug ste sbyong brdar can gyi nad 'bu'i skor mkhas pa rnams sko bzhag byas/ nyams zhib tshogs pas 'phral du shes rtogs byung ba la gzhi byas te nad kyi 'byung khungs tsi tsi med pa bzo ba'i las 'gul nan tan gyis byas par ma zad mi mang rnams la sman khab brgyabs pa dang / rgya gar yongs su gtsang sbra yong thabs byas pa red/mu ge las skyob thabs/ mi mang la nad rims kyi dka' ngal gcig pā ma
250 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/yin par mu ge'i 'jigs pa chen po byung zhing / phyi lo 1896 dang 1897 lo gnyis ring char chu ma byung bas mu gi byung ba dang / 1899 dang 1900 lo gnyis mu mthud mu ge byung ba red/ char chu ma byung ba des sa cha le dbar gru bzhi 'bum bzhi lhag tsam la do phog byung ste/ gujarātra mnga' sde lta bu'i phyug po lo brgya phrag ring mu ge nam yang ma byung ba'i mnga' khul de yang yi dwags kyi gnas su gyur pa red/phyi lo 1900 lor mu ge'i skyob gso'i ma dngul btsugs te/ de la rgya gar gyis dbyin sgor nyis 'bum lhag zhal 'debs sprad pa dang / yul gzhan dper na dbyin yul dang lngaste.i.ā dang / jaraman sogs kyis dbyin sgor bdun 'bum brgyad khri lnga stong zhal 'debs phul ba dang / skyob gso'i ma dngul de tsho mu ger/ gdung ba'i mi mang tsho la gyon gos dang / nasbral dang / sman bcos mthun rkyen dang / son 'bru nyo rgyu dang / dud 'gro'i 'tsho skyong dang / dud 'gro la rtsa chag dang / zhing las yo byad sogs su bed spyod byas pas ma tshad sa zhing bdag po tshor bu lon snga ldengs sprad pa dang / gzhan yang rogs ram sna tshogs byas pa red/ der ma zad sa zhing gi khral yang chags yang du btang ba red/ kuradzan kyis mu ge rtogs zhib tshogs pa btsugs te sa khral chag yang dang / mu ge skyob gso'i gra sgrig sngon tshud nas byed dgos pa dang / dud 'gro dang son lud nyo byed ma dngul sngon sprod dgos pa'i snyan sgron zhus pa ltar lag len byas pa red/so nam las don/ phye lo 1901 lo'i mi grangs tho gsher byas pa las grong gseb kyi mi grangs bcu cha dgu ni dngos shugs gang rung las so nam gyi las don la brten yod par shes te/ kurangon gyis rgya gar gyi so nam pa rnams ni dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab kyi dmigs yul dang po dang mtha' ma gnyis ka yin zhes dril bsgrags byas
le'u sumapa/ deng dus kyu byungab brjod pa/ 251te so nam dang so nam pa'i skor legs bcos byas yod pa red/phyi lo 1859 lor dbyin jis panāb la dbang 'dzin byas rjes zhing pa tshor bu lon gyi khur ljid chen po byung ba dang / de las zhing pa tshos sa zhing rnams pe shag yod mkhan gyi phyug po tshor 'tshong dgos byung ste mthar dka' sdug tu tshud pa red/lngarngo kurangon gyis 1901 lor pa②ba sa zhing bdag dbang 'pho 'gyur khrims gzhi zhes pa zhig bzos te zhing pa tshos sa zhing su la'ang 'tshong mi chog cing sus kyang gzhung gi bka' khrol med par sa zhing 'tshong mi chog par bzos pa red/der ma zad ma dngul tshogs pa zer ba zhig btsugs te zhing pa tsho la dgos dngul rogs ram thob par bzos pa de'i dminge yul ni pe shag yod mkhan tshos zhing pa tsho la pe shag g.yar skyed byas nas skyed kha shin tu chen po len gyi yod pa de bsal ba'i don du yin pa red/der ma zad kuradzan gyis gros chod gcig bton don bzhin lo nyes byung ba'i skabs khral la chag yang gtong tshul gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / 3 lo 1905lor baṅgāl gyi sa gnas pus zer bar so nam nyams zhib khang zhig kyang 'dzugs skrun byas pa red/ des ma zad zhing chu 'dren pa'i las don rtogs pa'i tshogs pa btsugs te brtag dpyad zhib nan byas te yur ba gsar bzo byas pa red/'dzin skyong la legs bcos/ de bar gyi 'dzin skyong la skyon cha yod par mthong nas kuradzan gyis 'dzin skyong thad legs bcos du ma byas pa dpe mtshon tsam ni/kho'i 'og gi gzhung zhabs pa tsho la las khungs nang phan tshun yig chung 'bri rgyu nyung du gtong dgos ayau bka' khyab tsha nan byas shing / sde tshan so so'i las 'gan rnams sger gyi gros bsdur gyis mthus tshang bya rgyu'i bka' khyab kyang gnang / yog tshang gi
252 'phagasayul 9 byungab brjod pa/bca' khrims gcig mtshungs dang / gzhung gi las byed pa'i phogs thob la bskyar zhib byas te las ka la tshags tshud che thabs byas pas ma tshad mnga' sde'i gzhung rnams la'ang 'dzin skyong legs po dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang /skor srung ba'i sgrig 'dzugs la skyon cha chen po yod pa de bsal thabs kyis zhib dpyod tshogs pa btsugs ti skor srung ba tsho'i gla phogs spar ba dang / mnga' sde'i skor srung ba'i grangs tshad kyang spar ba red/ skor srung ba'i sbyong brdar slob grwa khag btsugs shing / nag can nyen rtogs gsang ba'i sde tshan zur du btsugs nas de la srid don gyi nag nyes can the ba'i nag nyes bya spyod tshang mar 'dri rtsad byed pa'i thob dbang yod pa red/khrims khang dang 'brel ba'i legs bcos/ kurangon gyis khrims dpon tsho'i gla phogs spar ba dang / las 'khyur skabs rgas phogs kyang spar ba dang / khrims khang chen mo'i khrims dpon gyi grangs mang du btang ba red/ der ma zad rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs rtsod rnyog gi zhal lce la bskur zhib yag po zhig kuradzan gyi skabs byas yod pa red/dpal 'byor legs bcos/ phyi lo 1899 lor rgya gar gyi ṭam sgor dang shog dngul gyi khrims gzhi zhes pa gtan 'bebs byas te sgor mo gcig nas lnga bar gyi shog dngul sogs bzos shing gser dang ma dang brje len gyi 'gan len gzhung gis byas/ de'i don du gzhung mdzod du gser gyi mdzod gtan 'jag bzhag yod pa red/der ma zad dbus gzhung dang mnga' sde'i gzhung bar dpal 'byor ba 'go 'grems dang mnga' sde'i gzhung la dpal 'byor gyi rang dbang mang ba sprad/ tshwa sogs dngos zog mang po'i thog khral nyung du btang ba sogs byas/
le'u gsum pa/ dengadusakyu byung ba brjodapa/ 253me 'khor rgya skyed/ kraradzan gyis me 'khor lcags lam rgya skyed la do snang chen po byas pa red/ rgyal tshab āṇḍa elagin rgya gar nas thon dus rgya gar du me 'khor lcags lam gyi ring tshad le dbar nyes khri nyis stong bzhi bcu (22040) las med kyang āṇḍa kuradzan rgya gar nas thon skabs me 'khor lcags lam le dbar nyis khri brgyad stong chig brgya lnga bcu tham pa 28150 bzos rin pa dang / le dbar sum stong chig brgya drug rtsu re bdun 3167 gyi ring tshad kyi lcags lam bzo bzhin yod pa red/der ma zad khos me 'khor 'dzin skyong tshogs pa yang btsugs pa red/sa gnas rang gzhung / phyo lo 1900 phyi zla bzhi pa'i nang sprulakarmā'i grong khyer lhan tshogs spre khrims gzhi zhig lag len du bstar ba ltar sprulakaṅgā'i grong khyer lhan tshogs nang nub phyogs pa'i mi rigs mang ba gtan du yod dgos shing rgyun las kyi dbang cha tshang ma de la yod dgos pa zhig red/ mdor bsdus na grong sde lhan tshogs de gzhung zhabs pa tsho'i dbang 'og tu bcug pa zhig red/ der brten khrims de la rgyal yongs ring lugs pa tshos ngo rgol byas shing / de'i skyon tshang ma kuradzan thog bkal ba red/ es en benaratna yis gtsos pa'i 'thus mi rtswa shu rtsa brgyad kyis sprulakabhā'i grong sde lhan tshogs nas dgongs pa zhus pa red/shes yon legs bcos/ āṇḍa kuradzan gyis shes yon skor legs bcos byas kyang de la phyogs gang sa nas skyon brjod byung ba red/ phyi lo 1901 lor kuradzan gyis shes yon la mkhas pa grags can tsho'i tshogs 'du zhig bskongs ba de la rgya gar ba gzhung zhabs min pa su yang skad ma btang / tshogs 'du de'i grub 'bras lta bur gtsug lag slob grwa chen mo khag gi skor tshogs pa zhig 1902 3 zla dang po'i ches 27 nyin btsugs pa red/ tshogs pa de'i snyan sgron gyi don tshan du ma 1904
254 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/phroṃ rla gsum pa'i ches 21 nyin gtan 'bebs byas pa'i mtho rim gtsug lag slob grwa'i khrims gzhi'i nang bzhag yod pa red/khrims gzhi de ltar mtho rim gtsug lag slob khang chen mo khag gi 'dzin skyong lhan tshogs kyi grangs nyung du gtong rgyu dang / de yi dbang tshad kyi khyab khongs yang rgyas bcad byed rgyu sogs yod pa red/ mtho rim gtsug lag slob grwa'i khrims gzhi de la rgya gar ba tshang mas skyon brjod byas pa dang / rgya gar rgyal yongs kānas tshogs pas khrims gzhi de khas mi len par dgag pa byed rgyu'i gros chod bzhag pa dang /āṇḍa kurangon gyis legs bcos de shes yon la legs bcos ma yin par srid don gyi sgyur bcos btang ba red ces skyon brjod byas pa red/ bshad tshul ltar na dong gsal mtho rim gtsug lag slob khang gi khrims gzhi de'i dmigs yul ni mtho rim gtsug lag slob khang khag tu rgyal yongs ring lugs pa mi thon pa dang / rgya gar mi mang rgya che ba de shes yon slob sbyong las phyi rol du 'jog thub na yul 'dir dbyin ji'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi srid dbang mu mthud gnas pa yong rgyu bcas red/'on kyang kuradzan gyis shes yon la legs bcos byas par yon tan nam legs pa'i cha shas gtan nas med pa ma yin te/ khos shes yon gyi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa'am spyi khyab nges ston pa sko bzhag byas pa dang / sngon 'gro'i slob grwa'i lo 'khor dgos dngul dbyin sgor nyis 'bum sum khri lhag sprad par ma zad sngon 'gro'i slob grwa stong phrag mang po sgo phyes pa dang / dge rgan tsho'i phogs legs su btang ba dang / grong gseb pa'i slob phrug tsho'i don du so nam gyi slob tshan dmigs bsal ba bslabs pa dang / tshan rig dang 'phrul las kyi slob sbyong la yang bskyar zhib gsar bcos byas par oṃ zad ba6lor la jamashed: 99 yis tshan rig gi slob grwa zhig btsuḍa
