le'u gsum pa/ deng dus skya byungababarjod pa/ 263dirsā rgyal sar gyur pa/ tshogs 'du de yi skabs pe shag dang rgyu nor 'grems sprod byas pas ma tshad gal che'i gsal bsgrags 'ga' shas byas pa ni/ rgya gar gyi rgyal sa sprulaka( nas lda4 la spo rgyu dang / baṅgāl dum bu btang ba de la rtsis med du btang nas gcig gyur bzo rgyu dang / āsam mnga' khul de zur du 'jog rgyu sogs kyi dril bsgrags byas pa red/ di: la rgyal sa bzo rgyu de la 'ga' shas kyis skyon brjod byas kyang de la dge mtshan mang po yod pas rgya gar gyi mi tshos de la dga' bsu zhus yod pa red/ baṅgāl gcig gyur byas pa de la yang dga' bsu zhus yod pa red/āṇḍa hāṇḍarsha thob/ 'brom zhus pa/ rgya gar gyi rgyal sa dirsā la spo rgyu'i tshos grangs ni 1912 zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i ches 23 nyen gtan khel bzos pa dang /de'i nyin degrwa'i me 'khor 'bab tshugs nas rgyal tshab mchog dang / rgyal tshab kyi lha lcam mchog dang / rgya gar gyi rgyal po khag dang / gzhung zhabs pa mtho ba rnams glang chen thog chibs nas chibs gral 'go 'dzugs byas pa dang / chibs gral de stsodani :ka nas brgal bzhin pa'i skabs glo bur du 'bar mdel zhig yong nas rgyal tshab kyis chibs pa'i glang chen la phog pa dang / lha lcam la mas skyon sogs ma byung yang / rgyal tshab hāṇḍarsha la rmas skyon chen po byung nas dran med du brgyal/ rgyab phyogs nas dbu gdugs 'dzin maban zhabs 'brengs pa de shi bar ma zad mi grangs sum rtsu nas bzhi bcu'i bar rmas skyon byung 'dug rgyal tshab kyi rna ba gnyis las gcig tsha gas su phyin/dran pa sog pa dang / sman bcos sogs byed bzhin pa'i skabs khong gis gsungs gsal las rim ltar mdzad sgo mu mthud bya dgos pa dang / khong gi gsung bshad de yang mdzad sgor dngo/na rigs rgan pa zhig nas sgrog byang dgos pa soḍa kyi bka' gnang ba red/
264 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/khong thog 'bar mdel zhus te skyon de ltar byas kyang / rgya gar ba tsho dang mnyam gdung sems mu mthud gnang yod pa red/ de ltar phal cher brgya phrag btsu gnyis pa tsam nas dbyin jis srid dbang ma bsgyur bar du rgya gar gyi rgyal sa dirsā yin pa ltar slar yang phyi lo 1912 pa'i nang di'i rgya gar gyi rgyal sar gyur pa de la rgya gar ba tshos dga' mos byas yod 'dug kyang / dbyin jis btsan dbang bsgrur bar rgyal yongs ring lugs pa tshos las 'grul la lhod yangs 'gro ma thub par mu mthud banas pa red/āṇḍa cesaphon/ (phyi lo 191641920)āṇḍa hāṇḍarsha gi rjes su āṇḍa cesapho/ rgyal tshab tu bskos shing / de'i reng 1919 lo'i rgya gar gzhung gi khrims gzhi gtan 'bebs byas te maXs sogs mnga' sde 'ga' shas su srid gzhung nyis sbrel zhes pa zhig gsar bzo byas te/ mnga' sde'i blon tshogs rnams 'os 'dems kyis rgya gar ba sko bzhag byas shing / srid skyong tshos srid dbang gtsor bzung byas te/ srid gzhung nyis brtsegs sam srid gzhung gnyis res mnyam du dbang byas pa lta bu zhig bzos shing / mthar lam lhong ldan pa ma byung tshod/ bdag nyid chen po gārdzas dbu 'khrid gnang ste mnyam 'brel mi byed pa'i las 'gul 'go 'dzugs byas/ amṛtasar la jaleganaXlā bāg zhes par btsan gnon gyis dmar gsod rkyen ngan byung ba red/āṇḍa erasmin/ (phyi lo 192641931)āṇḍa cesaphon yi rjes su āṇḍa erakhrin rgyal tshab bam srid skyong spyi khyab tu bskos pa de'i ring gal che'i gnas tshul ni/ su.iman tshogs pa zhes pa de rgya gar du bslebs pa de la rgya gar ba tshos ngo rgol rgyab gtad byas pa dang / rgyal yongs ༷ṅges tshogs
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus sprebyung babarjod pa/ 265pas 1929 lor rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan cha tshang dgos 'dun gyi gros chod gtan 'bebs byas/ spyi sde'i bka' gyen ldog gi las 'gul tshugs shing shāX'i dbyug pa'i 'grul skyod ces pa lo rgyus su grags pa de byas pa dang / 1930lor cog tse sgor mo'i tshogs 'du de lonagan du tshugs pa dang / gā'i dang erasmin gnyis bar 1931 lor gros mthun bzhag pa sogs red/āṇḍa khrikhricacan/ (phyi lo 1931—1936)āṇḍa erakhrin gyi rjes su luṇḍa khrislogatsun rgyal tshab tu bskos shing / de'i skabs su 1931 lor cog tse sgor sgor gyi tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa de tshugs shing / 1932lor mi rigs gzhan pa khag la bya dga' zhes pa'i khrims gzhi zhig dbyin jig bzos te rgya gar du rigs dma' ba dang / grangs nyung mi rigs 'ga' shas kyi ched du 'thus mi'i sa mig zur 'jog sogs byas pa dang / de las rgya gar nang gi mi rigs phan tshun bar chig sgril rtsa gtor gyi srid byug lag len du bstar ba dang / cog tse sgor sgor gyi tshogs 'du thengs gsum pa de 1932 lor tshugs pa dang / 1935 lor rgya gar gzhung gi khrims gzhi zhes pa gtan 'bebs kyis rgya gar gyi mnga' sde rnams la rang skyong ljongs kau thob thang sprad nas mnga' sde khag gi 'thus tshogs 'os 'dems kyis mnga' sde khag gi gzhung rgya gar ba'i dbu 'khrid tshos bskyangs te las don phal cher gag po bya rgyu dang / de bzhin dbus gzhung la yang 'thus mi rnams 'os 'dems byas te dbus gros tshogs 'dzugs rgyu dang / tshogs pa su la mang mos thob pa des blon chen lhan tshogs bzos nas gzhung srid rgya gar ba tshog bskyong rgyu sogs gtan 'bebs byas yod pa red/
266 'phagasayul 'a byung babarjod pa/āṇḍa lin thaX'u/ (phyi lo 193641942)āṇḍa khrislothertson gyi rjes su luṇḍa lenalithaX'u rgyal tshab tu bskos shing / de'i ring sngar gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rgya gar gzhung zhes pa'i khrims gzhi de 1937 lor dngos su lag len du bstar nas mnga' sde khag tu 'os 'dems byas par mnga' sde mang por ༷sgres la mang mos thob pas mnga' sde mang che bar kārjes yi gzhung dang /blon tshogs tshugs shing rgya gar ba'i dbu 'khrid tshog las don phal cher yag po byas pa dang / mnga' sde 'ga' shas su tshogs pa gzhan rnams mnyam 'brel gyis las don byas pa red/ 'on kyang dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs ༷ṅges blon tshogs kyis dgongs zhu byas pa red/ de lta na yang dbus gzhung la khrims gzhi de lag len byed dgos kyang ma byas pa red/ barmā de rgya gar las zur du phyes pa red/ 3 lo 1935 lor gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rgya gar gzhung gi khrims gzhi ltar gyi srid gzhung gi chags stangs de phyis su rang dbang rang btsan byung rjes kyang da bar phal cher lag len du yod pa yin/dbyin yul nas giripas zhib dpyod pa bslebs nas rgya gar du gros tshogs gong 'og bzo tshul dang yul du srid gzhung rang dbang can zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i skor gros gzhi ring po zhig bzhag pa de la kāṣṭhas tshogs pas ngos len ma byas te/ rgya gar gyi rgyal khams tsho la gnas pa'i mi mang la gros tshogs su rang gi 'thug mi gtong ba'i dbang cha ma sprad pa dang / gros gzhi de'i nang srung skyob kyi thob dbang rgya gar la yod min skor tshog tsam yang ma bshad pa sogs kyis khas ma blangs pa red/ kha che tshos kyang kha che'i yul khams gsar pa zhig bzo rgyu'i skor dang de'i gros tshogs kyi skor gang yang ma 'khod par bshad nas ngos len ma byas pa red/ 1942 lor dbyin ji rnams rgya gar nas phyi rgyugs shig ces pa'i las 'gul rgya che lo rgyus su grags pa de byas pa red/
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 267āṇḍa :wem/ (phyi lo 1942—1946)āṇḍa linalithaX'u'i rjes āṇḍa 1wem rgyal tshab tu bskos shing / de'i ring dbyin ji'i bka' shag gi 'thus mi 'ga' shas rgya gar du yong nas rgya gar du rang dbang rang btsan myur du yong thabs zhib 'jug byas te/ rgya gar mnyam 'brel gyi rgyal khab gcig bzo rgyu'am rgya gar dang pānastun gnyis su bgos te rgyal khab khag khag bzo dgos pa dzi yin brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas rjes yul dum bu gnyis su bgo rgyu min par gnas skabs rang dbang rang btsan gyi sngon 'gro'i sta gon du gnas skabs pa'i gzhung gsar 'dzugs dgos pa'i snyan sgron 'char gzhi bzos pa dang / de'i skabs 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa de thag chod pa red/āṇḍa mya'un bekaka/ phyi lo (194741948)rgya gar dbyin gzhung gi rgyal tshab tha ma ni āṇḍa loyis mu'unya bekaka yin zhing /de'i skabs rgya gar yul de dum bu gnyis su phyes nas/ rang dbang rang btsan du 'gyur rgyu'i ched 1947 lor rgya gar rang dbang rang btsan gyi khrims gzhi gtan 'bebs byas shing / lo der rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan gtsang ma thob pa dang / rgya gar dang / pānalhan zhes pa'i rang dbang rang btsan gyi yul gnyis su gyur pa na/ āṇḍa mu'un besnan de nyid 1948 bar du rgya gar rang dbang rang btsan gyi srid skyong spyi khyab kyi phyag las gnang ba red/phyi lo 1947 phyi zla brgyad pa'i ches bco lnga nyin rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan thob pa yin la/ rang dbang rang btsan gyi grwa sgrig ched luṇḍa mya'unya becan rgya gar la rgyal tshab tu phyi lo 1947 phyi zla gsum pa'i nang du bslebs shing de nas phyi
268 'phagasayul gyi byung ba brjod pa/lo 1947 phyi zla brgyad pa'i ches bcu bzhi bar rgya gar du dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab byas shing / phyi lo 1947 3 zla brgyad pa'i tshis bco lnga nas 1948 phyo zla drug pa'i tshos 20 bar rgya gar rang dbang rang btsan gyi srid skyong spyi khyab kyi tshul du bzhugs yod pa red/de ltar ngo rgal gyen lang chen po'i rjes dbyin gzhung gis rgya gar la srid dbang bsgyur nas srid skyong spyi khyab bam rgyal tshab bco brgyad lhag tsam zhig gis dbang bsgyur ba dang / mthar phyo lo 1947 6 zla brgyad pa'i ches bco lnga la rgya gar du dbyin jis srid dbang mjug sdom byas pa'i byung ba shin tu bsdus pa zhig de ltar lags shing /brgya phrag bcu dgu pa'i nang dang dus rabs nyi shu pa'i stod char rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor dang / spyi tshogs dang chos la 'gyur ba byung tshul dang / rgyal yongs ring lugs pa ji ltar dar tshul dang rang dbang rtsod len gyi las 'gul ji ltar byas tshul sogs 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro//phyi lo 1858 nas 1947 bar gyi rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor gnas stangs/dbyin ji rgyal mo chen mo khrirtsoriXs 1857 lor gnang ba'i bka' khyab nang don tshan gzhan dang mnyam rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor gyi yar rgyas dang rgya gar mi mang gi khe phan la shugs rgyag rgyu yin tshul gsal yod/ de skabs yul gyi gnas stangs dang lhag par grong gseb kyi gnas stangs la gzhigs pas mi mang gi bde don dang / dpal 'byor gong 'phel ched gzhi rgya chen po'i sgo nas las rim lag len byed dgos yod pa dang / dpal 'byor yar rgyas ched dbyin ji'i dbang 'dzin pa tshog las don 'ga' shas byas yod kyang des rgyal mo'i bka' khyab kyi dmigs yul 'grub thub pa ma byung ba
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus 9byung babarjod pa/ 269red/ dbyin gzhung gi las don rnams kyi dmigs yul dbyin yul gyi bzo las dang 'tsho ba'i khe phan bsgrub rgyu de yin pa smos mi dgos te btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i srid gzhung tshang mas de ltar byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya gar rjes lus thebs pa dang / de'i 'bras bur mi mang gi dbul 'phong ni phyi rgyal gyi bran du tshud pa la brten nas byung ba zhig red/spyir btang yul gyi dpal 'byor thad dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i smad phyed dang de'i rjes su 'gyur ba mang po zhig byung yod pa de ni bzo las khag gi 'dzugs skrun dang /mi grangs 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / dngul dang brje chog yod pa'i ston thog rnams kyi dgos mkho dang / rgya gar gyi bzo las khag tu dbyin dzo'i ma dngul mang po btang ba dang / dal bus 'gros las ma byung na yang me 'khor dang me 'khor lcags lam rgya bskyed sogs rgyu rkyen mang po zhig las byung yod pa red/ 'gyur ba de dag la brten nas yul gyi cha shas sna tshob/sa pa de gcig la gcig brten pa'am ltos dgos pa byung zhing /sngar gyi rang mkho rang ldengs kyi grong gseb kyi spyi tshogs de'i tshab tu dpal 'byor spyi mtshungs kyi mi che 'go tshugs pa red/ gnas tshul de rgya gar gyi gcig gyur la phan thogs po byung yod pa red/ dbyin jig rgya gar du rang gi khe phan gtsor bzung gis btsan dbang bsgyur ba yin yang rgya gar du deng dus kyi yar rgyas kyi rnam pa ji snyed pa zhig kyang ngo sprod byas yod pas khe phan yang mang po byung yod pa red/sa zhing dang so nam/sngar dbyin ji'i shar rgya gar gyi tshong tshogs gyi srid dbang gi ring la zhing bdag lugs srol dang zhing pa'i lugs srol lag len byas shing / rgya gar shar dang / dbus dang byang bcas su zhing bdag lugs srol bed spyod kyis gzhung dang / —zhing pa so nam
270 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/pa gnyis kyi bar zhing bdag gam sa bdag zhes pa zhig yod la/ zhing bdag gis so nam pa tsho las khral bsdu srol dang / khral de gzhung la sprod pa dang / cha gcig zhing bdag kho rang gis 'jog srol byung la/ lugs srol de ltar na sa zhing bdag po degzhung dang so nam pa gnyis kyi bar du bogs ma len mkhan lta bu zhig yod pa red/rgya gar lho phyogs dang nub khul du de ltar min pang zhing pa'i lugs srol lag len byas te/ gzhung gis so nam pa tsho las thad kur khral bsdu gi yod pa red/lugs srol de gnyis ku'i dmigs yul ni gzhung la sa zhing gi khral rgyun mthud thob rgyu de red/ de dag la brten nas sa zhing gi srung skyob dang gzhung khral brtan po yong ba dang / de las so nam gyi yar rgyas 'gro ba'i re ba byas kyang de ltar byung med pa red/der ma zad so nam pa tsho'i thog khral gyi gnon ljid ha cang chen po byung bas dka' ngal zad mtha' med par gyur pa red/1859 lor zhing bdag lugs srol yod sa'i sa khul khag tu khrims mang po zhig bzos pa las khral rtsung zad chung du can pa red/ so nam pa zhig gis lo brtsu gnyis bar mu mthud zhing las byas na kho la sa zhing de'i thog bdag dbang gi thob thang sprad de khrims thog nas gtan 'bebs byas/ 'on kyang zhing pa'i lugs srol yod sar de 'dra'i khrims ma bzos pas khul der gzhung khral bsdud mkhan dpon rigs tshos dbang sgyur byas pas so nam pa'i dngos 'brel gyi dpal 'byor gnas stangs la ma bltas par khral rigs bsdu tshad bskyar zhib byas/ de'i grub 'bras su so nam pa'i thog khral gyi 'khur ldid bzod mi nus par gyur par ma zad/ pe shag gi car du so nam pa tshog tshong pa phyug po rnams las bu lon len dgos thug nas khong tsho tshong pa phyug po tsho'i lag 'og hu tshud/ phyi lo 1875 lor ḍakan gyi sa khul 'ga' shas su so na ma
le'ugasumapa/ deng dusakyi byung ba brjodapa/ 271pa tshos ngo log kyang byas pas/ zing cha langs pa dang / tshong khang me la brgyabs pa dang / 'bru mdzod la me brgyabs pa'am 'phrog bcom byas yod 'dugder brten 1879 lor rgya gar dbyin gzhung gis khrims bzos te tshong pa tshos so nam pa'i sa zhing 'phrog mi chog par bzos kyang des ni so nam pa'i dka' ngal gyi rtsa ba med pa bzo ma thub cing / sa zhing gi khral che ba de dka' ngal gyi rtsa ba yin yang de la sgyur bcos gang yang ma byas/mi grangs mang du 'phel ba las kyang sa zhing thog gnon ljid byung zhing / bzo las la yar rgyas gang yang byung med/ de'i rjes su yang khrims 'ga' shas bzos kyang rgya gar la rang dbang ma thob bar du sa zhing 'dzin skyong thad rtsa ba'i sgyur bcos chen po gang yang byas med par ma zad bar du 'tshangs mkhan gyi bogs ma len mkhan tshos mi mang gi bshu gzhog byed rgyu de 'dog thub med pa red/sa zhing rmo 'debs kyi ngo bo chung du phyin pa/ rmo 'debs byed sa'i zhing kha chung chung yin pa de so nam gyi las don la rjes lus thebs pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso che ba zhig yin zhing / sa zhing bdag 'dzin nam shul 'dzin gyi khrims la brten nas sa zhing rnams nang mi so sor bgo gsha' byas pas mu mthud sa zhing gi tshad chung du phyin pa dper na phyi lo 1771 nas 1915 bar ḍamin du sa zhing gi tshad ekar 40 las chag nas ekar bdun rer gyur/ des na so nam pa phal che bas rang gi nang mi'i dgos mkho rnams so nam las bskyed ma thub/dus rabs bcu dgru pa'i phyed smad du so nam bya rung gi sa zhing mang du byung na yang de la mi grangs mang du phyen pas dka' ngal rang sor gnas/ mi mang 'phel rgyas phyin pa dang mnyam las don gzhan byed pa'i do skabs kyang ma thob/ phroṃ lo
272 'phags yul 9byung ba ba dpa/1861 lor rgya gar gyi mi grangs bye ba nyi shu dang 'bum drug rtsu tsam yod la/ phyi lo 1901 lor bye ba 28 dang 'bum 30 yod pa dang / 1961 lor bye ba 38dang 'bum 90 yod/ phyi lo 1981 nas mi grangs khyon bye ba 65 lhag tsam 'phel rgyas phyin pa red/ dus rabs nyi shu pa mjug sdom skabs mi grangs bye ba brgya tsam 'phar rgyu red/pe sha dmar rkyang dang brje chog gi ston thog za 'bru'i rigs kyi thon skyed nyung du phyin pa'i rgyu rkyen ni pe sha dmar rkyang dang brje chog yod pa'i ston thog gal chen po gyur pa de yin zhing / so nam pa tshos shing bal dang / so ma ra tsa sogs lta bu'i ston thog mang po skyed thabs byas pa de dag ni bzo las la shin hu mkho che ba dang / gzhung gis kyang de lta bu'i ston thog 'debs las la rgyud skul byas shing / za 'bru'i thon skyed nyung du phyin pa'i skor do snang ma byas/ shing bal dang so ma ra tsa sogs ni gong che zhing dgos mkho che bas 'phral du pe sha dmar rkyang len chog yod pas de tsho pe shag gi ston thog gam pe shag dmar rkyang dang brje chog gi ston thog ces brjod srol 'dug1861 nas 1865 bar amerikā'i nang dmag 'khrug byung bas de nas dbyin yul du shing bal yong ma thub cing / shing bal dkon pa des dbyin yul gyi bzo las la gnod skyon tshabs che yong gi yod pas dbyin gzhung gis rgya gar la shing bal gyi ston thog 'debs las la rgyud skul byas shing / basbra'i dang / madrus dang / dbus phyogs mnga' sde'i nang las don de'i ched dpon rigs do dam pa bskos/ rgya gar du shing bal gyi thon skyed chen po byung zhing zhing pa mang po phyug po yang chags pa red/so nam pa tsho'i dbul 'phong gi sdug bsngal 'phel ba/ rgya gar du rang dbang rang btsan ma thob bar du rgya gar gyi grong gseb kyi mi mang rnams la dka' ngal
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus sprebyung ba brjod pa/ 273chen po gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni bu lon gyi 'khur po lci ba dang / gnyis pa mu ge bcas red/sa gnas gang sar so nam pa rnams bu lon gyi 'og tu mnon yod cing / bu lon len sa ni tshong pa khag kho na yin la/ bu lon blangs te gzhung la khral 'jal rgyu dang / nang mi'i 'tsho ba skyel rgyu dang / gnyen mdun chang bza' dang / skyes pa dang shi ba'i skabs kyi 'gro gron sogs kyi sprur du bu lon len dgos byung / de dus rgya gar gyi so nam pa tsho'i cha snyoms yong 'bab shin tu chung rkyen thengs gcig bu lon blangs na mi ñtsha gang po phal cher de las thar mi thub pa byung ba red/ 1880 lo'i cas gzhi ltar de skabs rgya gar gyi zhing pa tsho'i bzhi cha gsum bu lon gyis mnan yod 'dug gnas tshul de dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus skabs lhag ma tshang ma'i skabs su rang sor gnas pa red/tshong pa tshos rim bzhin so nam pa rnams las bu lon gyi sprod 'jal ma byung bas de tsho'i sa zhing rnams blangs pa des nus shugs ngan pa zhig so nam gyi bya ba la byung ste tshong pa de tsho so nam dang 'brel med yin pas len/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i 'go stod tsam nas gzhung gis sa zhing 'tshong len sogs mi chog pa'i dam sgrag byas pas ma zad bu lon gyi skyed kha gtan 'bebs sogs byas/ zhing pa tshor bu lon dgos tshod dang skyed kha mtshams po'i thog bu lon sprod mkhan mnyam 'brel tshoḍa pa khag btsuḍa pa de tsho'i las ka gal chen po byas 'dug rgya gar du mnyam 'brel lam mnyam las kyi las 'gul de 3 lo 1904 lo nas 'do tshugs yod pa red/ de lta na yang dka' ngal shin tu che zhing gting zab pas mnyam las sogs yod bzhin du'ang gnas stangs la khyad par byung ma thub pa red/rgya gar gyi so nam pa rnams mpi char dus gyi char pa la rag lus pa yin pas
274 'phags yulagyi byung ba brjod pa/char pa dus su ma babs pas ston thog ma byung zhing / char chu yag po byung ba'i lo de la yang ma 'ongs par lding pa'i ston thog bskyed ma thub pas mu ge yang yang byung ba red/phyi lo 1866 dang 1899 bar gyi lo nyi shu tsam de mu ge'i dus skabs red/ 'on kyang yul gyi cha shas yongs rdzogs la mu ge byung ba'i lo gcig kyang byung med/ 'khor lam dang / me 'khor lcags lam bzos pa las za chas dkon sar 'bru rigs sogs skyel 'dren thub pa byung ba red/ dngos gnas kyi dka' ngal ni so nam pa chung khag dang / ngal rtsol ba rnams kyis lo 'khor gcig gi ched du ldeng pa'i 'gru rigs thon skyed byed ma thub pas las ka med pa'i skabs za rgyu ma thob pa'i nyen kha yod pa de red/mu gi las 'bras bu ngan pa mang po yong gi yod pa ni mi dang dud 'gro mang po shi gi yod par ma zad zas bcud ldan pa ma thob pas nad rims yang 'phel ba dang / mu ges gdung ba'i so nam pa'i sa zhing zhing bdag phyug po rnams dang tshong pa tshos phrogs pa dang mu ges nyen pa'i sa gnas bzhag ste zhing pa rnams sa gnas gzhan du 'gro gi yod pa sogs red/mu ge yang yang byung rkyen gzhung gis mu ge zhib dpyod tshogs pa btsugs nas skyob gso dang / rogs ram ci rigs pa byas shing khral chag yang dang / chu 'dren las don rgya skyed sogs byas yod pa red/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang mu ge nyung ba dang / byung yang de'i nyen kha chung du phyin pa de ni 'khor 'dren dang / skyob gso'i las don la gar rgyas byung ba bcas kyis red/ dus rabs snya shu pa'i nang mu ge che shos 1943 lor baṅgāl du byung zhing / des mi 'bum bcu tsam la gnod skyon byung ba red/ 'on kyang de ni char zhod ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis ma yin par dmag 'khrug chen po'i skabs gzhung 'dzin pa tshos drang po ma byas pa
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 275las byung ba zhig red/zhing chu 'dren byed mthun rkyen yar rgyas/ rgya gar du sngon dus nas gzhung 'bangs gnyis kus 'bad rtsol las khron pa dang / rdzing bu dang / yur ba dang /chu rag sogs bzos yod cing / de dag las zhing la chu 'dren gyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gi ring zhing chu 'dren pa'i skor do snang ma byas la/ do snang ma byas pas sngon dus kyi mthun rkyen de yang sdug tu phyin pa red/mu ge byung skabs zhing chu 'dren rgyu'i skor gzhi nas do snang byung zhing / mu ge rtog zhib tshogs pa tshang mas zhing chu 'dren rgyu'i thad gar rgyas dgos pa'i snyan sgron zhus yod/ de ltar yang zhing chu 'dren pa'i mthun rkyen kun tshang gi sa zhing nyung ngu las med pa dper na 3 lo 1940 lor rgya gar gyi sa zhing las brgya cha bcu gsum tsam la zhing chu'i mthun rkyen yod pa las de 'phros la med/ 'on kyang char chu la ltos dgos pa'i gnas tshul de nges par du nyung du phyin yod pa red/ zhing chu'i mthun rkyen tshang ba'i sa zhing la ston thog ched du 'gro gron mang ba gtong dgos byung zhing / de la brten nas so nam pa tshos pe shag gi ston thog gi las ka mang ba byas/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang so nam gyi yar rgyas skor gzhung gis srid byus leḍa po 'ga' shas lag len byas pa dper na dbus gzhung dang mnga' sde'i gzhung nang so nam las khang gsar 'dzugs dang / so nam byed phyogs thad deng dus kyi sbyong brdar dang nyams zhib khang btsugs pa dang / yul gyi cha gang sar so nam las don slob grwa khag dang / mtho rim slob grwa khang sogs btsugs pa red/de lta na yang so nam gyi bya bar yo chas spus legs dang / 'phrul 'khor sogs bed spyod ma byung ba dang / mi grangs 'phel rgyas che ba des so nam thon skyed la
276 'phags yul 9 byung babarjod pa/'phel rgyas byung ba'i grub 'bras mngon gsal can ma byung ba dang / sa zhing bgo 'grems cha ma snyoms pas sa zhing rtsa nas med mkhan tsho'i grangs 'bor 'phel ba des gnas stangs legs su 'gro bang 'gog rkyen byung ba red/ rgya gar la rang dbang thob pa'i rjes su sa zhing legs bcos kyi bya ba byed thub pa byung ba red/skyel 'dren gyi yar rgyas/yul gyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas kyi ched du skyel 'dren dang yig 'brel sbrag zam gyi mthun rkyen yag po zhig gal che zhing / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dkyil bar rgya gar du skyel 'dren 'khor lo dang / sbrag zam gyi cha nas nga/nas stangs shin tu nas skyo zhing /de skabs kulakasgyu nas disnya bar dang / balha.āo dang / āgarā bar 'char lam phyed bzos zin la phyed ka bzos ma zin pa gnyis las yod pa ma red/ phyi lo 1848 lor āṇḍa ḍalahosmi srid skyong spyi khyab twā yong rjes khos mi mang 'dzugs skrun sde tshan btsuḍa te/'khor lam dang / me 'khor lcags lam dang / tur lam bcas bzos nas rgya skyed byas/ phyi lo 1857 lor ngo log byung ba des 'khor lam sogs rgya skyed byed dgos pa'i skor shugs thebs yod de/ de dag las dbyin ji'i srung skyob la phan khyad chen po byung ba red/ 'grim 'grul gyi mthun rkyen yar rgyas su phyin pa de la brten nas lung pa'i tshong 'brel dang / bzo las la shugs thebs yod pa red/me 'khor/ me 'khor dang lcags lam gyis rgya gar du skyel 'dren gyi ngo bo bsgyur nas deng dus kyi rnam pa dod pa red/ me 'khor lcags lam dang po de phyo lo 1853 lor balharmā dang / :nā gnyis dbar bzos shing / gnyis pa de phyi lor sprulakarmā de baṅgāl gyi rdo sol gter kha khag dang sbrel/ 1856 lor ma'is nas
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 277ā(nam bar lcags lam bzos/ de nas bzung ste gzhung dang dbyin ji'i sger gyi tshong tshogs khag gis 'bad rtsol byas pa las me 'khor rgya skyed byas pa red/ thog mar me 'khor lcags lam che ba la shugs brgyabs yod cing / phyo lo 1875 bar yul gyi grong khyer gal gnad che ba phal cher phan tshun bar lcags lam gyis sbrel mthud byas te lcags lam ring tshad le dbar lnga stong tham pa yod pa red/ de skabs me 'khor lcags lam bzo skrun gyi dmigs yul ni phyi rgyal gyi tshong las gong spel byed ched yin pa las rgya gar yul gyi tshong las dang bzo las la yar rgyas gtong ched ma yin pas ma tshad phyi rgyal gyi tshong las de yang gtso bo dbyin ji tsho'i lag par yod pa red/me 'khor lcags lam bzo skrun gyi srid byus de 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po ma byung bar du gnas shing / dmag chen dang po'i rjes su rgya gar gyi bzo las la gar rgyas gtong ba'i do skabs byung ba dang / yul gyi mi mang tsho'i 'dod tshul yang brtan po chag yod pa red/ rgya gar gyi me 'khor las khang gis phyi rgyal las rang yul gyi dpal 'byor khi phan la do snang mang ba byed 'go btsugs pa red/ yin na yang me 'khor las yong 'bab chen po yong ba de tshang ma rgya gar gyi phyi logs su 'gro gi yod pa red/ phye lo 1947 bar rgya gar du me 'khor lcags lam ring tshad le dbar stong phrag bzhi bcu zhe gsum lhag tsam yod pa red/ 'on kyang gnas stangs dngos la 'gyur ba gang yang ma phyin pa red/me 'khor la brten nas rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor dang / spyi yongs kyi mi 3 la 'gyur ba chen po byung yod de/ phar 'gro tshur yong mgyogs pa dang / las sla po dang / srung skyob dang ldan pa byung ba dang / yul gyi thon skyed phyi logs su bslebs thub pa ma zad mu ge'i 'jigs pa chung du phyin te za 'bru sogs dkon sar 'bru rigs
278 'phags yul 9byung ba brjodapa/skyel thub pa byung yod pa dang / rdo sol dang / dngos rigs rjen pa rnams las sla por thob pas bzo las kyi yar rgyas la phan thogs byung ba dang / yul gyi cha shas sna tshogs su dngos rin gyi khyad par chung du phyen pa red/ me 'khor lcags lam bzo skrun las nges med kyi ngal rtsol ba sbyong brdar med pa tsho khag mang po zhig thon nas/ me 'khor las khang gis yul gyi cha gang sar de lta bu'i ngal rtsol ba mang po lo mang po'i bar las ka la bzhag pa de tsho ni sa zhing med pa'i zhing las kyi ngal rtsol ba sha stag yin pa red/me 'khor lcags lam dang mnyam 'khor lam yang 'dzugs skrun byas shing /'khor lam gyi bzo skrun las grong gseb pa'i mi che la 'gyur ba chen po byung ste de tsho'i sngar gyi rang mkho rang ldeng gi spyod tshul de med par gyur pa ma zad so nam gyi las don la yang 'gyur ba phyin pa red/deng dus kyi bzo las/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i phyed smad du rgya gar la bzo las 'ga' shag 'go tshugs zhing / ja zhing dang / bzo grwa sogs kyu 'dzugs skrun byas yod pa de tsho'i bdag po ni dbyin ji'i tshong tshogs rnams yin zhing / bzo las 'ga' shas kyi bdag dbang rgya gar ba rnams la yang yod/ 'on kyang gzhung gi srid byus kyis rkyen pas de tsho la yar rgyas gag po byung ma thub pa red/ dbyin yul du bzos pa'i dngos zog khag gi khrom ra che shos ni rgya gar yin pa red/phyi lo 1904 dang 1905 bcas su rang yul gyi dngos zog bdag gces de nyid rang dbang gi las 'gul gyi cha shas gal che shos su brtsis pa de'i dmiḍa yul
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus 9byung ba brjod pa/ 279ni rgya gar yul 'di cha thams cad nas rang mkho rang ldeng yong thabs bya rgyu de red/rang yul gyi dngos zog bdag gces kyi las 'grul dang / dmag chen gnyis kyi dgos mkho dag la brten nas rgya gar ba tsho la bzo las 'ga' shas yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i go skabs brnyed/ dus rabs de'i bcu phrag gsum pa'i nang lcags dang / dwang lcags dang / ras gos lta bu'i bzo las la srung skyob byung / de ltar rgya gar ba tsho'i snga mo nas yod pa'i re 'dod khengs pa dang / dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs phyi nas nang 'dren nyung du phyin pas dngos zog gi dgos mkho mang ba byung zhing / der brten gzhung gis rgya gar ba'i bzo las rnams la srung skyob mang ba byas/ dmag chen mjug sdom byung rjes dang / lhag par du rang dbang thob rjes yul gyi bzo las rgya skyed kyi las don shin tu gzhi rgya chen po'i sgo nas byas yod/skyed tshal bzo las/ nub gling pa tshos skyed tshal gyi bzo las la do snang chen po byas shing / brgya phrag bco brgyad pa'i nang gi mjug mtshams su de tshos shing tshos sngon po bzo 'don byed 'go btsugs pa red/ shing tshos sngon po de'i zhing las ni bahār dang / baṅgāl gyi rdzong 'ga' shas la 'go 'dzugs byas shing / 1850 bar shing tshos sngon po de rgya gar gyi dngos zog phyir 'tshong byed rgyu'i nang gal chen po zhig chag 'on kyang dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug tu jaraman yul du tshos bcos ma bzo 'don byas pas rgya gar gyi shing tshog sngon po'i so nam la do phog ngan pa byung nas khrom ra khag tu de'i dgos 'dun nyung du phyin pa red/'on kyang dus skabs de tsam zhig tu rgya gar gyi ja de dbyin dzi'i khrom khag tu brin po byung bas khi song yag po byung ba red/ rgya gar du ja yi zhing las ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dkyil nas 'go tshugs pa byung nas skyed tshal gyi bzo las nang nas gal
280 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/gnad che ba zhig chag pa red/ ja zhing mang che ba ātsām phyogs la yod pa red/1940 bar du rgya gar ayau ja brgya cha brgyad rtsu 3 rgyal du 'gro gi yod pa dang / mang che ba dbyin yul du tshong brin yong gi yod pa red/der ma zad tshog ja kātyā dang sgyig dang / nyal tha sogs kyi zhing las bzo las rnams gal che ru thun pa dang / dbyin ji'i srid dbang ma rdzogs bar du gong gsal bzo las khag la dbyin ji'i ma rtsa'i dbang cha 'ba' zhig yod/'phrul 'khor bzo las/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang 'phrul 'khor gyis bzo las byas pa des yul gang sar lag shes pa'am lag bzo ba tsho las med du gyur pa dang / rgya gar du yang 'phrul 'khor gyis bzo las byed pa'i 'go 'dzugs skabs der byung ste/ 'phrul 'khor gyis bzo las gtso che ba ni ras gos dang / so ma ra tsa'i bzo las sogs yin zhing / ras gos gyi bzo grwa dang po de phyi lo 1853 lor bkarmā la bzos pa dang / rgya gar gyi ras gos bzo las de yar rgyas rgyun mthud phyin pa red/ 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po ma byung bar du ras gos bzo 'don byed mkhan yul khag gi nang nas rgya gar gang bzhi pa red/ ras gos bzo las nang rgya gar ba tshos ma rtsa'i bgo skal mang thag chod yod pa red/ rgya gar gyi ras gos bzo las kyis dbyin ji dang nyi hong gi ras gos bzo las la 'gran bsdur gdong len byed thub pa byung / yul gyi nang gi khrom la lag 'thag byas pa'i ras gos brin po byung yod cing / gārdza mchog gis 'dī zer ba'i lag 'thag ras gos kyi las 'gul gnang ba de las lag 'thag ras cha bzo 'don la phan thogs chen po byung yod pa red/so ma ra tsa'i bzo las de baṅgāl gyi lag shes gtso bo yin la/ phyi lo 1855lor baṅgāl du so ma ra tsa'i bzo grwa dang po de btsugs te dus tshod gang mtshams bar rgya
le'ugasum pa/ deng dus 9byung ba brjod pa/ 281gar gyi so ma ra tsa'i bzo las kyis saXṭarbaṇḍa yi so rma ra tsa'i bzo grwa khag dang 'gran nus pa dang 'gran dgos pa'ang byung ba dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i bzhi cha tha ma'i nang nas bzung rgya gar gyi so ma ra tsa'i bzo las kyis phal cher 'dzam gling gi khrom ra khag tu gcig dbang bsgyur ba red/ madrus dang / bkraṅgā dang / ahamad nagar rnams bzo las kyi grong khyer du bzo ba la ras gos kyi bzo las gal chen po byung ba ltar kulakaX de bzo las kyi grong khyer du 'gyur bar so ma ra tsa'i bzo las gal chen po byung ba red/deng dus kyi bzo las yar skyed byed rgyu'i rtsa ba ni gter kha nas thon pa'i gter zog khag dang / rdzas sbyor dang / ar sa dang / glog shugs sogs kyi yar rgyas la brten yod par ma zad bzo grwa khag dang / me 'khor la rdo sol nges par du dgos shing / rdo sol ni nus shugs kyo 'byung khungs gal che ba zhig red/ rgya gar du deng dus kyi thabs tshul gyis rdo sol 'don pa'i 'do 'dzugs de 1843 lor byas pa dang /me 'khor lcags lam rgya skyed dang / bzo grwa'i yar rgyas phyon pas rdo sol kyi dgos gnad che ru phyin pa dang / me 'khor las khang gis rdo sol mang shos bed spyod byas yod pa red/ baṅgāl dang / bihār dang / uris la spus tshad spyi snyoms kyi rdo sol gyi gter mdzod shin tu chen po yod pa red/ phyis su me 'khor sogs su rdo sol ma dgos kyang rdo sol la bed spyod gzhan yang mang po byung yod pa red/1874 nas bzung rgya gar du deng dus kyi thabs tshul las lcags bzhu gin yod cing / lcags bzhu bar rdo sol can tu gal gnad che/ de lta na yang lcags dang dwang lcags kyi dngos 'brel bzo grwa ni 1911 nas 'go tshugs pa red/ de ni jamashedapur la 99'i lcags dang dwangs lcags tshong tshogs kyi bzo grwa btsugs nas byung
282 'phags yul gyigrang babarjod pa/ba zhig red/ de nas baṅgāl dang miswār sogs sa gnas mang por lcags dang dwangs lcags kyi bzo grwa khag btsugs yod pa dang / lcags dang dwangs lcags kyi bzo las yar rgyas thun pa las 'phrul las kyi bzo las kyang 'dzugs thub pa byung yod/ rgya gar du lcags dang dwangs lcags bzo las tshugs pa dang de la rgya gar ba tsho'i ma dngul dang /'bad rtsol gnyis thad nas yag po byas yod kyang 'phrul 'khor bzo skrun la do snang ma byas pas 'phrul 'khor rnams 3 logs nas nyo dgos kyi yod pa red/ der brten rgya gar du bzo las kyi yar rgyas dal bus phyin yod pa red/ bzo las dang bzo grwa 'ga' shas btsugs pa de lta na yang rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan thob skabs rgya gar de bzo las kyi cha nas gang mtshams rjes lus thebs yod pa red/ yul gyi thon khungs la bed spyod tshul bzhin ma byung ba ni dbyin ji'i srid byus la brten nas byung ba red/ dbyin jig bzo las tshang ma dbyin yul dang dbyin ji'i khe phan 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa zhig yin tsang dpal 'byor gyi srid byus tshang ma de'i rjes su 'brangs pa red/phyi rgyal dang tshong 'brel/me 'khor lcags lam gyi bzo skrun dang / deng dus kyi gru gzings dang /sawe'o yur ba'i mtsho lam phyes pa sogs las rgya gar gyi phye rgyal khag dang tshong 'brel mang du 'phel zhing / nang 'dren dang phyir 'tshong byed rgyu'i dngos zog rnams la'ang 'gyur ba byung ste/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug bar du rgya gar gyis phyi yul khag la gtso bor dngos rigs rjen pa khag dang / shing bal dang / so ma ra tsa dang / ja dang / gro dang / pags rigs sogs phyir gtong byas pa dang / bzos zin pa'i
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus: byung babarjod pa/ 283dngos zog phyir 'tshong nang so ma ra tsas bzos pa'i dngos zog rnams gtso bo yin/phyi nas nang du 'dren rgyu'i dngos zog nang nas 'phrul 'khor rigs dang / lcags rigs sam khams las bzos pa'i ca lag dang / gyon chas dang / gser dang / dngul sogs yin pa red/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang rgya gar gyi phyir 'tshong che ru phyin pas/ dbyin yul las gzhan amerikā dang / snya hong dang / jaraman sogs kyi mnyam tshong 'brel byung nas gong 'phel du phyin pa red/ rgya gar nas phyir 'tshong nang bzos zin pa'i dngos zog gi cha shas phyed kur gyur cing / rang dbang thob skabs rgya gar nas phyor gtong gi dngos po phyed ka dang / nang 'dren 9 dngos zog nang bzos zin gyi dngos po nyung du phyin yod pa red/ de lta na yang phyi rgyal dang tshong 'brel de yi khe phan de dbyin yul gyis blangs pa red/mi mang gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs/gang zag re re'i spyi snyoms lo 'khor yong 'bab de yul de dang de'i spyir btang dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs mtshone byed yin la/ dbyin ji'i 'og gi rgya gar du gang zag re re'i spyi snyoms lo 'khor yong 'bab de'i tshad ni tshod dpag las zhib gsal shes med kyang tshod dpag byas na/ phyi lo 1867 dang 1947 bar gang zag re re'i spyi snyoms lo 'khor yong 'babs de sgor 24 nas rim 'phar gyis sgor 228tsam yin zhing / rgya gar du bzo las sogs spre 'dzugs skrun byung na yang dbyin ji'i srid dbang mjug sdom ma byas pa'i bar rgya gar ba rnams la spyi snyoms su nyin rer sgor mo re yang thob mpi med pa red/ yul du dngos gong 'phar ba dang / lhag par du
284 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjodapa/dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs 'bru rigs kyi rin gong chen po 'phar bar ma zad/ spyi tshogs su gral rim sna tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyi yong 'bab la khyad par chen po yod de/sa zhing bdag po khag dang / bzo grwa'i bdag po rnams dang / tshong pa khag dang / gral rim bar ma rnams kyi yong 'babs ni ngal rtsol ba khag las mang ba yod cing / mang che ba'i yong 'bab ni ha cang chung chung yin pa red/ de tsho'i 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad kyang dma' po yod pa red/dus rabs 'di'i 'go stod du zhing las ngal rtsol ba zhig gi spyi snyoms zla ba re la yong 'bab sgor lnga las kyang nyung ba yod pa dang / kralakarmā dang / di4 lta bu'i grong khyer che khag la sbyong brdar med pa'i ngal rtsol ba zhig la zla rer sgor brgyad re thob kyi yod pa red/spyir btang dus rabs brtsu dasdu pa'i nang 'dzam gling gi yul mang po'i gzhung gis dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong thabs byas kyang / rgya gar la gnas stangs gzhan zhig byung ste dpal 'byor yar rgyas la do snang ma byas pa dang / rgya gar dbyin gzhung gis grong gseb pa tsho'i mi ñtsha gar rgyas yong thabs ma byas shing / deng dus kyi so nam gyi las don la 'gan blangs med/ de las ldog ste sa khral spar ba dang / khral rigs gzhan mang po brgyabs pa red/dmag dbung dang 'dzin skyong gi don du gzhung gi 'gro gron shin tu che ba de rgya gar gyi dbul 'phong gi gnas stangs de'i rgyu gal che ba zhig red/ dbyin yul nang gi 'dzin skyong la 'gro gron btang ba de las ldab gnyis dang phyed ka tsarma zhig rgya gar du 'dzin skyong thog btang dgos byung ba red/ rgya gar du 'dzin skyong dang / dmag mi tshang ma'i dmigs yul ni dbyin yul dang dbyin ji'i khe phan srung skyob ched yin pa smos ma
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 285dgos shing / sa zhing bdag po tsho dang / zhing pa phyug po rnams dang / tshong pa tshos grong gseb pa dbul po tsho la bshu gzhog byas yod pa red/skyed tshal bzo las pa dang / bzo grwa'i bzo las pa tsho'i gnas stangs kyang legs po ye nas med cing / 1881 lor bzo las khag tu las yun gyi chu tshod thung du btang ba dang / ngal rtsol gla cha nyung mtha' rgyas bcad sogs byas kyang / khrims gzhi de dag lag len byas med/ 1930 lor rgya gar rgyal yongs ngal rtsol tshogs pa btsugs nas ngal rtsol ba rnams chig bsgril gyis so so'i khe dbang gang mtshams blangs yod/yul la rang dbang thob rjes 'char 'god lhan tshogs sogs kyi sgo nas dbul phongs kyi rnam pa bsal ba'i thabs shes mang po zhig lag len byas te yul gyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas su btang yod/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang spyi tshogs dang chos kyi legs bcos khagyishu'i dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mjug bar du rgya gar du dbyin ji'i srid dbang brtan por tshugs zin pa dang / de dang mnyam nub phyogs pa'i shes rig dang /spyod bzang gi rlung 'tshub de yang rgya gar du dar khyab byung ba red/ dbyin ji'i srid dbang rgya skyed byung ba dang / nub phyogs pa'i lta tshul dang spyod tshul gang sar khyab 'phel byung ba des rgya gar gyi sngon dus kyi chos dang gshis rig la do phogs dang 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba red/ skabs der sngon dus kyai chos lhag ma yod pa ni rig byed nyisa'i chos dang / rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs gnyis las med la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ni sngar nas phal cher rtsa med du phyin zin la sa khul khug skyog re zung la byung zad yod srid pa de tsho stobs dang mngon gsal chung chung las med/ dus phyis dar ba'i kha
286 'tsho gas yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/che'i chos lugs dang / sngar gyi hiḥ'i chos dang / rgyal ba pa'i chos lugs gsum gyi nang nas hi: rig byed kyi chos lugs de rgya gar rgya che'i mi mang gi chos lugs yin zhing de'i rjes 'jug pa mang shos yin pa red/dbyin ji'i srid dbang brtan po tshugs te nub phyogs pa'i gshis rig dbyar chu ltar rgyas pa'i skabs de 'dra zhig tu rgya gar gyi chos dang gshis rig shin tu rgyud pa'i gnas skabs yin la rgya gar gyi mi nub phyogs pa'i slob sbyong thebs pa mang po zhig 'jig rten dang chos gnyis thad nas nub phyogs pa'i lta spyod kyis yid 'phrogs pa lta bur gyur pa red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgya gar du chos dang spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba'i lugs srol ngan pa mang po yod de/ mi rnams rigs che chung du mar bgos yod pa dang /bud med tsho dang mnyam bya spyod ngan pa lag len du bstar gyi yod pa ma zad byis pa'i chang bza' rgyag pa'i lugs srol rgya cher dar zhing / lugs srol ngan pa'i rkyen gyis mi dmangs la tshog sgril yag po ma byung bar spyi tshogs rjes lus thebs pa red/ lugs srol ngan pa 'ga' shas la chos kyi dbu 'khrid rnams kyis rgyab skyor yang byed kyi yod pa red/ dus rabs bar ma'i skabs su rnal 'byor pa dang / grub thob sogs mang pos rgya gar spyi tshogs su lugs srol ngan pa rnams 'gog thabs byas yod pa red/ rnal 'byor pa de tsho'i bsam tshul la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i shan chen po zhugs yod par mkhas pa mang pos gsungs 'dug pa de bden pa yin srid/ dus rabs bar ma'i skabs su rgya gar la nang chos nyams zin yang / nyams rgyud phyin nas yun ring ma 'das pas bsam tshul la nus shugs ma yal bar bsdad yod pa yin pas gong gsal gnas lugs de la rgyu mtshan yod par sems/
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 287dbyin jis srid dbang btsugs nas nus phyogs kyi gshis rig dang lta spyod dar khyab byung ba las rgya gar ba shes yon can mang po zhig gis hortsa'i gshis rig gi mangs gzhi de rang la dogs pa byas pa sogs byung ba red/ gnas stangs de 'dra zhig gi skabs spyi tshogs dang chos kyi legs bcos pa rnams kyis thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sgrug gis rgya gar gyi chos dang / gshes rig dang / mi 3 sogs kyi rin thang 'chad spel dang / lugs srol ngan pa rnams 'dog thabs kyis legs bcos byas yod pa red/ brgya phrag bcu dgu pa'i nang yul gyi mi rigs khag dang / sa gnas phal che ba la chos dang spyi tshogs la legs bcos kyi ched du las 'gul 'go tshugs pa red/ las 'gul de dag gis rgya gar mi mang dum bur gtong mkhan gyi yol ba rnams rtsa gtor gtong bar phan thogs byas par ma zad mi tsho'i klad par rgyal khab dang 'brel ba'i bsam tshor skyed par byas/ shes yon slob sbyong las tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lta tshul yar rgyas su phyin nas legs bcos kyi las 'dul la shugs snon byung ba red/ ngan pa bkag nas bzang po dang du len pa'i legs bcos byed mkhan tsho'i nang nas rāju rām mohan rāg zhes pa de gtso che shos yin pa dang khong gis btsugs pa'i brahma samaja ste tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs zhes pa de chos kyi las 'gul gtso che zhig red/rāhā rām mohan rāya/ (phyi lo 177441833)rāju rām mohan rāya zhis pa de deng dus kyi rgya gar gyi gnas tshul nang gi mi gal che shos shig yin la/ bdag nyid chen po ༷spris khong ni srid don dang gshis rig gi bran g.yog las rgya gar la rang dbang len pa'i mes po zhig yin zhes bsngags brjod zhus pa de bden pa yin pa ma zad de ni ma shes rmongs pa dang / rmongs dad rnam rtog
288 'phags yul 9 byungab brjod pa/gi bran g.yog las thar bar byed pa'i yab chen zhig kyang red/rāju rām mohan rāg de nyid baṅgāl nas yin zhing / de nyid rāṅgānagar zhes pa'i grong gseb cig la bram ze'i mi tshang sngar srol mkhregs bzung byed mkhan zhig tu phyi lo 1774 lor 'khrungs shing / lo rgyus 'ga' shas nang 1772 phyi zla lnga pa'i ches 22 la 'khrungs tshul yang 'khod 'dug khong gis lharwalngarsā la legs sbyar gyi skad dang / paṭanā la arab skad dang / parashiga'i skad kyi slob sbyong byas/ der ma zad dbyin ji dang phruna'i skad dang lesan dang hibaru dang rgyuka skad kyang shes kyu yod pa red/kho lo bco lnga lon tsam la baṅgāl gyi skad nang du deb chung zhig bris te sku 'dra la mchod pa byed pa'i lugs srol la dgag pa byas shing / sku 'dra la mchod pa de rig byed las kyang gsungs med tshul sogs bris pa red/ der brten kho rang gi nang sngar srol la mkhregs bzung can des kho rang phyir 'bud byas pa red/ de lta na yang khong ga sa ga la 'grul bzhud byas te yon tan slob pa dang nyams myong gsog thabs na/ mthud byas pa red/phyi lo 1805 lor dbyin ji'i shar rgya gar tshong tshogs kyi las ka byas te 1814 bar rgyun mthud byas/ de nas khong kālakarmā la gzhis chags te rgya gar mi mang gi khe phan 'ba' zhig gi ched du mi che'i ring las ka byas/ 1817 lor kālakaX lha/ ñtsha sna ṭwāṃ hūm̐ paX shā nā (( shā /lha ༵ // ((gas tt+waṃ spya ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ dā 〉pa ṭwāṃ dargya kyig dzā ṣṭṛ rim slob grwa zhig btsugs te baṅgāl gyi skad nang tshan rig slob sbyong thog mar 'go 'dzugs byas pa red/ der ma zad khong gis rang gi gzim shag tu legs sbyar gyi skad slob sbyong
le'u gsumapa/ dengadus 9byung ba brjod pa/ 289byed ched rig byed mtha' pa'i mtho rim slob khang chen po zhig kyang btsugs pa red/khong gis gsar shog la rang dbang dgos tshul skor la yang 'bad brtson byas te rang nyid kyis kyang baṅgāl gyi skad nang salhad namuX ste yongs su 'chad pa zla ba'i 'od zer zhes pa'i dus deb gcig 'don gnang mdzad pa de ni rgya gar gyi gsar shog gam gsar deb snga shos nang nas gcig yin pa red/ 1822 nang khong gis parashilnga'i skad nang bdun re'i gsar shog gcig 'don spel gnang ba de ni rgya gar du parashilā'i skad du gsar shog par 'debs byas pa thog ma de yin pa red/ de dag la brten nas srid don dang spyi tshogs skor kho rang gi bsam tshul rnams shes yon can rnams la spel yod pa red/ khong gis gsar shog la dbyin gzhung gis dam sgrag gang byas la ngo rgol mthar phyin byas pa red/dus skabs der baṅgāl la satu zhes pa kyo shi ba'i dur me'i nang chung ma yang sreg pa'i lugs srol dar khyab yod pa ltar/ 1811 lor kho rang gi spun jagan mohan rog zhes pa de ñtsha las 'das pa na de'i chung ma de yang de'i phung po dang mnyam du gson sreg byas par mthong nas rāju rām mohan rāya yis bya spyod ngan pa de lta bu de khrims kyi thog nas rtsa med bzo rgyu'i dam bca' byas de gsar shog brgyud dang / lag len thog lugs srol de la ngo rgol drag po byas shing / hiX'i chos lugs mdo mkhregs tsho'i ngo rgol skyon brjod la ma ltos par las don mu mthud byas te mthar 1828 lor dbyin ji'i srid skyong spyi khyab āṇḍa khrilagam be〉ka gis gtī lag len byed mi chog pa'i khrims gzhi bzos pa dang / dbyin ji'i gros tshogs gan chad la gtugs nas sanywa zhes pa'i srol ngan de khrims 'gal yin par dril bsgrags byas te med par bzos/khong gis yid ches byas pa ltar hiḥ'i chos lugs kyi lugs srol ngan pa khag
290 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/bsal nas rtsa ba'i lung dang / bstan bcos khag nang gi snying don rnams mi mang la gsal bshad byed rgyu de gal cher brtsis/ khong gis 'bad pa chen pos rig byed dang /de 'brel gyi lung rnams baṅgāla'i skad nang du bsgyur/ khong gis dkon mchog ni gcig rang yin la sku 'dra la mchod pa byed pa dgos med dang / chos 'tshe tshang ma'i snying don 'de rang yin par bstan/ der ma zad regs bzang ngan gyi dbye 'byed dang / de mtshungs chos kyi ming thog cho ga 'dra min sna tshoḍa don med du byed pa la skyon brjod byas/khong gis yishu'i chos dang / kha che'i chos dang hortsa'i chos bcas la slob sbyong shin tu tshad ldan byas yod pas chos lugs tshang ma dang mdza' 'brel dang mthun po yod cing / dbye 'byed phyogs ris med par dkon mchog gcig rang yin pa de chos lugs tshang ma'i snying don du bzung nas tshang ma dang mthun sbrel che bas kha che tshos khong la kha che yin par 'dod cing yishu'i tshos khong yishu dang / hi( tshos khong la hiḥ'i 'du shes byas pa red ces brjod srol 'dug gang ltar gang mtshams nas khong rang gi nye skor du slob sbyong dang shes yon yod pa khag gi tsho khag chen po zhig 'khor yod pa dang / 1828 lor khong gis brahma samaja ste tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs zhes pa zhig btsugs pa red/ rāju rām mohan rayā de dgung lo chen po rang ma yin par 1833 lor dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ 'on kyang khong gis btsugs pa'i brahma samyang zer ba de'i sgo nas spyi tshogs dang chos la legs bcos byas pa rnams 'chi ba med par rtag tu gnas kyi red/brahma samaja/bramisamaja ste tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs zhes pa de 3 lo 1828 lor rāju rām mohan rāg yis btsugs pa dang / de ni thun mong sam 'jig rten yongs rdzogs
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 291'dus sa'i tshogs pa lta bu zhig yin zhing / mi mang mnyam 'dzoms kyis bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gcig rang la mchod pa byed par shugs rgyag mkhan zhig red/ tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs kyis sku 'dra'i mchod pa la ngo rgol dang dgag bya byas te 'jig rten yongs rdzogs kyi skye 'gro spyi la spun grogs spre 'du shes 'jog dgos pa'i skul ma btab/ spyi tshogs des chos lugs tshang ma la ris su ma chad par gus bkur zhus shing / des hiḥ'i chos lugs gtan nas dor med/ rāju rām mohan rāya sku 3 ma zin pa des tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs la gyong grun chen po byung zhing / desnye:nātha shegor gyis tshogs pa 'di bskyangs shing / yang bshawa cadre dewa zhes pa de yang tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi dbu 'khrid gal chen po yin/ rim bzhin spyi tshogs 'di la yan lag gi tshogs pa khag mang du gyes te mthar lnga bcu nga bzhi tsam byung ba red/ gang ltar 'go 'khrid de tshos yul gyi cha thams cad la phyin te so so'i bsam tshul rnams khyab spel byas/nashawa cadri dewa dang de'i rjes 'jug pa tsho'i bsam tshul de tshangs pa'i spyi tshoḍa kyi tshogs mi gzhan rnams las gsar brje che ba yod pa dang / de tshos rigs kyi dbye 'byed dang / sngar srol chos kyi don med spros pa tshang ma bkag pa dang / rigs 'dra min bar gnyen 'dun byed chog pa dang / bud med rnams gdong 'gebs pa'i lugs srol med par bzos pa dang / byis pa'i chang sa bkag pa dang / slob sbyong dang shes yon khyab spel la shugs rgyag pa sogs byas te spyi tshogs la legs bcos byas/gsar brje'i bsam blo la brten pas khos sngar gyi rtsa ba'i tshogs pa de las zur du thon dgos byung ba red/lngathanā samaja/〉thanā samaja ste gsol 'debs tshogs pa zhes pa de rgya gar nub phyogs su
292 'phags yul gyi byung babarjod pa/tshugs pa yin zhing de ni tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi kha gtad du btsugs pa zhig red/de ni phyi lo 1887 lor btsugs shing geshalha tsand+ra sen gyis rgyud skul las btsugs pa red/ de'i rjes 'jug pa rnams ni mahārā6 nas yin zhing de tshog tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs ltar ma yin par hiḥ'i lha rnams kyi sku 'dra la mchod pa byed cing / spyi tshogs lku legs bcos la shugs rgyag mkhan yin pa red/ de tshos dad pa'i bstod dbyangs kyi sgo nas dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing spyi tshogs nang rigs mtho dman tshang ma mnyam du kha zas za rgyu dang / phan tshun gnyen byed rgyu dang / yug sa ma rnams bskur du gnyen 'dun byed rgyu dang / bud med rigs dang / rigs dman skyo po tshang ma'i gnas stangs mtho ru gtong rgyu sogs kyi thabs shes byas yod pa red/ khrims dpon rāXṭi dang topyal kroṇḍa gokhale bcar dbu 'khrid snyan grags can gnyis tshogs pa 'di'i 'thus mi yin pa red/ khong gnyis kyis gzigs rtogs 'og ) phrug gso skyong khang dang / yug sa ma'i gso skyong khang dang / rigs dman skyo po tsho'i sdod khang zhes pa btsugs pa red/mahādewa gowenda rāṇaṭṭa/ (phyi lo 1842—1914)rla(ce ni 1842 lor phyi zla dang po'i ches 18 nyin nusika la skyes shing /kho la balha.āo yi gtsug lag slob khang chen mo las khrims kyi nang 'dzin rim bca drug pa'i lag khyer thob rjes mtho slob nang slob dpon gyi phyag las gnang ba dang / mthar balngazhwa'i khrims khang chen mo'i khrims dpon du bskos pa red/ khong gis spyi tshogs legs bcos la 'bad pa chen po byas shing / 1861 lor yug sa ma tsho'i gnyen 'dun tshogs pa zhig btsugs pa dang / 1870 lor pānu'i mi dmangs tshogs pa zer
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus kyi byungab brjodapa/ 293ba zhig btsugs te dus deb sogs 'don spel gyis spyi tshogs dang / srid don legs bcos gang thub byas pa red/ khong ni khrims dpon 'ba' zhig ma yin par lo rgyus la mkhas pa dang / dpal 'byor la mkhas pa dang / shes yon la mkhas pa dang /spyi tshogs legs bcos pa sogs kyang yid pa red/khong gis ḍamin shes yon tshogs pa zer ba zhig btsugs te gokhale dang tilaka sogs grags pa can gyi dbu 'khrid rnams tshogs pa 'di'i khongs mi yin zhing / de tsho'i dmigs yul ni yul mi rnams la shes yon slob sbyong sprod rgyu dang / 'tsho ba stabs bde po dang / bsam blo mthon po yong thabs la 'bad ‘/ byas shing / slob grwa zhig kyang btsugs pa sogs byas/gong du bshad pa ltar tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs dang / gsol 'debs kyi spyi tshogs sam tshogs pa de tsho ni rinayisenas ste shes rig bskur gso'i byed stangs las byung ba zhig ste/ nub phyogs pa'i tshan rig gi lta stangs de bed spyod byas te rgya gar rgyal yongs ring lugs kyi grub mtha'i thog spyi tshogs la legs bcos dang shes yon khyab spel byed mkhan red/ de'i rjes su chos lugs legs bcos ayau las 'gul gzhan khag 'go tshugs thub pa byung ba red/daXnanda saraswabhā dang ārya samārnga/ (182441883)ārya salngaja ste 'phags pa'i spye tshogs zhes pa de phyo lo 1883 lor swāṇḍa daXnanda sarapa3 ste rje thugs rje kun dga' dbyangs can zhes pas btsugs pa dang /'phags pa'i spyi tshogs kyi las don dang dmigs yul ni 'gro ba mi rigs yod do cog la khrims 'dra mnyam dang / rgyal khab tshang ma la yang khrims srol 'dra mnyam dang /
294 'pha sa yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/reg tu mi rung ba'i lugs srol 'gog pa bcas red/ rje thugs rje kun dga' dbyangs can gyis rig byed du phyir log dgos zhis pa'i skad sgra bsgrags pa dang / hoḥ'i chos la rang dbang gi lam mpi hiḥ'i chos lugs gtsang ma zhig la thug yod cing / dge ba'i las ni dka' thub las legs pa yin la deng dus gyi tshan rig gi gsar gtod tshang ma'am tshan rig gi bsam tshul tshang ma rig byed rang du yod la/ nga tshos de 'tshol zhing shes thabs bya danas pas rig byed rang la thos bsam byed dgos/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang /khong gis hiḥ'i chos la legs bcos kyang 'ga' zhig mdzad pa dper na sku 'dra la mchod pa byed rgyu dor dgos pa dang / dkon mchog gcig rang yin pa dang /rigs bzang ngan gyi dbye 'byed spong ba dang / byis pa'i chang sa spong ba dang / bud med la shes yon yag po sprod dgos pa dang / pho mo 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / yug sa ma tshog bskyar du gnyen 'dun byed dgos pa sogs khong gi bsam tshul rnams deb thog tu bris par ma zad thad kur mi mang tsho la bka' slob gnang ba red/ 'phags pa'i spyi tshogs 'di dar rgyas su phyin nas panāb dang uttar phradesha la ni lhag par du dar khyab phyin nas lag len thog nas tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi sa gnas de 'phags pa'i spyi tshogs 'dis bzung ba yin/ 'phags pa'i spyi tshogs 'dis slob grwa dang mtho rim slob grwa 'ga' shas btsugs te deng dus kyi shes yon dang mnyam nyirdu'i chos kyang slob sbyong byed kyi yod la/ deng sang dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang la'ang 'phags pa'i spyi tshogs 'dis las don byed bzhin yod/rām kriṣṭha paramahas/ (phyi lo 183641886) dang rāmakriṣṭha'i chos tshogs/rāmakriṇḍa paramanyas ste dga' byed nag po mchog gi ngang pa spyir btang dga'

296 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/zag gis gang zag gi tshod thig pa dka' zhing / rnal 'byor pa'i dag snang la so skyes tshad ga la mjal nus/ gal te rnal 'byor pa dngos ma yin na yang ma yin pa de yi sgrub byed las sla po zhig rnyed par dka'/gang ltar spyir btang byung rabs pa dag gis bzhed tshul la dga' byed nag po 'di la nub phyogs pa'i slob sbyong dang nub phyogs pa'i bsam blo'i shan cung zad kyang ma zhugs shing yishu'i chos lugs kyi bsam blo'i dre tsam yang med par bzhed/ dong du bshad zin pa'i tshangs pa'i spyi tshogs dang 'phags pa'i spyi tshogs rnams kyi 'dzugs pa po rnams nub phyogs pa'i shes yon che zhing / yishu'i chos lugs kyi bsam tshul legs pa dag gis bskul nas hoḥ'i chos lugs la legs bcos gtong mkhan yin la dga' byed nag po de ltar min/ de lta na yang khong dang 'brel gtug dang 'brel ba yod tshad la khong gis gdams ngag gis phan thogs rgya cher byung yod/ khong gis mi mang phal mo che la gdams pa'am slob gso gtso bo ni 'dod ma snye bud med dang / gser ste nor longs spyod gnyis las rgyal bar byed dgos zhes gsungs/ don ni bud med dang rgyu nor gyi dbang du ma song bar dgos zhes pa'i don yin/dga' byed nag po 'di mkhas pa'am slob sbyong can zhig min na yang khong gi bsam tshul khyad du 'phags pa rnams la brten nas rgya gar ba shes yon dang ldan pa rnams kyi yid 'phrogs par gyur/ 'gro ba mi rigs la phan thogs dang zhabs phyi zhu ba ni dkon mchog gi zhabs phyi dang / dkon mchog la mchod pa dngos 'brel de yin par gsungs shing lag len byas pa de khong gi khyad chos che shog yon/phyi lo 1886 lor khong dgongs pa rdzogs shing de'i rjes su rāmakriṇḍa mishan ste dga' byed nag po'i chos tshogs zhes pa de btsugs shing / de'i dgos pa dang

298 'phagasayul 9 byung ba brjod pa/red/ slob sbyong de tsam byas kyang sems la zhi bde ma byung ba dang / dga' byed nag po dang mjal nas sems la zhi bde byung yod pa red/ khong rgya gar gyi sa cha kun tu phebs nas gnas stangs mtha' dag la gzigs pas yid skyo po byung / rgya gar du dbul phongs dang / dzor po dang / sems stobs zhan pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skor re ba chad pa sogs gzigs nas thugs sems shin tu skyo po byung / khong gis yul gyi gnas stangs 'di 'dra byung ba 'di'i le khag kyang yul mi rnams rang la yod pas rgya gar ba rnams la rang yul gyi gnas stangs legs su gtong dgos tshul gsal por gsungs pa red/ khong gis rgya gar ba tsho la dang po so so'i skyon bsal dgos pa dang / de nas spyi tshogs gsar pa zhig gi 'dzugs skrun dang / spyi tshogs gsar pa de'i nang dbul phongs rnams la gdung sems kyis skyong dgos pa dang / bkres pa rnams la zas dang / mi mang spyi la blo gros gyi snang ba thob pa byed dgos tshul rtsal du bton nas dga' byed nag po'i chos tshogs kyi las byed pa shes 'jon gnyis ldan gyi mi mang po gra sgrig byas te de tshos rgya gar ba tsho la yul la brtse zhin gyi bsam blo khyab spel byas pa red/rgya gar gyi phyi la yang rnam dpyod kun dga'i mdzad phrin las phyi rgyal ba tsho la rgya gar gyi shes rig ngo sprod byung ba red/ phyi lo 1893 lor a ri'i grong khyer shikago zer sar chos kyi gros tshogs chen po zhig tu rnam dpyod kun dga' de nyid hortsa'i sku tshab byas nas phebs te der khong gi gsung bshad kyis der 'dus pa'i yul khag 'dra min gyi 'thus mi tshang ma'i yid 'phrogs par gyur te ha las pa byung yod pa red/phyi lo 1897 lor rang yul du log pa dang / de rjes 1898 lor nub gling dang / gamerikā bcas su phebs nas 1900 lor phyir log mdzad/ khong gis a ri sogs phyo rgyal khag tu rig byed mtha' pa'i lugs kyis gtsos pa'i rgya gar gyi
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 299lta grub dang / shes rig ngo sprod dang / rigs pa'i lam nas gsal bshad rgya cher byas shing / tshan rig gi lam nas lta ba'i ngo sprod byas pa des nub phyogs pa khag la yang mos mthun byung ba red/rgya gar du chos rgyal mya ngan med dang / kuniṣka lta bu'i nang chos kyi rgyal po bla na med pa tshos nang chos khyab spel gnang nas 'phags yul 'di'i chos srid gnyis ku'i mnga' thang shin tu rgyas pas 'dzam gling yongs su 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal khab yul gzhan gyi chos dang shes rig gi 'byung khungs su gyur pa'i rgya gar yul 'di la dus phyis dus rabs mang por kha ches dbang bsgyur 'og tu gnas pa dang / de nas nub gling pa'i bran g.yog tu tshud par brten srid don gyi cha nas gzhan 'og tu tshud par ma zad chos dang shes rig sogs kyi cha nas kyang gzhan 'og tu non te/ spyir btang rgya gar mi mang tsho'i sems shugs nyams nas sngar gyi chos lugs dang shes rig de tsho ni khungs med la dngos don dang mthun gyi e yod snyam pa'i the tshom byung zhing / spru gling pa tshos de tsho'i tshan rig gi bsam tshul de dngos don dang 'brel la rgya gar gyi chos dang lta grub de snying po med pa'i stong gtam 'ba' zhig yin tshul dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas bshad de yul 'di'i mi mang rnams khong tsho'i 'og nas nam yang mgo 'degs mi thub pa'i thabs shes byas pa red/ srid don dang dpal 'byor gyi cha nas gzhan dbang 'og tshud par ma zad chos dang shes rig sogs kyi cha nas kyang gzhan dbang du gyur pa red/rje snying rje kun dga' dbyangs can mchog dang / rje rnam dpyod kun dga' sogs kyis gong gi gnas tshul de legs par mkhyen nas rgya gar gyi mi mang tsho la sngon gyi chos 'tshe dang lta spyod mtha' dag rigs pa dang tshan rig kyi bsam tshul dang mthun pa yin par bsgrubs pa'i sgo nas gang ci'i thad nas nub phyogs pa'i lta spyod dang shes

le'u gsum pa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 315gi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal de yi rgyu rkyen gzhung gi srid byus la thug yod tshul bshad pa red/ dbyin rdzas rgya gar la bshu gzhog byas pa dang / rgya gar gyi rgyu nor dbyin yul du khyer ba dang / dbyin gzhung gis 'gro gron phangs med btang bas rgya gar gyi mi mang mu ge'i gnas su gyur pa sogs kyi skyon brjod byas te/ so so'i dgos 'dun bton nas rgyal yongs las 'grul de'i drag rtsub che ru phyin pa red/rgyal yongs las 'dul gzhi rgya che ru phyin pa dang mnyam du gzhung gi btsan gnon gyi bya ba yang che ru phyin pa red/ 3 lo 1898 lor luṇḍa kurdzan de nyid srid skyong spyi khyab tu gyur pa des rgyal yongs las 'gul de mgo gnon thabs shugs cher byas pa dang / des rgya gar gyi mi mang gi 'dod tshul la do snang tsam yang ma byas shing /rgya gar ba rnams ni go gnas gal che sar sko bar 'os pa ma yin zhes dngos su bshad/des kāñdzas tshogs pa rtsa med du bzo rgyu'i dmigs yul bzung ste/ dmigs yul de 'grub ched kha bral dbyen sbyor byas nas chab sred skyong / zhes pa'i srid byus bzung ba red/ des baṅgāl mnga' sde dum bu gnyis su bgos pa de las mthar grub 'bras yag po ma byung zhing / rgyal yongs las 'gul shugs che ru phyin pa red/brgya phrag bcu dgu pa'i mjug mtshams nas rgyal yongs las 'gul byed mkhan tsho'i nang du bsam tshul gsar pa zhig rim bzhin bslebs pas kāṣṭhas nang tsho khag gnyis bslebs pa red/1907 lor kāñdzas dum bu gnyis su gyes pa/spru lo 1907 lor surata zhes pa'i sa gnas su rgyal yongs kārjes tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du chen mo tshugs pa na kānmas tshogs pa'i sde khag gnyis phan tshun bsam blo ma mthun par rtsod gleng dngos su byas pa red/ phyogs gnyis bar rgya gar ba so
316 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjodapa/so'i srid gzhung len pa'i dmigs yul la ma mthun pa min yang / thabs lam la ma mthun pa'i dbang gis rtsod pa byung nas khag gnyis su gyes/ khag gcig ni zhi 'jam ru khag dang / khag gcig ni drag rtsub can gyi ru khag yin pa red/ zhi 'jam ru khag gis dbyin ji dang mthun 'brel gyis dal bus sgyur bcos yong thabs byas shing / 'on kyang drag po'i ru khag gis zhi ba'i zhu 'bod kyis ma yin par drag po'i ngo rgol 'ba' zhig las so so'i dmigs yul sgrub rgyu'i phyogs bzung ba red/spyir btang rgya gar rang dbang gi las 'dul de la rim pa gsum yod de/ dang po phyi lo 1885 nas 1905 bar yin zhing / dus skabs de ni zhi 'jam ru khag tsho'i dus skabs yin pa red/ rim pa gnyis pa ni 1905 nas 1920 bar yin zhing de'i ring drag spyod can gyi rgyal yongs ring lugs pa tsho'i dus skabs yin/ rim pa gsum pa ni 1920 nas 1947 bar yin zhing / de ni 1lha'i dus rabs yin/zhi 'jam ru khagzhi 'jam ru khag tsho'i dus skabs de la gosprul kriṣṭha gokhale sogs dbu 'khrid mang po byung ba de tshos rgya gar ba so sos bskyangs pa'i gzhung zhig 'dzugs skrun thob thabs su yul gyi bzo las dang / dpal 'byor dang / sems stobs yar rgyas su gtong thabs 'dzugs skrun khag bzos te rgyal yongs su gcig sgril yong thabs dang / da yod gyi chab srid 'dzin skyong la legs bcos brtan po yong thabs dang / de'i ched dbyin gzhung la go bskon gseng 'grol rgyud skul zhi 'jam gyis byed gyi yod pa red/ zhi 'jam ring lugs pa tshos 1916 bar du las 'grul dal bus byas te kārjes nang dbang shugs spel yod pa red/ de tsho'i dbu 'khrid che shos ni gokhale yin zhing / de ni rgyal gces pa bsngags par 'os pa zhig yin pa red/
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 317gosprul kroṇḍa gogale/ khong ni phyo lo 1866 lor 'khrungs shing / 1915lor dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ der brten khong sku hnā ring po rang bzhugs med pa red/ dgung lo 18 lor 'dzin rim bcu bzhi pa thon pa dang / dgung lo 20lor dge rgan du gyur cing / dgung lo 22 lor bkarmā'i khrims bzo tshogs pa'i 'thus mir gyur/ dgung lo 36 lor ches mtho'i lhan tshogs kyi 'thus mi dang /dgung lo 39 lor rgya gar rgyal yongs kārmis tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin du bskos pa red/der ma zad mtho slob kyi gtso 'dzin dang gsar shog dang dus deb gal che dag gi gtan 'bebs byed pa po sogs shes yon dang 'brel ba'i las don sna mang gnang /gogales dbyin jis tshwa bral la skyon brjod byas shing / go gnas dang las don gal che khag la rgya gar gyi mi rigs bsko bzhag ma byas pa la skyon brjod gnang ba dang /baṅgāl dum bu gnyis su phyes par ngo rgol gnang / khong gis dbyin ji'i mi rigs rnams dang mnyam rgya gar ba tsho la go skabs sogs 'dra mtshungs dgos par dmigs nas las don hur thag gnang bar ma zad dbyin ji dang rgya gar gnyis ka shes rig dang dmigs yul gcig mtshungs gi sgo nas phan tshun gcig la gcig brten yod pa dang /mthun 'brel yag po'i sgo nas rgyal spyi'i brtse gdung la nan tan chen po gnang ba red/khong ni 'jam mkhas kyis mthun 'brel gnang mkhan zhig yin pas dbyin gzhung dang dbyin rdza'i mi tsho dang mnyam du 'cham po yod pa dang / dbyin ji'i spyi tshogs nang du yang dga' mos chen po yod/ khong gis gartswa lho a:spya nas rgya gar du yong dgos par bskul nas rgya gar dang rgya gar mi mang gi ched du las don byed dgos pa'i slob ston gnang ba red/ bdag nyid chen po gā'i mchog gis gokhale ni khong gi sred don gyi bla ma yin zhes gsungs 'dug dbyin ji'i mkhas pa mang pos gokhale'i mdzad rnam
318 'phags yul gyi byung ba brjod pa/bris 'dug par tshang mas khong la bsngags brjod byas 'dugde ltar gokhale ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go stod du zhi 'jam ring lugs pa'i 'go 'khrid dngos gnas pa zhig yin pa dang / khong gi sems la rang yul gyi khe phan sgrub pa de bzhag yod cing / dbyin gzhung gis nor 'khrul dang / khrims dang mi mthun pa byas che de dag la skyon brjod byed chog chog yod pa red/ de ltar na yang gal te gzhung gis yag po byas pa byung na de la rgyab skyor yang gnang gi yod pa red/ khong mpi rgya gar 9 rang dbang rang btsan ni gros tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs kyi sgo nas len rgyu dang / de yi ched 'thab 'dzing yang sbos tshogs kyi thabs lam nas byed dgos pa'i yid ches gnang mkhan zhig red/ khong gis sred don gyi 'dzugs skrun la mi mang rnams zhugs rgyu'i ched thabs shes gnang ba red/ de lta mod kyang gsar brje'i sno nas dbyin ji'i lag pa nas dbang shugs 'phrog pa'i thabs lam la zhugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes ma gnang ba red/ de ltar yin bzhin du'ang khong ni dus skabs der rgyal gces pa che shos dang / rgyal khab la sre zhu zhabs 'degs rlabs che zhu mkhan zhig red/ khong gis kārshas tshogs pa'i nang gi zhi 'jam ring lugs pa dang / drag po'i ring lugs pa gnyis slar yang mnyam 'dzoms gcig gyur yong rgyu'i dmigs yul bzung yang de 'grub ma thub pa red/drag po'i ru khag gam drag spyod ring lugs pa/sngar bshad zin pa ltar zhi 'jam gyi thabs shes kyis grub 'bras thon pa ma byung bar brten kārjes tshogs pa'i nang bsam tshul gzhan pa 'dzin mkhan byung ste/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa la zhu 'bod byed pa'i snyom chung slong ba po'i byed stangs las yul la rang dbang 'thob mi srid cing / rgya gar gyi rang dbang ni drag spyod dang /
le'ugasumapa/ deng dus klu byung ba brjod pa/ 319'che ba dang / nub phyogs pa rnams dmar gsod gtong ba dang / dbyin gzhung gi dpal 'byor la gtor bshig gtong ba sogs drag po'i btsan spyod 'ba' zhig las dbyin ji'i btsan gzhung rgya gar nas mthar skrod thub pa'i yid ches byed mkhan byung ba de tsho la drag spyod pa'i ring lugs pa'am drag po'i ru khrag ces brjod pa red/rgya gar gyi rang dbang gi byung rabs ni 1885 lor rgya gar rgyal yongs kāñdzas tshogs pa nas 'go tshugs pa yin zhing / brgya phrag bcu dgu pa yongs rdzogs dang / brgya phrag 'di'i thog ma'i char kārjes dbu 'khrid tshos rgya gar rang dbang gi las 'grul rim pa mang po zhig byas shing / de tshog khrims mthun dang drang po'i sgo nas dbyin gzhung gis rgya gar la khe dbang sprod rgyu'i yid ches kyis khrims mthun gyi dgos 'dun byas rte zhu 'bod sogs byas pa red/ 'on kyang dgos 'dun ma grub par ma zad dbyin gzhung gis spyod tshul las dbu 'khrid tsho'i re ba chad pa na de tshos dbyin gzhung thog gnon shugs che ru btang skabs dbyin gzhung gis legs bcos kyi khrims gzhi mang po zhig bzos te/ don du mgo skor smyu brid las rtsa ba'i khe dbang gang yang ma sprad pas kāñdzas tshogs pa'i nang dbu 'khrid gsar pa khag mang po'i sems la drag spyod kyi bsam tshul byung zhing / de ltar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni/ dbyin jis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan shugs bed spyod byas pa dang / nub phyogs kyi shes yon dang srid don gyi slob sbyong yar rgyas su phyin pa dang / yul khag mang por gsar brje byung nas dmangs gtso'i srid gzhung tshugs pa las rgya gar ba tsho la slob gso thob pa dang / rje rnam dpyod kun dga' (5mi smyuwe1nanda )sogs kyis gzhung 4tshe kyi sgo nas rgyal gces dang rang dbang gi bsam blo'i gzhi rtsa brtan po bzos nas rgyal khab ring lugs kyi lta spyod spel ba dang / zhi 'jam ring lugs pa tshos 'bad brtson gang byas pa las rtsa
320 'phags yul 9 byungab brjodapa/ba'i dmigs yul ma grub pa dang / rgya gar gyi dpal 'byor nyams rgyud du phyin pa'i thog dbyin jis bshu gzhog byas pa dang / yul du lo nyes dang mu ge rgyun mthud byung ba dang / āṇḍa ku4na gyis srid byus gdug rtsub can bzung ba sogs rgyu rkyen du ma zhig dang / gnas tshul mang po zhig la brten nas kāñdzas yi nang du dbu 'khrid gsar pa mang po zhig gis drag po'i bya spyod kyi sgo nas dbyin ji'i rgyal srid rgya gar nas phyir skyod byed pa'i bsam blo btang ba red/ rgya gar gyi rgyal yongs ring lugs pa drag spyod byed mkhan 'di tsho brgya phrag bcu dgu pa'i mjug tsam nas 'do tshugs te bar bar du dus yun gang mtshams ring 'jam du phyin pa las dus rabs nyi shu pa'i bcu phrag gsum pa bar gnas yod pa red/gong du bshad pa ltar gyi rgyu rkyen grangs mang zhing las drag spyod pa'i ring lugs de dar yod pa yin yang gtso che shos ni 'jig rten gyi byung ba khag las skul ma thob pa dper na 1905 lor nyi hong dang lku ru su'i dmag 'khrug nang nyi tong la rgyal kha thob pa de las shar gling yeshilā'i yul zhig gis nub gling yuropa kyi rgyal khab gcig pham par byas pa'i gnas tshul dang po de byung ba yin pas rgya gar ba'i mi mang tsho la yid ches gsar pa zhig brnyed pa ni shar gling gi yul zhig gis nub gling pa pham par byed nus pa de shes pa red/ 1905 lor urusu la gsar brje byung nas mi dmangs la dbang cha phra mo tsam yang med pa'i rgyal srid btsan dbang ring 4tshe de med pa bzo ba'i thabs shes byas pa red/ gsar brje de mdo mnan pa yin yang rgya gar ba tsho la rgyud skul thebs pa red/ de mtshungs 'jig rten 3 cha shas gzhan khag tu yang bran g.yog dang mnar gcod btsan dbang ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi mang gi 'thab rtsod sna tshoḍa byung ba dper na āyaraleṇḍa gyi mi mang tshos dbyin ji'i dbang 'og nas thar ba'i
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 321'thab rtsod byas pa des rgya gar gyi rang dbang rtsod len pa tsho la skul ma thebs pa red/gang lags zer na āyaraleṇḍa gyi rang dbang rtsod len pa dang / rgya gar gyi rang dbang rtsod len pa gnyis kyi bsam tshul 'dra po yod pa red/der ma zad 1905 lor āṇḍa kuradzan gyis baṅgāl mnga' sde de dum bu gnyis su bdos pa de las drag spyod pa tshos bsam blo drag rtsub ches cher phyin pa red/de skabs baṅgāl de rgya gar gyi mnga' sde che shos yin zhing / de'i khongs su bihār cha tshang dang / utnaswā'i cha shas mang po yod pa red/ baṅgāl gyi shar gyi cha shas de lngasām dang mnyam sbrel te mnga' sde gsar pa zhig bzos/ las don de ni kha bral dbyen sbyor byas te dbang sgyur zhes pa'i srid byus lag len du byas pa zhig yin zhing / de skabs baṅgāl de rgyal yongs las 'gul nang ang dang po yin pas mnga' sde de dum bu gnyis su btang na kha che dang kha che min pa'i khra mang bar dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byed thub pa dang / de la brten nas rgyal yongs las 'gul mgo gnon thub rgyu'i bsam blo btang yod tshod/ kuradzan gyis bshad don/ shar baṅgāl de kha che'i gnas yul yin pas zur du dbye dgos zhes brjod pa red/ dmigs yul ni kha che dang hiḥ gnyis phan tshun 'dzing du bcug nas kha che tsho rgyal yongs las 'gul las zur du 'byed rgyu de red/der brten 1905 3 zu 7 ches 19 la baṅgāl dum bu gnyis su gtong rgyu'i dril bsgrags byas shing / 1905 phyi zla 10 ches 16 nyin dngos su lag len byas pa red/rgya gar gyi rgyal yongs las 'gul pa tshos dbyin ji'i bsam blo'i dmigs yul ha go nas baṅgāl yongs rdzogs su khong khro me ltar 'bar zhing grong khyer khag la tshogs 'du byas te rngam ston byas/ mnga' sde dum bu gnyis su bgos pa de la ngo rgol byas te kha

le'ugasumapa/ deng dus gyi byung ba brjod pa/ 329ba de srid 'dzin dang / b.rakatu'i la sred blon bsko bzhag byed rgyu byas pa red/ 'on kyang 'char gzhi tshang ma lam lhong ma byung bar gsar brje ba mang po 'dzin bzung byas te mnar spyod tshad med btang nas dus yun ring por btson du sdod dgos byung ba red/rgya gar ba'i gsar brje'i las don byed mkhan tshos so so'i dmigs yul bsgrubs ma thub na yang / khong tsho'i yul zhen dang / sming stobs dang / rang srog blos gtong byed pa'i sems shugs de ni bsngags par 'os pa zhig yin pa dang / mi mang la rgyud skul yong ba'i 'byung khungs lta bu zhig yin pa red/ gsar brje'i las don pa de tsho'i las ka byed stangs la skyon cha 'ga' shas yod pa dper na de tsho'i bsam par dbyin ji'i mi ngan 'ga' shas dmar gsod gtong nas rgya gar yul rang btsan bzo thub kyi yod pa'i yid ches byas pa red/ gnyis nas de tsho ru khag chung chung mang por sgrig 'dzugs byas pa las de tshos mi mang byings rnams gcig bsgyur gyis so so'i mnyam du 'khrid pa'i 'bad pa ma byas pa red/ der ma zad khong tshos btsan stobs shin tu che ba'i rgyal srid chen po de sger gyis 'che ba'i las don las med par bzo mi thub pa de ha ma go ba dang / de lta bu'i rgyal srid de mi mang gi las 'gul 'ba' zhig las pham par byed nus pa de ma shes pa red/ de dag la brten nas de tsho la drag spyod pa zhes btags pa red/ de lta mod kyang khong tsho'i dpa' mdzangs dang 'jigs zhum med pa de rgya gar gyi mi mang la rgyud skul yong ba'i 'byung khungs lta bu yin/kha che'i srid don tshogs pa gsar 'dzugs/kha bral dbyen sbyor byas te srid dbang sgyurd ces pa'i dbyin ji'i srid byus sngar bshad pa ltar srid byus de'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni hiḥ dang kha che'i bar dkrug shing dbyen sbyor byed pa de yin pas/ dbyin jis rgya gar du kha che tsho dang hiḥ gnyis
