le'u gsum pa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 3891948 lo'i rkyen ngan/rgya gar la rang dbang byung nas zla ba lnga lhag tsam rjes 1948 zla ba dang po'i tshos 30 nyin rkyen ngan shin tu chen po zhig byung ba ni/ bdag nyid chen po gardza mchog bkrongs pa de yin la/ de yang khong gong ches nyin lha khang du gsol ba smon lam gnang du phebs skabs nā:rām goṭase zhes pa'i hiX'i chos lugs pa mgo bo brag las kyang mkhregs shong chos dang chos min gyi rnam gzhag mi shes pa yul dang mi mang gi khe phan soḍa gtan nas mi shes pa zhig gis me mda' brgyabs nas bkrongs pa red/khong bkrongs pa'i gnas tshul des rgya gar tsam ma yin par 'jig rten yongs rdzogs la mya ngan dang blo pham chen po byung ba red/ 19 mchog ni deng dus kyi rgya gar gyi skyes bu che shos de yin zhing / khong ni 'jig rten nang skyes bu chen po dag gi gral du brtsi ba yin la/ khong gi dbu 'khrid 'og rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan byung ba red/der brten khong la rgyal khab kyi yab ces 'bod pa red/ khong gis hiḥ dang kha che sogs chos lugs tshang mar gcig mthun yong ched sku 3 gang por 'bad brtson gnang zhing / rgya gar yul dum bu gnyis su bdo rgyu la ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu gnang mkhan thig yin pa red/ kha che dang hoḥ'i bar zing 'khrug gis mi gsod khrag sbyor byung ba dang / yul dum bu gnyis su btang ba las thugs pham tshod med byung ba red/ khong ni 'tshi ba med cing zhi bde dang bden pa'i phung po zhig yin zhing / 'gro ba mi'i thob dbang la gal gnad chen po 'dzin mkhan zhig red/ khong ni rtsod rnyog gis khengs pa'i 'jig rten 'di la lam yang dag par ston mkhan gyi snang ba'i ka ba chen po zhig yin la/der brten khong la bdag nyid chen po zhes 'bod/ khong gis rgya gar tsam ma yin par 'jig rten yongs rdzogs sdug bsngal las grol thabs bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhes pa red/
390 'phagasayul 3 byung ba brjod pa/der brten de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po de yul la rang btsan thob nas mi ring bar rkyen lam du 'das par 'jig rten spyi dang lhag par rgya gar mi mang rnams mya ngan gyi nang du thim pa red/ khong gi bzhed tshul dang spyod tshul de la mgo mkhregs pa 'ga' shas kyis dga' po ma byas pas khong bkrongs pa yin tshod/ 'di'i skor btang snyoms su bzhag na legs pas zhib tu ma spros/rang dbang gi rjes su thog ma'i byed sgo/rang btsan rgya gar gyi yul dang mi mang ched bya dgos pa'i las don shin tu mang po yod kyang thog mar gal gnad che shos ni yul du srid don gyi gcig gyur bzo dgos pa de dza drag che/dbyin ji'i srin blon 697 ma'og gis 1947 lor dril bsgrags gnang ba dang / mu'ulnga 26na gyis 'char 'god ltar phyi zla drug pa'i ches gsum nyin slar yang dbyin ji 7gong ma'i srid dbang rgya gar nas phyir bsdu bya rgyu dang / rgya gar spru yul 'di rgya gar dang pānastun zhes pa'i rgyal khab gnyis su bzo rgyu yin tshul bshad pa des dngos don du dka' snyog gting ring po zhig bzos yod pa red/ de'i go don du rgyal po chung khag gis skyong bzhin pa'i rgyal phran rnams rgya gar mnyam du zhugs pa'am 5gistun mnyam du 'gro rgyu'am yang na so so rang dbang du sdod pa gdam ga bya chog pa zhig bstan pa red/ gal srid de tsho rang dbang du bsdad pa yin na 'dzin skyong dang srid don gang thad nas gtan nas mi 'grigs pa dang dka' ngal brjod mi shes pa zhig yong rgyur gdon mi za ba red/dbyin gzhung gis rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan sprad pa'i snga nub tu rgya gar
le'u gsum pa/ deng dusagyi byung ba brjod pa/ 391nang rgyal phran lnga brgya dang drug rtsu re gnyis tsam yod pa red/ de tsho la naXb zhes pa kha che'i dbang 'dzin pa dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal po chen po rnams kyis dbang bsgyur bzhin yod pa red/ rgyal phran de tsho'i skor sngar yang bshad zin la/ de tsho tshang ma dbyin jis rang dbang du bzhag pa yin pa'i snang tshul tsam yod kyang don du dbyin ji'i srid dbang gi grib 'og tu byi'u gser gyi drwa ba'i nang du bcug pa lta bu zhig yod pa red/ dbyin rdzas srung skyob byas pa ma gtogs rgyal phran de tsho rgya gar rang dbang gi las 'grul dang srid don gyi 'gyur ba'i rlabs phreng gis gtsang mar phyin yod kyi red/'on kyang dbyin ji'i srung skyob las gnas thub pa byung / 1kānir dang / pasa.ālā dang / swālegar dang / badzodwa sogs rgyal phran gtso che ba tshang mas rgya gar dang mnyam zhugs bya rgyu'i 'dod mthun byas pa red/ 'on kyang lhadarabād dang na/ kasha'ir rgyal po gnyis gyis rgya gar mnyam zhugs 'dod ma bstan par rang dbang du sdod 'dod byas/ rang btsan 9 sngon nyi ma bzhi bcu la pasal mchog gis rgyal phran tshang ma rgya gar dang mnyam 'dzul zhugs dgos skor 'bod skul gnang bar tshang mas 'dod mthun byung yang (pāl 9 nalhab dang ind+rar gyi rgyal po gnyis kyis the tshom dang dngangs skrag byung bar rjes su go bkon bses dkrol sogs byas te de gnyis kyang rgya gar dang mnyam 'dres/ mthar rgyal phran gsum lus pa ni snrunāgaḍar dang rtedarāpād dang / kushagrwar gsum yin zhing / juXgadha ni sa cha'i chags stangs ni rgya gar dang 'brel la/ dbang 'dzin pa ni kha che'i nalhab yin pa des pāṇḍastun dang mnyam 'gro 'dod byas kyang mi mang mang che ba hiḥ yin pas mi mang gi ngo rgol sogs byas rkyen mthar junagadu de yang rgya gar du zhugs pa red/rgya gar rang dbang byung nas mi ring bar 5gistun gyis kunarmār la btsan rgol
392 'pha sa yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/byas par nashasmyur rgyal pos rgya gar la rogs ram zhus pa na rgya gar gyi kushasmyur rgya gar dang mnyam du zhugs rgyu'i dam bca' byas na rogs ram gnang rgyu'i gros mthun byas shing rgyal pos de ltar dam bca' byas rte gros mthun yig cha bzhag 'phral rgya gar gyi drag dpung btang nas pyagistun gyi dmag dpung mthar skyod btang bzhin pa'i skabs srid blon naharus dmag mtshams bcad nas rgyal spyi'i nang bka' mol gyis zhi 'grig bya dgos tshul gsungs pas gshagrwar gyi sa cha phyed ka lhag tsam las len ma thub par lhag ma de 5gistun 'og lus lhang dus da lta yang rgya gar dang shākastun bar rtsod rnyog gi rtsa ba yin pas rgyun du dka' ngal yod bzhin pa red/rtedarabād la rgya gar gyi drag po'i las don dang srid don zung 'brel byas pa dang / rtedarāpād yi gzhung 'dzin nidzām zhes pa'i kha che'i dbang 'dzin pas a ri'i srid 'dzin dang mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs la yang rogs ram zhu thabs byas kyang pasal gyis las don drag tsam nan po gnang bas mthar 1950 lor phyo zla dang po'i ches 25la rgya gar gyi dbang 'og tu zhugs pa red/de mtshungs mnga' sde so sor dbye 'byed dang / rgyal phran tsho so so'i 'dabs 'brel gyi mnga' sde'i nang phyogs bsdu sogs srid don gyi gcig gyur cha tshang byas yod cing / de skabs kyi mnga' sde khag gi grangs 'bor dang gnas stangs deng sang dang 'dra po rang med kyang rtsa ba'i rgya gar gyi mnga' khul de ga rang yin pas golha ma gtogs rgya che chung de ga rang yin/rang dbang rjes su yul gnyis ku'i nang gi zing cha/gong du bshad zin pa ltar rgya gar yul du kha che dang hiḥ gnyis dbar 'then 'khyer byung ste/ mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi 'che ba'i las don lhing 'jag ma byung ba'i
le'u gsumapa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 393skabs su yul gnyis la rang dbang thob pa yin la/ der brten rang dbang byung rjes kyang lam seng zing cha ma 'jag par rgya gar gyi kha che mang po pāṇḍastun la phyin pa dang /pā'istun nas hiḥ 'bum phrag mang po rgya gar du yong ba yin zhing / phan tshun gnas stangs ji bzhin ma shes pas sdang zug gis gsod brdung 'phrog bcom sogs thabs sdug mang po byas yod 'dug dbu 'khrid tsho'i dgongs tshul ga re yin yang rung / me mang dkyus ma tshos kha che dang hiḥ'i chos lugs la gzhi byas nas yul so sor gyes pa yin pas kha che tshang ma 5gisprin la 'gro dgos pa dang / hi( yongs rdzogs rgya gar la yong dgos pa'i bsam blo btang ba yin tshod/ 'on kyang de ltar cha tshang yong thabs ma byung bar rgya gar du kha che bye ba mang po gnas yod cing / rgya gar du yod pa'i kha che'i grangs 'bor de 'dzam gling nang kha che'i rang dbang gi rgyal khab mang po las mang ba zhig red/gang ltar 5gistun nas mi 'bum phrag mang po glo bur du yong ba des dka' ngal chen po byung zhing / de dag tshang ma la sdod gnas dang / zas gos dang / slob sbyong gi rogs ram thog slar yang gzhis chags thabs bya dgos byung ba red/ gnad don de la rgya gar gzhung dang mi mang gis rogs ram rgya chen po byas/ yul dum bu gnyis su gyes shing mi 'bum phrag mang po yul byol du yong ba sogs las dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal shin tu chen po byung zhing de dag la gdong len mthar phyin bya rgyu de rang dbang gzhung gsar pa de'i las 'gan gal che ba zhig tu gyur pa red/ rgya gar rang dbang gi srid gzhung gis mi mang la yar rgyas yong thabs dang tshang mar 'dra mnyam gyi thob dbang sogs sprad pas las don lam lhong dang ldan pa gnang ba red/
394 'phags yulagyi byung babarjod pa/rgya gar rang dbang rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims gsar bzo/de 'dra'i skabs su rgya gar gyi rtsa khrims gsar pa bzo ba'i las don yang byed bzhin yod pa red/ sngar bshad zin pa ltar mabirjeṭa tshogs pas ma 'ongs rgya gar gyi rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs ched rtsa khrims bzo mkhan lhan tshogs 'dems sgrug dgos tshul bshad pa ltar 1946 6 zla bdun pa'i nang khrims bzo lhan tshogs kyi 'os 'dems byung zhing / 'os 'dems de ni mi dmangs nas thad kur 'os bsdu ma byas par mnga' sde khag gi gros tshogs kyi 'thus mi tshos bdams pa zhig yin pa dang / 'thug mi'i grangs 'bor ni mi mang gi grangs 'bor la gzhi byas pa zhig yin te de yang mi grangs 'bum bcu'am sa ya re'i thog 'thus mi re bdams pa red/ 'thug mi'i grangs 'bor khyon bsdoms sum brgya brgyad rtsu gya dgu 389 yod pa de tsho'i nang mang che ba rgyal yongs ༷sgres tshogs pa'i khongs mi red/ 1947 lor pāṇḍastun bzos pa na kha che'i tshogs pa'i 'thus mi tshang ma pāṇḍastun la phyin pa ma zad de'i sngon du yang 1946phyo zla 12 tshos das snyan khrims bzo tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du tshugs skabs kha che tshogs pa'i 'thus mi tsho ma yong ba red/ der brten rtsa khrims bzo mkhan tshogs pa'i 'thus mi'i nang mi grangs sum brgya brgyad 308 yod pa red/ 'thus mi tshogs pa de yi nang rgya gar gyi mi sde kun dang / srid don tshogs pa kun dang / gral rim tshang ma'i 'thus mi yod par ma zad yul gyi khrims la mkhas pa chen po khag kyang yod pa red/ rtsa khrims bzo mkhan lhan tshogs de'i nang srid don gyi dbu 'khrid shin tu gal chen po mang po yod pa dper na/ paṇḍita ngaswāhārakhāl niharu dang / mkhas dbang rwajedra srasād dang / saradur wa7lha lhakhri pasal dang / rgyalānā āsprad dang /mkhas dbang shām srasād nakharje dang / saradur b.ladewa siha rnams yin zhing / khong

406 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjod pa/brdung bdegs dang / dmar gsod sogs ni nag nyes yin zhing / dngul sprod len dang / rgyu dngos po'i rtsod rnyog dang / gzhan yang phan tshun ma mthun pa'i rtsod pa sogs ni nyes pa tsam po ba yin zhing / 'di rigs la spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba'i nyes pa zhes brjod kyang rigs par sems/rgya gar du ches mtho'i khrims khang ngam khrims khang mtho shos ni rgyal sa di: la yod cing / de la khrims dpon mtho shos gcig dang / khrims dpon gzhan bcu bdun tsam yod pa red/ khrims dpon tsho'i grangs 'bor ni dbus gros tshogs kyis khrims bzos nas sgyur bcos gtong chog cing / khrims dpon che shos dang khrims dpon gzhan tshang ma srid 'dzin gyis bsko bzhag byed cing / rang lo drug cu re lnga'i bar las don byed chog khrims dpon du 'khod pa la dang po rgya gar gyi mi ser yin dgos shing / khrims kyi sbyong brdar mthar phyin byas pa zhig yin dgos/ der ma zad lo bcu'i ring khrims rtsod pa'i las don byed myong yod pa'am yang na mnga' sde'i khrims khang chen mo zhig gi nang lo lnga'i ring khrims dpon gyi las ka byed myong yod pa'am yang na rgya gar gyi srid 'dzin kyi dgongs tshul la khrims la mkhas pa yin par bzhed pa gang rung dgos gal che/ khrims khang mtho shos kyi khrims dpon du bskos pa'i rjes su las sla por phyir 'bud thub pa min par dbus gros tshoḍa su sum cha gnyis kyis mos mthun byas te gros chod byung na ma gtogs las don nas phyir 'bud chog pa min/ khrims khang mtho shos des khrims zhib rigs yongs rdzogs byed thub pa red/ yul gyi khrims khang gzhan yongs rdzogs khrims khang mtho shos 'di'i 'og tu yod pa yin/mnga' sde'am zhing chen phal che ba la khrims khang chen mo re yod cing / khrims khang chen mo la khrims dpon gtso bo re dang / khrims dpon gzhan mang po yod pa
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus 9 byung ba brjod pa/ 407dang / khrims khang 'di tshor khrims dpon gyi grangs 'bor ni mnga' sde che chung la rag lus pa yin/ khrims khang 'di tsho'i khrims dpon rnams ni srid skyong dang / mnga' sde'i khrims dpon gtso bo rnams kyis gros 'debs gnang nas bsko bzhag byed/mnga' sde khrims khang chen mo mpi mnga' sde de'i nang khrims dpon che shos yin zhing / mnga' sde'i nang gi khrims khang gzhan tshang ma de'i 'og tu gnas yod/ khrims khang 'di tshos nag nyes dang nyes pa tsam po ba gnyis ku'i skor khrims zhib byed chogkhrims khang 'og ma yang mang po yod de/ de yang rgya gar gyi mnga' sde rnams rdzong khag du mar bgos yod cing / rdzong khag re'i nang nag nyes dang / nyes pa tsam po ba'i skor khrims zhib byed mkhan gyi khrims khang sna tshogs yod pa de rnams la khrims khang 'og ma zhes bya/ rdzong khag gcig tu nyes pa tsam po ba'i skor khrims gtam mkhan ni rdzong dpon gyi khrims khang yin zhing nyes pa tsam po ba rnams la khrims zhib byed rgyu'i dbang cha rdzong dpon khag la yod pa dang / de tsho'i las don la rogs ram byed mkhan khrims dpon 'phar ma yang bsko bzhag byed pa yin/nag nyes kyi kha mchu gtam mkhan rdzong gi gnas tshad dang mthun par seshan khrims khang yod cing / de la seshan khrims dpon zhes pa zhig yod pa yin/ de tsho ni rdzong gi gnas tshad gyi khrims khang dang khrims bdag yin/ rdzong khag tu yod pa'i khrims khang 'og mya tshos khrims bcad pa de la khas len ma byas par khrims khang chen mo khag la zhu gtug bya chog pa yin/ khrims khang chen mos khrims bcad pa'i rgyab 'gal du khrims khang mtho shos la zhu gtug byed chog pa'ang yod/ mdor na khrims khang dma' rim zhig gis thag bcad pas ma tshoms na khrims khang mtho sar zhu gtug byed chog khrims khang mtho shos kyis thag gcod byas na de'i gong zhu gtug bya yul
408 'phags yul 3 sung ba brjod pa/gzhan su yang med pas tha ma yin/ 'on kyang khrims khang mtho shos kyis mi zhig la srog gi chad pa btang ba yin na de'i gong gtug sa med kyang srid 'dzin la snang rje'i zhu 'bod byed chog sming rje'i zhu 'bod de gsan bzhes gnang 'os min ni srid 'dzin gyi dgongs bzhed la rag lus shong / gnas stangs gang thad nas dpyad pa gnang ste gang dgos gzigs rgyu red/de ltar khrims bzo mkhan dang / lag len byed mkhan dang / khrims zhib byed mkhan bcas cha shas rnam pa gsum gyis dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab 'di'i 'dzin skyong byed pa lags shing / mnga' sde ñtsi shurshartsa lnga dang / dbus gzhung gis thad kur bskyangs pa'i sa khul khag 'ga' shas dang bcas pa'i 'phags yul rgya chen po 'di rang dbang dmangs gtso'i khrims srol bzang pos skyong bzhin yod cing / 'byung 'gyur du yang spyi tshogs dmangs gtso lam srol dang rang dbang dang zhi bde rgyun gnas kyus mi mang yongs rdzogs bde skyid la rtag tu spyod cing gnas pa'i re smon zhu/de ltar sma lo lnga stong tsam gyi lo rgyus dang ldan zhing / ya rabs spyod tshul gyi mi ñtsha ches ring po zhig nas yar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam gling shes rig gi 'byung khungs/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyu 'khrungs yul/ gzhung lugs dang rig pa'i gnas thams cad 3 'byung gnas/ 3 nang gi lta ba dang grub mtha' sna tshogs 9 bdar sha gcod sa/ srid dbang can tu che ba'i 7gong ma dang rgyal po dang / rgyal phran du mas rim par dbang sgyur byas pa'i rgyal khab/ shar gling gi skye bo rnams kyis rtag tu grus zhabs dang che mthong bya yul/ nub phyogs pa'i yul rnams cas ya mtshan gyis rtogs zhib dang / rgya skyed 'dzugs bskrun bya yul/ kha che'i dbang 'dzin pa sna tshogs kyis rim bzhin lo brgya phrag mang por srid pa'i phun tshogs la longs su spyad
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus spre byung ba brjod pa/ 409nas gzi brdzid dang che ba ngoms sa/ dbyin yul sogs nub gling pa tshos dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyis srid kyu dbang sgyur byed sa/ rgyal gces dpa' bo rnams dang yul zhen can tshos dus ring mor so so'i bde skyid blos btang gi sgo nas rang dbang rtsod gleng gi las 'gul zhi drag sna tshogs byas pa las mthar rang dbang rang btsan thob ste spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dmangs gtso spyi mthun rgyal khab chen po deng dus 'dzam gling gi zhi bde'i rtsa bar gyur pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul 3 byung ba brjod pa legs bshad zla 'od gsar pa zhis bya ba re zhig rdzogs so//bde bar gshegs pa gang du 'khrungs pa dang / /lung rtogs bstan pa gang du dar ba'i yul/ /'phags pa'i yul la kun gyis sdus mod kyang / /lnga phyi'i byung ba tshul bzhin ma shes pas/ /rmongs dang 'khrul pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs smra/ /'ga' zhig gtam brgyud kho nar gzhir bzung zhing / /la las so so'i sems kyu 'char sgo la/ /gang shar smras pas yid ches thub par dka'/ /spyir na rang re'i gangs can bod yul du/ /byung rabs gnas la do snang dman pa dang / /gal chung brtsis pas legs bshad shon tu nyung / /byung rabs grags can 'ga' shas bris 'dug kyang / /'phags yul rgyal rabs rim pa 'chol ba dang / /dad pa'i dbang gis sgro 'dogs byas pa mang / /
410 'phags yul 3 byung ba brjod pa/'phags pa'i skye bo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i mdzad pa ji snyed pa/ /so so'i skye bo'i blo yul las 'das pas/ /ngag gi lam nas nges brjod mi thub kyang / /thun mong snang ngor thun mong byung ba rnams/ /thun mong lam nas tshul bzhin 'chad dgos shing / /gnad don re yang khungs dang ldan pa dgos/ /byung rabs gnas la rjes dpag kho na 'jug /rjes dpag tshad ma mngon sum la brten pas/ /mthar thug mngon sum zhig la thug pa dgos/ /dngos rnying zhib rtogs rig par gzhi bcol nas/ /tshan rig thabs tshul mang pos tshad 'jal zhing / /gzhung lugs yig cha du mar rgyab brten te/ /mkhas pas byung rabs gnad don rjes su dpog /phyi rgyal gzur gnas mkhas pa mang po dang / /'phags yul byung rabs smra la mkhas pa tshos/ /ji ltar bshad bzhin gangs can skad du bris/ /gal te nyes par mchis na bzod gsol zhu/ /gangs can mkha' lam yangs pa na/ /mkhas dbang rgyu skar tshogs rnams kyis/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i snang ba dang / /legs bshad khru ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i rmongs mun yongs su bsal/ /'on kyang 'phags pa'i yul chen gyi/ /
le'u gsum pa/ deng dus kyu byung ba brjod pa/ 411byung rabs snga phyi ma 'chol ba/ /tshul bzhin 'chad la btang snyoms mdzad/ /de phyir bdag gis 'bad pa yis/ /mkhas dbang du ma'i rjes 'brangs shing / /gtan tshog rnams la zhib tu brtags/ /'phags yul byung ba mdor bsdus bkod/ /byung rabs rig pa'i rgya mtsho de/ /shin tu rgya che gting zab pas/ /thig pa tsam zhig blangs pa las/ /zhib tu brjod par ga la nus/ /de yang rmongs 'khrul la sogs kyis/ /nyes par bshad pa'ang yod nges pas/ /gzur gnas slo gros spyan ldan gyis/ /sreg bcad brdar bas dpyad par mdzod/ /deng dus 'jig rten snyan grags las/ /legs bshad don du mi gnyer zhing / /bden par smra la sdang bar byed/ /'khyog por bshad la mkhas par 'dzin/ /de lta na yang bden pa'i don/ /rmongs 'khrul ngo bstod zob bshad kyis/ /ma sgrib gsal bar ston pa ni/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i khyad chos yin/ /'bad pa 'di las rnam dkar gang mchis pa/ /'jig rten bde skyed phun tshogs ched du bsngo/ /lhag par kha ba can dang der gnas pa'i/ /skye bo pho mo'i blo gros 'phel gyur cig/ /legs bshad 'di ni nam zhig bsil ldan gyi/ /rang btsan gtsang ma'i gzhon nu pho mo tshos/ /brtag shing dpyad de sgrog pa'i dge mtshan gyi/ /snang ba 'dzin ma'i khyon du khyab gyur cig/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byung ba brjod pa legs par bshad pa zla ba gsar pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di ni sku sger drung che rma rje rta ra ba bstan 'dzin chos nyid
412 'pha pa yul 9 byung ba brjodapa/mchog gi bka' yos bskul bas gang gi bka' dgongs snyi bor blangs te/ bas/la rdzongs shar gyi phyogs su skyes pa ge ru ba thub bstan mchog sgrub kyis phroṃ lo 1996lor ri bo 'bigs byed spre lho phyogs lha chen po'i ri rgyud kyi dkyil pacamari zhes pa skya seng bu lnga'i ba: gnas su grags pa'i dben gnas nas 'do brtsams te 1997lor lārāgarsā'am yul gsal ldan 9 grong khyer nang legs sbyar gtsug lag slob khang chen mor mjug grub par bgyis pa re zhig rdzogs so// //bkra shis par shog
kha skong lhan thabs kyi sde tshan/
kha skong dang po/theg pa chen pa'i slob dpon gtso che ba khag gi byon lo/theg pa chen po'i slob dpon yongs su grags pa gtso che ba dag gi 'khrungs lo dang de dag 'phags yul gyi rgyal po su dang su'i skabs su phebs pa yin min gyi skor 'di gal che bas mdor tsam dpyad par bya zhing / de yang spyir btang gi ston pa bde bar gshegs pa zas gtsang gi sras po gang gi 'khrungs lo la ches mi mthun pa mang ba sngon dus kyu byung ba brjod pa las bshad zin pa ltar la/ lhag par du theg chen gyi bstan pa byung tshul dang / theg chen gyi slob dpon rnams kyi 'khrungs lo soḍa kyi skor byung rabs smra ba tsho'i bzhed pa ches mi mthun pa mang bas mtha' gcig tu kha tshon gcod pa shin tu dka' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de ltar dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ni rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran dag phal che ba'i khang bzang ngam/ mchod rten nam gzhan yang shul rjes sna tshogs shig rjes su lus yod pas de dag gi grogs ram dang tshan rig gi thabs tshul las lo dus rjes su dpog thub par ma zad de dag gi rnam par thar pa'am lo rgyus sogs 'phags yul du brnyed thub pa sogs byung ba rjes su dpog thub tsam yod la/ theg chen gyi slob dpon phal che ba'i bzhugs gnas pho brang sogs rjes su lus pa mthong rgyu ma byung ba dang / rnam thar lo rgyus kyang 'phags yul du rgyun 'jags med par bstan pa la nyams rgyud byung rjes 3 dngos po'i shul rjes dang / nang gi bstan bcos sogs tshang ma shul med du gyur 'dug pas tha na dbu ma rtsa ba sogs dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs kyi rtsa ba yang legs sbyar skad sogs 'phags yul gyi skad du ma thob par phyes su bod kyai sngar gyi dgon pa khag nas rgya dpe rgya gar du gdan drangs pa yin zhing / deng dus rgya gar du theg chen gyi bstan bcos mang po legs sbyar skad du
416 'phags yul 9 byung ba brjodapa/bzhugs pa phal cher bod nas gdan drangs pa yin zhing / theg chen gyi gzhung la 'chad nyan cung zad yod pa 'di yang dus rabs snya shu pa'i nang du byung ba yin pas sngar gyi byung rabs 'tshol bar shin tu dka'/bod du ni spyir nas byung rabs la gal chen po ma brtsis shing / lhag par du 'phags yul gyi byung rabs sogs kyi skor tshad ldan gyi yig cha dkon zhing / re gnyis yod pa rnams kyang dag snang gi lo rgyus kyi tshul du bris pa ma gtogs byung rabs lta bu zhig ma yin pas sgrub byed de dag kyang bsgrub byar gyur pa las rjes su dpog pa'i thabs su 'gro ba dka'/ byung rabs ni byung rabs lta bur 'chad dgos pa las de dag snang gi chos kyi tshul du 'chad na byung rabs su mi brtsi ba yin/ des ni theg chen gyi slob dpon mang che ba'i 'khrungs lo dang / 'khrungs yul sogs gtan gtan shes par dka' 3gas chen po yod/slob dpon de dag gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rmad du byung ba mang po yod pa rnams las cung zad dpog nus shing / de bzhin bstan bcos gzhan rnams su slob dpon de dang de yi lung drangs pa sogs brnyed na de dag las bsam gzhig byed thub pa yin/ dper na mu stegs pa'i mkhas pa shin tu grags che ba lhacaspati misha ste ngag gi bdag pos slob dpon chos grags kyi tshad ma rnam 'grel la dgag pa byas yod pa dang / ngag gi bdag po de phyi lo brgya phrag brgyad pa'am dgu pa'i nang du byon pa yin pas chos grags de'i sngon du byung bar nges pa lta bu yon/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang sogs kyang brnyed pas las sla/phyi rgyal ba'i mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis kyang theg chen gyi slob dpon 'ga' shas kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la deng dus dang mthun pa'i zhib 'jug byas te de dag gi
